The only downside was that we had to wait nearly a half hour to get our check after a dinner-we had to chase several people down. We were elsewhere for dinners after that experience.

reviews.title: Stephen saved the day
reviews.text: I had the best experience with Stephen, in room dining manager.  He was beyond helpful and kind in an experience with trying to send a bottle of champagne to a guest on property.  I  truly love the Four Seasons properties, and Stephen was an example of the service and care the hotel exemplifies.

reviews.title: Best hotel ever in Las Vegas.
reviews.text: We have stayed in Vegas a dozen times in all kinds of five star hotels. The level of service, attention.to detail and cleanliness (and ambience) is unsurpassed. I’d only come back here in the future. We got recognized with champagne and chocolate upon check in, cake and Prosecco on our birthday and every interaction with the staff was ncredibly pleasant. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: What a great place. Beautiful quiet hotel close to it all. Great breakfast and lovely rooms. Put my sunglasses on the counter, came back and they were sitting on a lens cloth. Plugged my phone cable in, came back and there was a cable tie. Wonderful staff. Not sure how they could do anything better.

reviews.title: Very Pleasant Vegas Hotel
reviews.text: No hassle, pleasant stay. I did not know this was part of the Mandalay complex, but it is a separate side (and top floors) of it and very nice. Quiet, spacious, comfortable and clean rooms. Professional and cordial staff, make you feel like a welcomed guest and treat you like a human being. Rooms are clean, large, comfortable to be in. Close to airport so you can hear some rumblings during the day (not at night) if you are facing closer to the strip but nothing bad or annoying. Not a room service person but ordered one time and food was fresh (salad with very lettuce fresh), fries came hot and crispy, etc so good on that, and the breakfast in the Veranda had it all! It is located at the starting edge of the strip (1.5 km from MGM, 3 km to Bellagio) so need to tram and walk bridge over to the main part of strip (or uber, cabs are less frequent at this hotel) but all is great with the property. Very enjoyable weekend stay in late January to see U2!

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: It was a wonderful place to stay. We had a room on the top floor with amazing views of the city lights. The room was modern, clean, bright, very a comfortable  bed and pillows. The staff was amazing especially Sarah and Zenja at the front desk and the valets. We had a great time.

reviews.title: Best Hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: If you want to feel pampered and really taken care of, this is the hotel for you. Staff was very friendly, very helpful, and definitely made you feel recognized. The rooms were very clean and the beds were like clouds of pillows, not too soft and not too hard just perfect. They have nespresso machines in the rooms with sweetener and creamer, and they provide cans of water for you. They also have water refill stations on every floor to keep you hydrated. The housekeepers were very helpful and organized our things. My husband arranged a birthday surprise for me and it was just perfect, with chocolate covered strawberries, champagne, and a little birthday cake. The restaurant downstairs had great service and great food with a very nice buffet on the weekends. The four seasons connects to Mandalay Bay through just a little door and then you’re in the casino. I actually preferred that you didn’t have to walk through a casino to get to your rooms. The Door men were very helpful and they have little heaters outside while you’re waiting for your ride. There’s a nice little bar and coffee shop in the lobby. Overall the hotel was beautiful and clean. This is definitely where we will be staying in Vegas from now on. We also like the Cosmo and the Venetian, but we loved the personalized experience here.

reviews.title: Relaxing stay hidden in the midst of Vegas
reviews.text: Having been to Vegas dozens of times I had never experienced a stay quite like this. The four seasons is an oasis in the middle of the hustle and bustle of Vegas. Everything was nice and clean and the staff was impeccable. Having the private entrance to the four seasons but also all the access of the Mandalay Bay was the best of both worlds.

reviews.title: Traveling with teens
reviews.text: Thanks so much for a fabulous five nights. Your concierge team was exceptional setting up with great dinners   Being able to walk to the Raiders game and an easy ride to the Knights game made for a perfect location. Having connecting rooms was excellent. And not having to walk through a smoky lobby was lovely

reviews.title: A tasteful hotel
reviews.text: Their no gambling and no smoking policy creates a good relaxing environment. Atmosphere is upscale which is nice to have in a place like LV. Bed and high quality bedding was also very relaxing. Tasteful xmas decor. Nice quiet lounge and fire pit outside. All staff excellent

reviews.title: Quiet oasis in the heart of Las Vegas
reviews.text: This hotel is perfectly situated at one end of the strip, attached to and part of the Mandalay Bay complex.  The hotel has a separate entrance, lobby, and amenities (spa, fitness center, bar, restaurant) and, most importantly, NO CASINO.  It is, as you would expect, a calm, quiet, and relaxing environment from the moment you walk through the doors.  But, there are several doors that lead to the Mandalay Bay, including one that opens right into the casino.  So, it is easy to get the “Vegas experience” when you want without having it forced on you at all hours of the day and night.  The staff is excellent.  The concierge desk is staffed with several knowledgeable staff members who can make reservations, acquire tickets, and help with suggestions for things to do and see during your stay.  We consulted with them almost every day.  The spa is small but lovely, and the services were excellent.  There is no place I would rather stay in Vegas.

reviews.title: When you want the very best!
reviews.text: If you are looking for the very best, the Four Seasons is your choice.We came earlier this year to visit a friend and again this December. They have a new GM, Konrad Gstrein and he, along with hotel Manager Salar, has transformed the hotel. The rooms and suites have all been renovated in elegant neutral tones with comfortable materials and high quality furnishings, and wonderful new toiletries. It’s a deep renovation and stunning. There is a new signature restaurant, Mina, opening soon. We love his restaurants and cannot wait to return to try it.They have endless thoughtful complimentary activities, fitness classes, a fresh hot donut station in the lobby, and a veritable army of incredible Clef d’Or concierge with truly all the secrets to enjoying the very best of the city. The housekeepers are cleaning ninja who kept our rooms spotless and with genuine care.The spa has a team of healers and aestheticians who added 10 years to my life. Book in advance as it’s very popular with both locals and guests.This hotel has many regular guests, which we are not, but we were still greeted by name and treated so well.We cannot wait to return. Thank you Four Seasons Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Long weekend on the Las Vegas Strip!
reviews.text: Everything was great! The hotel atmosphere, all the staff were perfect, no smoking allowed at the hotel and no casino was a perfect hotel stay for us, the room was well equipped and we give it an A+ for the view of the Strip! Felt very safe and it was at the end of the strip so a very quiet stay too but close enough by Taxi to all we wanted to experience! Loved everything about this hotel will return to this hotel in the future!

reviews.title: Great Upscale Las Vegas Options
reviews.text: We live in Utah, when I travel to Las Vegas, once or twice a year, I am picky. At 67 years, an academic executive for the last 10 years of a research academic career, now in private practice and engaged in my own personal scholarship, I guess I can afford to be picky. Because when younger, I couldn’t afford to be. So. now, I choose carefully with cost as a minor factor. I generally stay at the Four Seasons. It’s simply the best Hotel brand in this town. Stands apart. The Wynn is nice, but you are confronted with casino everywhere. Trump Hotel is worthless, really. Caesar’s well located, but too used. This goes for others, Mandaly Bay, Bellagio etc. Botique hotels, Nomad - even the upscale options, disappointing. I’ve tried them all. Crowds everywhere. Service spotty at best. And I could go on with my comparisons. Honestly, I am picky. But, the Four Seasons is as good as it gets here, yes, there are small things. Chat line is a little slow at times. But, nothing is perfect, nor will it ever be. If you want a nice, relaxing stay in this town at a cost, of course, Four Seasons is really the only option.

reviews.title: Wonderful weekend get away
reviews.text: We had a lovely weekend stay at the Four Seasons Las Vegas.  The staff was wonderful and so helpful.  Sitting around the fire pit, drinking delicious drinks, and eating s'mores was one of the highlights of our trip.  It was such a relaxing trip.

reviews.title: One of the Finest Hotel we been to
reviews.text: Simply the best, I have been to Vegas few times previously. Nothing compares to Four Seasons Hotel. Great location, great experience. Will be definitely visit there again. The Best hotel we have ever stayed.

reviews.title: Hit the jackpot in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We stayed for a birthday celebration and loved the peaceful respite from the strip in this no gaming no smoking hotel. Our suite was spacious and very comfortable. Breakfast was plentiful and delicious. Everything was so well done, tasteful and relaxing.

reviews.title: Disappointing Experience at Four Seasons Las Vegas
reviews.text: The conditions of my room were far from satisfactory. The bathroom had issues, with a clogged shower drain that resulted in a complete flood. This does not align with the standard of excellence I associate with the Four Seasons brand. Although the maintenance team was notified and attempted to resolve the issue, the solution was only temporary, and the problem recurred. // When making the reservation, we were informed that we could request an upgrade, subject to availability. However, upon arrival, we were assigned what I can only describe as the worst room in the hotel, located at the end of the corridor and in unsatisfactory conditions. Furthermore, the corridor was untidy, with trash on the floor and an unpleasant odor. This deviated from the quality standard I associate with Four Seasons. We requested a new room, but we have not received a response to this request during our stay. // In the reservation, it was stated that breakfast was included and that we had a credit of up to USD 300 for expenses at the hotel. However, at check-in, we were informed that the credit was only USD 90 for breakfast, and the total value for hotel expenses was USD 100. This lack of clarity and conflicting information made the experience even more frustrating.

reviews.title: Not the Four Seasons experience
reviews.text: Substandard in most regards. Rooms are dated, we were charged $22 for two terrible iced coffees, wait to check in was absurdly long. Would say this was more like a 1.5 Seasons. Will stick with Wynn properties or Aria in the future

reviews.title: Good, could use improvement
reviews.text: We love the Four Seasons brand and always have the best experience, but this location didn’t feel as special.Pros:Pool and hotel are small and smoke free which we love in Vegas.Pool staff and all the guys at the main doors were very attentive and kind. One guy was so kind that when our Uber passed the turn into 4S he ran to find him… we were so appreciative and impressed.Lunch by the pool was great! Cons:Room was pretty outdated (but I will say it felt clean).Construction went on into 7:00 PM each night on floor 39.Front desk was awful for check in and check out. Check in was a little snarky and we had an idea we were getting an older room when the clerk asked us if we, “booked through Expedia at a discount”. We were both pretty surprised and said no it was through Amex Travel which we’ve done many times as their concierge team is wonderful! We also booked that way as there was no availability on the 4S website and knew we preferred the brand and location. Check out seemed a little unorganized when we left they asked if we wanted printed or emailed invoice. We said email and they let us know they didn’t have an email on file. Seems strange that we fill out paperwork during check in and it’s not put into the system or used.

reviews.title: Not what you expect from Four seasons
reviews.text: Long lines for breakfast, with no heads up that its better to get a table in advance.No chairs in the pool, which needs to be reserved as well. no one told us. had to wait an hour for the chairs.very long line at checkout, got billed money to my credit card but never got the bill sent over.had large moths in my room both nights

reviews.title: Real luxury in Vegas
reviews.text: The Four Seasons Las Vegas is heads above other luxury hotels in Vegas.Perhaps because there is no casino, the service is centered on the comfort of the guests. And comfort is everywhere - from the pool and surrounds to the great spa, the really good restaurants and the well-appointed rooms. Service staff is prompt and extremely helpful.

reviews.title: Top Notch
reviews.text: Super clean, friendly staff and all the amenities you'd expect from a luxury hotel.  Appreciated that there were several cans of water around the room and I loved that the iron actually worked and didn't leak.

reviews.title: Moths inside our Four Season hotel room!
reviews.text: Moths inside the hotel room! We were mortified. October is "moth season", evidently, and we saw them 3 days out of our 7-day stay. When we told the front desk the first day, their response was "Oh". The next day, the manager told us that they come through the vents. We also saw them by the elevator in the hallway. He comped us a $20 lunch from the previous day, but not the $35 snack that wasn't charged to our hotel room (but for which we had the receipt and showed him). I have PTSD from killing moths; I'm on a flight, so can't seem to upload a photo or video of it. They were everywhere, including in our luggage, so I shook out everything so as not (hopefully) to bring them home with me! We've been Four Seasons fans, having stayed at them in Philadelphia, Dallas, Denver, Minneapolis, Los Angeles (Beverly Wilshire), Hong Kong, several in the Maldives and planning a stay in Nevis this coming February. The hotel manager wouldn't give us a voucher for our upcoming stay in Nevis, saying that each Four Seasons is individually owned. News to me and interesting that we are evidently not garnering any favoritism by staying at Four Seasons hotels. We may rethink future travel plans and definitely never staying at this one in Las Vegas again.

reviews.title: A memorable stay.
reviews.text: It was a pleasure to stay at this property, nothing short of exceptional. The room was wonderful, comfortable, impeccable, and elegant. Incredible, friendly, and knowledgeable staff. The lobby bar was a delightful place to unwind and enjoy a drink. The bar staff was amazing and their attention to detail was impressive. In particular, I must mention Jorge, whose exceptional service stood out. He exemplified outstanding qualities and his passion for the craft is evident, and his recommendation were on point. The spa staff was efficient and professional. Heather exemplified the qualities of an outstanding massage therapist. Additional the hotel's location within the Mandalay Bay and on the Strip is convenient.

reviews.title: Poor Service
reviews.text: Checkin was at 3 but room was not ready until 4:45. Concierge failed to bring my bags up and had to retrieve them myself. The house manager never called and we scheduled a time to speak. Poor service to say the least.

reviews.title: The Four Seasons Las Vegas simply sets the standard for all hotels...
reviews.text: The Four Seasons Las Vegas simply sets the standard for all hotels. it is simply the best in the city. The main thing about the Four Seasons is the incredible quality of service. In this category, I believe the Four Seasons has no real competition in Las Vegas. Leland Dempsey

reviews.title: Outstanding Hotel
reviews.text: If you need some respite from the hustle and bustle of Las Vegas, this is the hotel for you. Calm, serene, and well appointed. Will definitely be staying again. The quiet pool, astonishing breakfast buffet, and the serene spa were only outdone by the impeccable service. The house keeping staff went well above and beyond any other hotel I've stayed out, and the service/waiters were on point.

reviews.title: Just fabulous!
reviews.text: This was one of the best hotels I ever stayed in.  We enjoyed it for two nights and I wish it was longer!  The room was huge, clean, and well furnished with the most comfortable bed imaginable.  Service at the hotel was as good as it gets.  We had a wonderful breakfast on-site at The Veranda (Short Rib Hash - so big you can split it).  The pool area is quiet but you can opt to use the Mandalay Bay Beach “water park” which is very busy but fun.  I would be happy to stay at the Four Seasons again!

reviews.title: READ NOW- Four Seasons is THEE PLACE TO STAY
reviews.text: My husband and I have been coming here for years. Now, obviously we have developed relationships with the long time staff that has been a part of this Four seasons team. So perhaps my review could be a little skewed. Despite that, I cannot imagine staying anywhere else in the Las Vegas area. The double to triple cost of this hotel is worth every penny. The pool staff is out of this world. They will make sure every need is taken care of, they will make sure you have freshwater that is complementary and they will make sure that you have a cushioned seat with a towel. They also bring around treats every hour on the hour, and if you were missing from your chair, they will find you to make sure you do or do not want whatever they have to offer. You will never feel unloved or unwelcome at this hotel. The valet is beyond. They will help you get to any destination needed and of course the House car is often available. The rooms are lovely and the breakfast is very good. Compared to a mass produced called buffet you find elsewhere. There are very few things in life that I rate a five star without hesitation, and this is one of them.

reviews.title: Four Seasons Hotel Las Vegas
reviews.text: We stayed here for 1 night. I found the staff were helpful. We had a bedroom overlooking the pool and airport area. My husband loved sitting watching the planes fly by.As part of a small group we had a delicious meal. Attention to detail was amazing as the food was beautifully presented.The buffet style breakfast was amazing. There was so much choice. American style cooked food, omelette and doughnut station. Freshly made dishes being brought through constantly and amazing staff.My only qualm after speaking to a bar tender was that there was nowhere to change before we left for our flight during the evening. Check out was 12 and we could leave the luggage behind until it was time for get ready.We didn’t have time to use the pool or spa.If you are looking for some peace and quiet away from the hustle and bustle of the strip here is the place for you.

reviews.title: Beauty in the midst of  this gambling town
reviews.text: I just returned from a long weekend at this beautiful hotel.  The service was impeccable.   The service workers were gracious, always smiling & offering to help in any way we needed.   Our room was clean & spacious. The location is perfect. While it is on the strip, it is at the end so much quieter than you would expect.  The hotel is a welcome change from the busy casino hotels. This was my first stay at a Four Seasons but I will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Four Seasons goes Westin😉
reviews.text: Arrival / Check In: at the southern end of Vegas, in Mandalay Bay. Very nice, separate driveway. Friendly welcome by valet.Reception was forgettable, however. The blonde receptionist actually has no business being around customers. Not Four Seasons standard. Snappy. No personal approach. You are not even accompanied to the elevator. Weak!Rooms: all rooms have a nice view, as you are at the top. Strip View rooms are a long way from the neon lights of the Strip (due to the hotel's location) and not really an upgrade. We had a view of the Luxor Hotel - it was good. Rooms have been renovated since our last stay. Floor-to-ceiling windows, good air conditioning. Despite the renovation, the hotel also looks dated in the rooms. Nice beach bags for the little one and children's shampoo. Friendly and thorough chambermaids.Coming from the rooms at the Encore Hotel, this was a step down.Gastronomy: apart from the main restaurant, with a very nice terrace and a wonderful, plentiful, balanced breakfast, the hotel has nothing to offer. If you ignore the pool and room service, the quality of the breakfast was really good. However, the staff were not consistently at 5-star level. The restaurant situation will change, however. It is not tragic that there are many very good options in Mandalay Bay itself.Pool, fitness: that is the real highlight, spacious, top service at the pool. And if you want, you can go over to Mandalay Bay and use everything for free. Great for the little one.Conclusion: The rooms and especially the not consistently friendly staffdo not make the hotel great. The reception in particular was bad. The pool was great, though.Therefore, only a limited recommendation

reviews.title: Small minded attitude
reviews.text: Can’t believe that a top brand 5* hotel like Four Seasons in Las Vegas can be so small minded about providing a complimentary cup of fresh milk to a customer who does not want to drink long life UHT milk in the room . And we had even bought a filter coffee in the downstairs bar. Front desk tried to escalate this to the manager but I said he/she can reply to me on trip adviser . This has not been an issue at any of the other top hotels we have stayed at during our trip to New York , Nevada and Arizona . It undermines the credibility of their brand , and the customer experience , for something so small .

reviews.title: I didn't like it even though it was quiet
reviews.text: I did not feel like I was at the Four Seasons Hotel as usual. The Four Seasons hotels are distinguished in dealing with the customer, but in Las Vegas the matter is different. ...............I was hoping that my requests would be responded to, but there is no doubt about who you are calling for.. The treatment is bad, bad, bad

reviews.title: Hotel quiet, ROOMS ARE NOT!
reviews.text: The hotel and staff are pure Four Seasons. Lobby bar his too small to handle a Saturday night. Didn't get maid service on a Saturday. We had the DND sign out from 12-3pm and finally had to ask for a new set of towels at 6:30pm. Little to no apology for no service. BUT the reason we will not return is the noise in the room. We were in 38219 (38th floor) and had to listen to a Mandalay Bay nightclub until 2:20am. This is not a Four Seasons! No Four  Seasons in the world would be ok with this. All hotels on the property are owned by MGM (including Four Seasons). Sad to see them lower the Four Seasons standard.

reviews.title: Found Heaven In Sin City!
reviews.text: They were very accommodating and allowed us to check in early. The suite was very clean, comfortable, and lots of amenities (steamer, Bose speaker, hair dryer, phone charger, slippers, robe, etc). The pool area had very comfy lounge chairs with pads. The entire staff from valet, check-in, and even the housekeepers went out of their way to accommodate us.  Everything was heavenly!

reviews.title: vegas for Calvin Harris
reviews.text: Sure we are 50 year who still like going to EDM shows but we also want to kick back and relax and there is no better place to do that in Vegas than the Four Seasons.  The service is incredible and unpretentious.  Food is very good and refined but doesnt scream uptight.  We were meeting people at Wynn and there was 7 of us heading to there and they allowed us to use their house car to get there together which was a lifesaver.  Hanging out in that pool the day after was exactly what we needed to do to relax and rehash our incredible time!

reviews.title: Fantastic! Best hotel experience ever!
reviews.text: Loved everything about it. Great service. Beautiful hotel. Really nice accommodating staff. Love love loved it. Only suggestion is tv should have ability to connect to paramount plus or other streamers.

reviews.title: Too Much Anymore
reviews.text: The wife and I love staying at the Four Seasons we used to stay here often because its a great chain. A standard room was just under $300 and a 1 bedroom strip view room was about $650 a night. Even though we can afford it, I'm not going to pay it. After taxes and other charges, which are adding another $80. This is a stupid amount of money. As a business owner, the cost doesn't equal the benefits.

reviews.title: Truly Pet Friendly
reviews.text: I travel with my cat extensively for business purposes as he works as a brand ambassador for pet companies. The Four Seasons is the only hotel that allows cats on the Las Vegas Strip. The hotel was wonderful and provided all the accessories needed for his stay. My feline loved the litter box, bed and dishes that were in my room. Will try to stay at Four Seasons every where we go!  The staff was also wonderful.

reviews.title: Good stay overall, but a bit disappointing for a Four Seasons
reviews.text: This review is the subjective opinion of an individual traveller and not of Tripadvisor LLC nor of its partners. Tripadvisor performs checks on reviews as part of our industry-leading trust & safety standards. Read our transparency report to learn more.

reviews.title: Best Dog Friendly Hotel
reviews.text: Best Dog Friendly Hotel! Amazing Service and Great for families in Las Vegas. Our family has been on a summer road trip and needed a dog friendly hotel. The Four Seasons was the perfect place for us and we will be back.

reviews.title: A stay worth experiencing
reviews.text: Perfection even when at capacity.   I used the hotel bar during a convention and found the staff great even though they were slammed with work.   The very best in staffing and comfort.  The pool was relaxing even at the hottest part of the day.  Nicely placed and staffed.

reviews.title: Best Hotel in Vegas by far
reviews.text: Fantastic hotel - top floors of Mandalay bay - have stayed at lots of strip hotels none compare to this. Staff amazing big thank you to Nicole who made our trip fantastic. Pool - always escorted to a bed - nothing too much trouble . Do not bother staying anywhere else - this is the best in Vegas . You will love it . Thank you again Four Seasons. The Cavill family .

reviews.title: Excellence in everything
reviews.text: My husband and I loved staying in this hotel for our Vegas vacation. I can't say enough good things about it and I can't wait to stay here again. It is a haven on the strip, free from smoke and much quieter than other hotels we've stayed at. I also loved the convenience of having the quiet of the Four Seasons nestled inside everything the Mandalay Bay complex also has to offer. It feels like two hotels for the price of one. The customer service is impeccable from start to finish and adds to the overall feeling of true relaxation and pampering. Already dreaming of the next time I can lounge by the pool here...

reviews.title: FS delivers again
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay. The hotel and rooms are impeccably clean. The service is always above par. The food at the hotel is exceptionally good. We enjoyed being able to access the Mandalay Bay pool but being able to come back to the FS pool, which was quieter and calmer.  We saw a number of celebrities at the hotel during this visit. I noticed how my young son was treated with the same level of care and respect as the celebrities.  No matter who you are or what age you are, the customer experience is always a 10/10. We will be back.

reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.text: What a wonderful oasis in Las Vegas strip. Staff was so polite, the pool was amazing, the beds were a dream. Can not wait to go back! You can also readily access the Mandalay Bay pool and lazy river.

reviews.title: Peace in Vegas.
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort. It gave my family the peace we needed after being out in the chaotic strip. The rooms are well appointed and clean. The beds are a dream!  We enjoyed breakfast at Veranda very much too!  It had so many selections and the staff was very kind. We enjoyed the private pool at FS but did venture out to Mandalay Bay’s wave pool and lazy River for a little bit. Overall it was a lovely stay and we look forward to returning!

reviews.title: Faux Seasons
reviews.text: Incredibly disappointed with our three night four day stay, sold one thing online that was completely different upon arrival.  The room looked nothing like the photographs posted on their website!  Most disappointing was the air conditioner was locked at 68* not cooling the room at all, apparently remotely controlled by management which did not work even after the hotel desk operator requested it be turned down to 60* in which case IMO we should have been offered a change of rooms where the ac would actually work.  No, she said that I would need to put in an engineering request for repair WHAT?!  During the call I mentioned the room was not anything like the photos they have posted online when booking, said desk operator -they were in the process of updating their rooms and the new photos would be online next weekend- well it’s been two weeks and they have not been updated or changed. I don’t appreciate being lied to with a blanket statement that clearly wasn’t true or having to stay in a room with little to no ac plus room decor that looked straight out of 1990 with zero luxury provided.

reviews.title: Great all around
reviews.text: This was our first stay and it exceeded our expectations. The attention to detail is impeccable and every staff member was friendly and welcoming.  The hotel breakfast was delicious, the bed was luxurious, and the option to swim in several swimming pools made for a great time. Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: The retreat
reviews.text: The four seasons Las Vegas is amongst my favorites. The stark contrast of quiet, refined, elegance, and impeccable service makes it a true oasis in the heart of a beautiful madhouse. The staff was always available to help and I never had to look for anything while poolside:) The Veuve Clicquot themed cabanas are also very well done and a nice touch in the summer!

reviews.title: Back for the 4th Time!
reviews.text: Rooms have been renovated since I was last here. I always enjoy my stay. Peloton Bikes available in the fitness center.Pool service is legendary, and the Four Seasons pool is closed off from the rest of the Mandalay Complex. BUT - you have access to the Mandalay Bay Pools and Amenities.FYI- it’s located @ the southern end of the strip, which means walking to other venues can be troublesome. But, my event was held at the Caesars Forum, and I still stayed here…so obviously, I find it worth the walk. The distance from Caesars, Bellagio, Wynn, etc., also means the hotel is quieter than others, so it can be a pro. I personally enjoy the oasis away from the hustle and bustle (and shenanigans) of the strip. Plus, there’s a house car available during the evenings.

reviews.title: Great stay away from the hustle and bustle
reviews.text: Great experience at the Four Seasons Hotel Las Vegas! I choose this hotel due to it not being directly part of a casino and away from the chaos of the central strip (and, of course, the glowing reviews). I'm glad I did especially after visiting those areas. The tram systems between the casinos is useful for traveling to the Luxor and Excalibur without having to go outside. The MGM area is also close to the Excalibur tram but otherwise I'd recommend a ride-share or taxi.The private pool was an excellent aspect of our stay after visiting the Mandalay Bay pool and seeing how crowded it gets. However, the Mandalay Bay pool is worth visiting at least once...just go early during the summer.The Amex perks were okay (daily $75 for an average breakfast) but we did not receive early check-in (arrived around 11:00 AM and informed hotel ahead of time but room was not ready until 2:30 PM) or a room upgrade. These are based on availability but disappointing not to receive nonetheless especially since it was more expensive to book through Amex.Overall, great stay and would stay again.

reviews.title: Exceptional hotel!
reviews.text: Would HIGHLY recommend staying at the Four Seasons. Loved that you were close enough to the action but could have a calm, clean and classy environment to return to. I have never stayed in a nicer (I had a queen suite) and cleaner room!

reviews.title: Best in Vegas for families
reviews.text: We last visited in the middle of Covid, May 2021, and was bitterly disappointed with the aging room. Now, after renovations, it’s like a gem has been finely polished. Just so well done, it’s like night and day to how it was before. What hasn’t changed is the service: impeccable. My only wish and hope is they get a restaurant in to replace the steak house that didn’t survive Covid. Right now, the only restaurant on-site is closed Monday thru Wednesday, leaving the lobby bar the only option for dinner.

reviews.title: Highly Recommend
reviews.text: The service at this hotel is amazing. The manager at the breakfast buffet/pool has clearly created a team with his staff. I was impressed with how sweet the man making donuts was with kids at the buffet. The staff at the pool were always checking in, brought pitchers of water and popsicles and went above and beyond. The manager stepped in to help at both locations which I respect a lot. We were greeted in hallways and everywhere we went. The room was clean and comfy. The food was great and we loved being in Vegas but not being in a crowd or having to walk through a casino if we didn’t want to.

reviews.title: Stay here if you want a calm vacation in Vegas
reviews.text: Having traveled to Vegas multiple times for both professional and personal trips, my biggest gripe is the large crowds and chaotic check-in/out, as well as long walks through loud casinos. Four seasons provided that calm, personal experience in the middle of the strip. I would highly recommend it for folks that know Vegas and are looking for a chill retreat.

reviews.title: Forgetting what makes them different
reviews.text: We’ve been coming to LV 4S for 15 years. We enjoy the quiet elegance and service. It is an oasis to retreat from the loud crowds. We’ve tried the other top places in Vegas, but always return to the 4S. The deciding factor for my wife is the pool experience. It is the only pool where you can rest calmly, read a book or just nap. However, on this visit we were surprised about the loud music and DJ. Now the pool experience is just like any other hotel. The 4S forgot what makes them unique and desirable for a certain type of clientele. If we can’t get quiet relaxation at the pool, we might as well go to Aria Sky Suites, Encore Tower, Waldorf, Trump or other high end properties.

reviews.title: My Fav in Vegas. But showing s few small cracks...
reviews.text: When in Las Vegas I TRY to always stay at the Four Seasons. I do so as it is a sea of tranquility amongst the madness of Las Vegas and the attached Mandalay property. What makes the visit possible or not is their rate. Vegas hotels can be pricey, this includes the Four Seasons. However on my recent trip I was able to snag rates between $200 and $250. Add to that the ever-present resort fee and valet parking, my net charges were around $310 for my first stat and $340 on my return stay 5 days later. Still for a true 5 star Vegas hotel this is pretty good. Why I like the hotel:1) It is CALM and QUIET.2). It is fairly private given how the entrance is south of the Mandalay, so minimum crowds.3) Four Seasons service...top notch. 4) It does not smell like your normal Vegas property, you know that sick smell of air freshener, cigarette smoke, and industrial A/C/5) If I want to go down the rabbit hole and it the casino I can easily do so.Things I noticed on this visit:1) Their restaurant availability is limited. Main dining venue is only open a few days per week. Their bar has limited options for food. 2) Charlie Palmer Steakhouse seems long gone. 3) Their driveway into the property has cracks and bumps. I know this is picky, but hey is is a Fours Seasons. Still my fav in Vegas. Will stay again.

reviews.title: You'll get Four Seasons when you stay within the Four Seasons
reviews.text: You always get exceptional service at the Four Seasons!  This Four Seasons takes up a few floors inside the Mandalay Bay but you have a separate lobby, front desk, elevators, pool, fitness center and spa from Mandalay Bay guests.  Four Seasons guests can access any of the Mandalay Bay amenities.  Pro:  loved hanging around the pool where it was usually quiet and I could find a lounge chair.  Over a long weekend, I couldn't find a seat so gave my number and they texted me when a chair was vacant.  Was allowed to access the spa's steam room without having to purchase a spa service.  For Vegas, it was the shortest distance from your room to the pool - didn't have to cross the casino to get there.  Con:  Once you ventured out of the Four Seasons area, you felt it!  As the casino is Mandalay Bay, it's not very nice.  Location -very south end of the Strip so you'll have to walk at least 15 min to find somewhere to eat.  Tried to venture to the Mandalay Bay pools but it was too crowded, too loud, too messy to want to stick around.  Advice:  Just stay within all that is Four Seasons.

reviews.title: The finest hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: This is the finest hotel in Las Vegas. I did not think the Wynn/Encore could be beat until I experienced the Four Seasons. We traveled with our 2 small children this time, and we felt very comfortable having them there unlike other resorts. We appreciated the little things like coffee in our room, readily available drinking water, and no lines for elevators or the front desk. We arrived early, and our room (which the upgraded to an Executive Suite) was ready just after 12pm. After staying in many 5 star hotels across the country, I will say that this was the cleanest hotel room I have ever stayed in. The pool area was very relaxing and staff was very attentive. My only recommendation would be a small overhaul of the pool area as it is appearing dated and it seems there is room for an expansion of the pool and lounge chair areas. We forgot we were in Las Vegas while we were there (which we appreciated) but through the elevator we could access the Mandalay casino. The resort demands high prices for the rooms, but it is definitely worth it if you are traveling with children or want to enjoy a more quiet side of Vegas.

reviews.title: Luxury, comfort and calm 🥰
reviews.text: Loved our stay here last month. We were over on holiday as our son was getting married in the Valley of the Fire. Everything about the ambience, friendly and helpful staff, decor and comfy rooms were lovely. We upgraded to a suite on arrival so made the most of an early check in. We had lunch at the pool and used the cafe for breakfast. Yes it’s expensive, but sometimes you have to push the boat out and have a few nights of luxury!! Hotel is very quiet and calming, it makes a welcome change from the hustle and bustle of the other Vegas casino hotels.

reviews.title: Wonderful Staff!
reviews.text: It was a lovely stay. We stayed celebrating multiple life milestones and the hotel was at full occupancy during our stay. Regardless, we were treated like we were the only guests in the hotel. The hotel is immaculate, and the grounds are impeccably maintained. We had In-Room Dining Breakfast each morning that was prompt and delicious. The food and drinks poolside were pricey, but very well worth it. The house car is a wonderful service to use at night to get to/from strip. The poolside experience is wonderful and we didn't want to leave each day. What was our favorite part of our stay? The staff that took wonderful care of us. I'm just recognizing the "first class standouts" below:Snjezana - Pool Server: doting service poolside, attentive, and so kindNoliko - Pool Attendant: hilarious and so welcoming at the pool each dayZlata - Pool Server: remembered our name each day and was so accommodating, even remembering our orders to a teeJunior-Front Drive: very kind and welcoming-a great first impression to guests Oolong - Pool Attendant: so sweet and so smart, she remembered our names fondly, and is an excellent luxury representativeDeMarus Narcis - Hotel Assistant Manager: sent us a lovely celebration in-room amenity and hand-written cardSiham - Guest Relations Manager: very welcoming, professional, personally walked us to our room, and checked in on us through our stayMyra - Front Office Manager: largely coordinated our stay, set us up with an awesome suite, very professional, and kindStephanie - Pool Manager: she creates such a fun, luxurious pool experience, she's a natural conversationalist. You all are so luck she came to you from our favorite Four Seasons in the company (Four Seasons Maui).Alejandro - Room Service Server: delivered our room service, sent me a lovely card, and dessert for an occasionAlice Jeikal - Hotel Assistant Manager: true luxury ambassador, she made us feel like we were at her home for our stay. We are very well traveled and have stayed at dozens of Four Seasons throughout the world. Alice is definitely on our list of one of the "greats" as far as hotel employee wise who has cared for us. Davin - Front Desk: so sweet and always remembered our name, also very hungry to learnMr. McCants-Security Supervisor: very professional, escorted me to my room via wheelchair, and brought me ice packs for a minor injurySydney-Pool Attendant: very kind, attentive, and shared with us her love of hospitality education Dominique-Assistant Manager: friendly, attentive, and accommodating with her poolside team. She also adores the Four Seasons company.Thank you all for the wonderful stay!

reviews.title: *Best service in LV*
reviews.text: From the moment we walked in, the service was spectacular. They facilitated an early check-in, had the requests (extra pillows) we made in the room upon arrival.The food and drinks were good the entire stay and the high level of service was maintained. The pool was the best part of our trip. A large number of staff, always attentive. Complimentary water service, sunscreen and hourly treats (muffins, ice cream, cookies, etc.).  A relaxing time in the craziness of LV. Four Seasons earned repeat business from my wife and I. **Tip: use a “preferred partner” to book and you’ll enjoy extra benefits.

reviews.title: Always a great choice
reviews.text: always super clean, super professional. Sophistication at its finest. My favorite place to stay in Vegas other than the Cosmo. A lovely respite from all the noise and hoopla. relaxing and refreshing!!

reviews.title: Consistently do the little things well
reviews.text: I've been coming to conferences at the Four Seasons in Vegas for about 8 years now, and have never been disappointed.  It's consistent, daily, great customer service from start to finish.  From opening the doors for me when I walk in, to the water offered to me at check in, to the holding luggage, accommodating us with early check in time, refrig in our room, clean room, staff consistently acknowledging you and saying "Hi" to you or, "Do you need anything" as you walk by,  Pool staff is phenomenal, and also had the opportunity to meet the new Gen Mgr, who was working poolside along side staff.  He and the pool Mgr also made it a point to say good bye to us at the lobby entrance as we left.    The "Starbucks" of hotels, that's how I feel, and "Thank you."

reviews.title: Not a real FS, not as nice as the Wynn, but ok if the price is low enough
reviews.text: This is not on the same level as other Four Season properties.  Think of it more like a decent Westin.  There are many areas where you can feel a general sense of apathy with the staff and the property overall.  This isn't a luxury hotel.  A few examples:- Our room keys didn't work on more than once.  No apology, and instead we had to deal with a surly "security" guy with an attitude who eventually let us back in.- The food in the veranda restaurant was subpar.  Much worse than anything we've had at the Wynn, for example.- Housekeeping came into our suite while we were still there, had the DND sign on the door, and started cleaning!- The rooms and the overall appearance of the hotel is old and tired.- We called the front desk to ask if they had any aspirin.  They didn't.  That's fine, but then they didn't even try to help us out.  Instead, it was "you can go there and they have some".  That's not the kind of service I expect from a FS.- We informed them about some of the issues above.  Most Four Seasons would follow up.  This one hasn't.You just get the sense that they don't really care.

reviews.title: Tranquility on the LV Strip!
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Four Season LV. FS feels like a tranquil escape away from the hustle & bustle of the strip. The rooms are spacious and well appointed. We love the gym and spa. Breakfast is great too. The biggest luxury is that the valet area is not crowded and packed like all the other hotels on the strip! We plan to come back on our next stay in Las Vegas!

reviews.title: One of my Favorite Hotels in the World
reviews.text: I've spent more business traveler nights at the Four Seasons Las Vegas than any other hotel in the world and they do it right!  I was there last week for a meeting and had a beautiful room overlooking JANET Airlines and the Strip. Their guest recognition is one of the best!  Tommy and Jorge at the Press Lobby Lounge bring the heat on the mixology!Veranda serves a wonderful breakfast and breakfast buffet on the weekends.  I was in the property for 48 hours without leaving and wanted for nothing.  The rooms are so elegant and comfortable and the minibar and snack bar is fully stocked.  My only complaint is the gym is too small and doesn't have floor space if you want to do yoga or stretch.  Sadly, Charlie Palmer's closed during the Pandemic but hopefully they have plans for a new restaurant for the space.  The Four Seasons Las Vegas is a luxury property you can check into for a few days and not have to leave and have a perfect time.  Oh, and the Four Seasons ChatApp is awesome, just be sure you are chatting with the right hotel if you've chatted with more than one Four Seasons on the App!

reviews.title: A fun time
reviews.text: It was a great atmosphere near to the action with the casinos nearby and they was loads to help and tips from the concierge to keep us going. The were great hotel service spa at Four Seasons Las Vegas. I was able to use their facilities and they had great cuisine

reviews.title: Las Vegas Four Seasons is a 10!
reviews.text: This is the best place we’ve ever stayed at in Las Vegas.  Enjoy all the lights and sounds of the city but then return to a hotel that doesn’t has no casino and is a quiet, luxurious retreat.  Hands down the best!

reviews.title: Great Property
reviews.text: Wonderful stay at the Four Seasons Las Vegas.  The hotel is in the same complex as Mandalay Bay and Delano Hotel but is much different.  It has no casino and was very quiet. The rooms were well-decorated, and the staff was exceptional.  I recommend this hotel for business travelers and families.

reviews.title: When you want the very best!
reviews.text: We arrived tired and stressed from a long work week to be warmly welcomed with open arms by the Four Seasons Las Vegas!Situated in the heart of where you want to be, next to the amazing shows, sports, and incredible food, meanwhile a short drive to some of the nation’s most beautiful hiking, this was the perfect choice for our stay.We enjoyed all the hotel had to offer, spending time by the pool, treatments at the spa, and the traditional glorious Four Seasons breakfast (do not miss the heuvos rancheros!). A particular standout is the spa, where from the front desk to the attendants to the therapist, everyone went the extra mile to make our time extraordinary relaxing and special. Nothing was too much for them to arrange. They helped me charge my phone, moved an appointment back because we were running late to the appointment because of traffic, had in house granola bites and blueberry muffins to die for, and when I mentioned I enjoyed the massage oil they use gave me a generous sample to take with me. Exceptional talent and thoughtfulness. Do not miss the spa!Unusually we enjoyed a suite for this short stay and though I don’t generally think they are worth the extra spend, at the FS Las Vegas, it’s worth it. The art was interesting and the decor felt very like a home away from home. Every detail was thoughtfully considered for complete comfort. The suite tv was so large that watching it felt like we were at the cinema. And, the separate living room and half bath was convenient for getting work done while my spouse slept in the heavenly bed. A special thanks to the new GM Konrad Gstrein, who believes in and goes above and beyond to empower his team to be the very best. Las Vegas is not normally a city we would visit but after staying with the Four Seasons we are already planning a return stay. Thank you Four Seasons Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Great stay if you don't want to be in the heart and noise of Vegas
reviews.text: At the end of the strip, but access to Mandalay gives pools and gambling at your doorstep if desired. Great quiet pool, food and bars are great and the rooms are well appointed. Very convenient and didn't have the smoke and crowd of the main strip.

reviews.title: A Luxurious Sanctuary Amid the Craziness of Las Vegas
reviews.text: Beautifully maintained hotel nestled next to the action of Las Vegas.  Food is excellent.  Staff is amazing.  You can choose to stay on property for a luxurious retreat, or be steps away from the Mandalay Bay and all the typical Las Vegas features.  Nice retreat!

reviews.title: More of a mid-level than luxury
reviews.text: First time staying here. There are over 100 properties on the strip so it's not like they're hard to come by. There's a bunch of factors that make one hotel better than another but the first is rooms. The rooms are fine but they don't match their price point. In fact, most of the hotel doesn't. The pool is what you'd expect in lower priced hotel. Yes, they have access to Mandaly's pools but you're paying 45 a night extra for that. Then there's service. Good service can come at any level and paying more doesn't mean you're going to receive better. Also, at check-out there was a billing issue which they overcharged an extra night and said they would correct by end of day. Great. They had charged for 5 nights on a 4-night stay. After 7 days there's still no refund. I spoke to the hotel and they said give it another week to appear. I gave it 2 weeks and still nothing. I ask if they could send an invoice of the adjustment just so I know it's been done. That took a day to receive and on it there was no adjustment made.  Call accounting back. They send me to a manager which then sends me to another accounts department.  They did overly apologize the whole time. A simple error that would normally be corrected within a day or two took them 26 days to fix. Nothing terrible about the hotel just a lackluster room, property and service that doesn't warrant a "luxury" label.

reviews.title: Great family holiday
reviews.text: Perfect family stay, with an 8 year old, in this non casino hotel.The pool and the pool team were the highlight of our stay. We enjoyed several great breakfasts in the restaurant.The beds are so comfortable.All staff and management made us feel very welcome.

reviews.title: Perfect Place to stay
reviews.text: We had a great stay: Service from the front desk to housekeeping staff is exceptional.  We booked with a Four Seasons VIP Travel Agent and received early check-in plus free breakfast and a $100 hotel credit.

reviews.title: Overall not impressed
reviews.text: We used a free night from our Hyatt account to book a one night stay at the Mandalay Bay. However, when we went to check in, they advised us that they upgraded our room over to the four seasons. We had to walk a bit down some winding hallways and stairs to get to the checkin area which sits mixed with a bar.We were immediately helped and advised that there were no room charges but would have resort fees and tax. We advised that we were globalist members and those are waived and she called her manager and confirmed that was correct. We got to our room which was down another bit of winding hallways to the elevators. The room itself was nice but could tell everything in it was an up sell. The bed was way too soft as well. At checkout, was never asked how our stay was. Overall with the stay being free it was ok, but we've had nicer stays. If we would have paid, it would have been very disappointing.

reviews.title: Calm in the ocean of Vegas nonsense
reviews.text: This is the second time I have brought a small business meeting to the Four Seasons. It is a beautiful property located with close access to the Vegas action but without all the shenanigans of the casinos right in your face. Outstanding service and attention to detail.

reviews.title: Great hotel, well trained staff members and an oasis of calm
reviews.text: We stayed at the hotel for 4 nights and had breakfast each day. For us it was a pleasure to be away from the Smokey casinos and able to enjoy healthy fruit, orange juice and yoghurt for breakfast.The Mountain View Deluxe room was very comfortable, however the airport is very close and was a bit noisy.

reviews.title: Best hotel that makes you feel special
reviews.text: The Four Seasons was amazing. Everyone who worked there was so kind and helpful. The room was beautiful and the bed/pillows were so comfortable. We used the pool and spa on our stay and both were exceptional.

reviews.title: Perfect place to stay with kids
reviews.text: We brought our two daughters on a trip to Las Vegas. The Four Seasons was SO accommodating for kids. We checked into our room and went down for a delicious lunch in the hotel restaurant. When we came back to the room they had placed cute little backpacks, stuffed bears, slippers and robes on the beds for the kids. The staff was very friendly especially in the concierge. The pool was awesome! It was not too crowded and they brought fun treats around for the kids throughout the day. Would definitely recommend this hotel on your next trip with our without kids.

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: One of the best stays I have had.  I travel a lot for business and pleasure.  This trip was a little of both and was incredible.  The service, cleanliness, staff, food, and doormen were amazing.  The room was huge and beds were super comfortable.  Bathroom was large and the shower had great pressure even though we were in the top floor!  I will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Very Disappointing Experience
reviews.text: I was very disappointed with the lack of empathy and follow-up when the hotel lost my golf clubs. I expect better from Four Seasons. Mistakes happen..but when you do not show any empathy or respect for a mistake you caused..I lose total respect.

reviews.title: Luxury oasis in Vegas
reviews.text: We've stayed here before but never fails to disappoint. A real oasis in the bustle of Vegas. Great pool, great food and drinks from great servers and lovely warm water with everything you could want. Loved the rooms and all the little touches provided by housekeeping - so thoughtful and appreciated. Thanks for another great stay :-)

reviews.title: Delightful and Quiet - but accessible to all of the Las Vegas fun
reviews.text: This was my second visit to this hotel.  As others have mentioned, the Four Seasons a a restful respite from the frenzy of this city but with easy access to all the city has to offer.  The rooms are large and well appointed, the service is outstanding.  On this visit I had my nails done at the first floor nail bar - excellent!  The food on the property is very good.  I enjoyed breakfast at Veranda on the first floor.  They offer a buffet or a solid choice of menu options.  I highly recommend the avocado toast.  I had to work so needed to order room service for dinner - delicious but you should know that the portions were extremely large. The pool and outdoor patio areas are wonderful places to relax.  Highly recommend this hotel and will plan to stay again.

reviews.title: Service is second to none
reviews.text: The staff and service at this property were outstanding. We appreciate not having to walk through a casino all of the time yet having access whenever we wanted. Rooms and common areas were very clean. The spa had everything one needed after a workout or time at the pool, well appointed and extremely clean.

reviews.title: Just sitting around watching airplanes, take off and fly….
reviews.text: I’ve been fortunate to travel quite a bit in the last ten years and I thought I was done with Las Vegas but this place changed my mind. The staff was amazing and friendly. The amenities are top shelf. Clean is an understatement. House keeping so helpful. This place is 10 out of 10🏆🏆🏆

reviews.title: Top notch service and amenities
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed for a week.  2 days for a work conference and the rest for leisure.  We had a wonderful time.  The service was great and when we had two minor issues during our long stay the staff was quick to resolve them.

reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text: Staff service and amenities are excellent.  Private pool with access to separate Mandalay Bay pool together with easy access to all the great entertainment, dining and bar option offered by the Mandalay Bay, Luxor & Excalibur complex.

reviews.title: LOVE this property!
reviews.text: Everything about our long birthday weekend stay was absolutely perfect.  This is the place to stay if you want to feel like you are on a luxurious vacation, but be close enough to easily access all the Strip has to offer.   The views are amazing.   The service was top notch and made us feel special.  The Spa was a lovely retreat.  We wished we could have stayed longer, but will definitely stay here again if we return to Vegas.

reviews.title: FIRST CLASS, FRIENDLY HOTEL
reviews.text: Staff is most helpful and accommodating.  Our spacious room (38307) with king size bed overlooks the Allegiant Stadium.  Floors 34-39 of the Mandalay Bay Hotel are occupied by The Four Seasons.  Various levels with the Lobby and Casino exits off of elevators can be confusing so look for a familiar picture or sculpture to always get your bearings.  Excellent in-room coffee maker with The Original Donut Shop coffee.

reviews.title: There is nothing better than the Four Seasons
reviews.text: It is always a pleasure to stay at a Four Seasons Hotel. The properties are consistently low-key elegance with impeccable service across the board from the valet, to the guest registration, to the concierge, to the bar/restaurant staff. I never feel like I have to be dressed up. Everything is pretty much perfect! And, they accommodated our dog with house-made dog treats, a dog bed, and food and water bowls. I wish I could travel to every Four Seasons on the globe. They never disappoint.

reviews.title: Greatest time of my life!
reviews.text: the hotel was the best of the best. Las Vegas is known for having very nice, large hotels, and this was one of them. I got the sunrise sunset room because I am very very rich, and stayed for about a week. I felt like I was a king here. I highly recommend to stay at this hotel.

reviews.title: Comfortable and pampered
reviews.text: I felt like royalty here. Comfortable bed, clean and spacious room. Loved the shower and bath tub. Truly felt pampered and refreshed despite jet lag and long days. I felt safe and well cared for. Wish I could have stayed longer.

reviews.title: Amazing time at FS Las Vegas!
reviews.text: My stay at FS Las Vegas was nothing short of AMAZING especially with super friendly staff that made my stay worthwhile! Let me start by saying the concierge team is by far the best I’ve ever connected with! Namely Cheryllynn , Ana and Karen. Cheryllynn in particular was very thorough , patient and shared the same level of excitement that I had for this first time trip. I recon in the coming months she will be Concierge supervisor as her professionalism really stood out. I was quite disappointed with my interactions with the Front desk as a number of my requests were not taken seriously like late c/o and a request for 2 queen beds instead of 1 king (Which I requested way in advance prior to arrival). No one followed up and I felt as though I was bothering the FD agents and never got my request or apology of some sort.  Concierge was way more friendly approachable and always helpful! Messaging via the FS chat was super easy , the operators and concierge staff were accommodating of every request and fulfilled and exceeded my expectations! I’ll definitely be back to this property!

reviews.title: Great 24hrs
reviews.text: I was treated with respect and had a great time. It was also right next to the house of blues so i never had to go outside. You do have to walk through the casino so just keep walking if you dont want to gamble

reviews.title: Four Seasons are always the Best, and this one was no exception
reviews.text: We recently spent two-nights at the Four Seasons Las Vegas while traveling on a tour of the Desert Southwest with Tauck.  Everything was simply great; I would not change a thing. Being in the travel business for 38 years (recently retired), I have stayed at hotels around the world of every shape and size. There is one brand that I can always have confidence my stay will be exceptional. The Four Seasons training is second to none, and it shows in every employee. My stay included a banquet reception and dinner; the banquet staff were great and the food was excellent. Rooms are large, comfortable and well appointed, and have the most comfortable beds. Everyone - housekeepers, front desk, concierge, dining room and bellmen - all gracious, friendly and professional. It doesn't get any better than that.

reviews.title: Quiet and blissful
reviews.text: We had a few days in Las Vegas before a business convention, and we chose the Four Seasons because we read that it was a nice quiet retreat from all of the chaos of the Las Vegas strip. I’m so glad that this is the hotel that we chose. I had some misgivings based on a few of the reviews, and now that I have stayed at the hotel I honestly do not understand the negative reviews at all. The staff could not have been better and they were very attentive. Veranda was wonderful. We had dinner there and also breakfast and brunch. The hotel is nice and quiet. For those wanting more action access to the Mandalay Bay resort and casino is a short walk through a door and down the hallway, but trust me you won’t want to leave the Four Seasons.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: This property has been consistently wonderful for decades. It is the seminal retreat in Vegas from Vegas. Staff is the best in town and they truly take care of their guests. Coming back to the hotel after a day of working a convention is as close to coming home as you’ll get here.

reviews.title: Valentine with my Wife 2022
reviews.text: Excellent service! Amazing property! Super clean the property! And we had a nice view from our room , Superior customer service! Food was so Ono! Planning to go back this coming summer 2023, KUDOS TO ALL ENPLOYEE! You Folks are BOMB! ❤️❤️ mahalo!

reviews.title: Average hotel
reviews.text: Disappointing stay, did not experience the usual level of care provided at a Four Seasons property. They did not offer to take luggage to room, issues with room and front desk staff did not seem to care. Restaurant staff were very nice and the kids did enjoy the holiday game room. But overall we will probably not return.

reviews.title: In town Dec. 16-19
reviews.text: To level set this review I will say that I have been in Vegas a total of 17 times in the last 21 years (mostly for work conventions). I've stayed at a variety of hotels with the most recent being two stays in Sept. of 2018 at the MGM and the Mirage. My girlfriend booked us at the Four Seasons and I was a bit underwhelmed to say the least. I have stayed at a number of Four Seasons in North America and this was not up to their lofty standards by any stretch. The rooms were just a bit above average for Vegas at best. I understand that the FS likes to separate themselves from the Mandalay casino but this was an absolute labyrinth to navigate back and fourth from the room. The service was just ok although security had an obvious issue with us putting the Privacy sign on our room. I don't like having strangers in my personal belongings so why would I want a perfect stranger in my room around my "stuff" (Just my preference).  Security left us a voicemail the second day to check in with them, which my GF returned to verify our status that we were ok. Then, no more than ten minutes after she called them to confirm,  security then made a personal stop at our room to have a health check on us. Very intrusive but if that's their policy they should re-think their approach (the security guy gave me the hairy eyeball look a few times and my GF was not happy about the interaction) As far as the food, it was average but because of the price point, I will say it was well below avg. The staff were just ok and the concierge seemed bothered by a couple of steak house suggestions. My advice would be to do your research on the other high end hotels and get better value for the money that FS asks for. We visited The Wynn and we will stay there next time.

reviews.title: Hotel suites and rooms situated next to the Mandalay Foundation club so VERY noisy till 3am… STAFF DON’T TELL YOU THIS.
reviews.text: Hotel suites and rooms situated next to the Mandalay Foundation club so VERY noisy till 3am… STAFF DON’T TELL YOU THIS.

reviews.title: Does harm to the FS reputation
reviews.text: This doesn’t even come close to what a Four Seasons should offer. As a frequent guest at FS properties around the world, I’m underwhelmed by every single aspect of this hotel. Starting from the bellman greeting and check-in process, I felt like I was somehow inconveniencing staff more than being welcomed. But the real shock was the room: after walking a confusing maze to the elevator, and then a similar labyrinth upstairs, I opened the door to the smell of carpet cleaner. Ironic, because the room looked as though it hadn’t been dusted in months. The sheets were frayed and there were wear marks in both the sleeping and bathrooms. Food and beverage is an unpleasant throwback to expense account days. My $37 breakfast included two badly poached eggs and an incinerated tomato. If you’re looking for a Las Vegas hotel on the strip, the Vdara and Waldorf do a much better job.

reviews.title: Very Good Hotel Francise
reviews.text: Stayed three nights at Four Seasons in Las Vegas. Have stayed here before. This continues to be one of my top thee choices. Why? 1. Lobby is not part of casino mileau.It’s not an overstimulating Las Vegas arrival. 2. Hotel is connected, via walking inside mall to several strip casinos. Easy access. Even to far flung venues like MGM Grand. 3. Decor is low key and stable, not ever changing. 4. Holiday decorations are nice, not glitzy. 6. Beds in room are good. 7. Services are prompt. Our heating fan went out, it was replaced quickly. You don’t get the sense that they are understaffed. 8. Decor in rooms is a little dated, but pleasant enough. 9. Tub and shower in bathroom. 10. Room has coffeemaker, small thing, but important in my view.Could use a few more usb outlets, elevator slow, press could serve those who want to stay in regular coffee cups versus paper cups, in-room movie choices are limited and poor, but these are small things. Remains a five star choice in my book

reviews.title: Quiet Casino free accommodations on the strip
reviews.text: While I enjoy occasional forays into an occasional casino I find the noise and general hustle and bustle too overwhelming on a continuous basis as frequently encountered at most Vegas hotels. The Four Seasons provided a welcome alternative. Located at a separate entrance and at upper floors of the Mandalay Bay, the accommodations were spacious, comfortable and quiet. Staff was exceptional in providing all services and location was ideal. Very satisfied with our weekend stay.

reviews.title: Four Season
reviews.text: Great people and best customer service ever, the rooms very clean and everyone I met at the hotel was very friendly and professional , you must see this hotel if you like to enjoy a stay! best coffee lady ever!

reviews.title: Overpriced Approximation of a 'Luxury' Hotel
reviews.text: Four Seasons brand should be ashamed to fly its flag on this Blackstone-owned 'property' which is really just a few cordoned-off floors atop the pedestrian Mandalay Bay --and mostly an approximation of what the unknowing might suspect a lux property to be. Obsequious service feels attentive at first, but quickly grows intrusive. Nobody needs 4 giant men all opening the property's front doors at once, nor do most of us have the bandwidth for constant polite responses to them all. Clearly the guys are there for some sort of security, which is fine. But once you're inside signage is so bizarrely poor (you'll walk in circles looking for the REALLY faraway elevators and unmarked gym), you wonder why at least 1 of them isn't assigned to route guests in the proper direction. Guest-room hallways are Mandalay's endless conventioneer layout --absurdly long, not close to lux. Everything seems geared toward the uninformed: $100 pedicure is just another gouge, as was crab and ahi 'salad' in lobby bar -- tasty but, I kid you not, literally 4 ounces of food for $28.Wasn't naively expecting bargains. But during 2 days marooned here w/o a car could there at least be one filling dish under $50 --maybe a $25 burger at the bar?Chief benefit is if ur not a gambler but must be in Vegas u can mostly avoid the cigarette smoke that poisons all casino properties. 4S still has plenty of loud guests and disruptive kids yelling in the lobby bar with not a soul suggesting they pipe down. Hardly serene.

reviews.title: Best Place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Awesome property.  Staff is friendly and courteous.  Connected to Mandalay Bay buy does not have that crazy Vegas feel, so you can have the best of both worlds. Food is excellent and the weekend breakfast buffet is a must.

reviews.title: Great Experience - quiet location.
reviews.text: First time in Las Vegas - weekend with my two sisters for one of our birthdays.  Top notch service from check in to check out.  Quiet, safe, efficient, friendly staff.  Once you enter the secure doors to the elevators that take you to the 4S floors, you feel like you're in your own world.  Rooms were comfortable and impeccably clean - staff cleaned/checked rooms twice daily - replacing towels, cleaning everything, etc.  I know 4S is known for it's attention to details (and I haven't stayed on one of their properties in a number of years) but they literally wind up your charging cords and arrange them neatly for you as well as do things like place a 4S logo eyeglass cleaning cloth under the reading glasses I left out.  That little detail tells me they notice everything.  Perfect experience and this location, while away from the noisy strip (a plus for me), gives you easy access to all that Mandalay Bay has to offer - restaurants, shops, casino, etc.

reviews.title: Beautiful safe and calm haven centrally located
reviews.text: The hotel has a great location and yet it is a wonderful haven of tranquility to which we enjoyed coming back every time after having been out and about on the strip. The city is so busy, loud and overwhelming that it was great not to have slot machines, smokers etc in this hotel's reception. The cozy pool area and lovely restaurant with a nice F&B selection helped unwind and relax during the day. The staff was extraordinarily friendly, helpful and professional. It's a very child friendly place too.

reviews.title: So great!!!
reviews.text: Loved, Loved this place so much. Stayed the week celebrating a friends birthday and everything was amazing!! Everyone was so kind and helpful, and the rooms where spectacular. Cant wait to come back and visit!!

reviews.title: Great experience a the Four Seasons
reviews.text: Had an amazing time at the Four Seasons last week attending a conference.  Once you enter the Four Season's you forget you are in Vegas. The atmosphere is relaxing and elegant. You feel like you are in a spa.  The only downside if there is one is the toilet paper. I think that a hotel of this caliber could have better quality tissue for my bum.  The staff is friendly and courteous and they cannot do enough to make the experience more inviting.  The poolside perks - delicious mini ice cream cones, candy bars, and frozen fruit come around every hour or so and are delightful when you sit by the pool on a warm sunny day. Kudos to everyone that works there.

reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.text: Every single person was fantastic.  The room and hotel was beautiful.  Close to everything yet tucked away. It is not often you have good service these days.  Everyone was genuine and went out of their way to make for a great experience.

reviews.title: Racist! Poor customer service! Don’t waste your hard earned  money at Four Seasons Las Vegas!
reviews.text: To say I was appalled at the customer service is an understatement. We experienced the absolute worst customer service throughout our stay, and I spent over 10k for the room, and usually stay at four seasons on my business trips monthly. But the Las Vegas four seasons is horrible! When I finally noted my concerns to the manager he gave every excuse in the world and claimed to give me a comp room. He lied! He actually sent me an email to book a basic room (I booked a suite and would never stay in a basic room) then he said he would “maybe upgrade me” like why even email me in the first place? The alarm went off and we were panicking because we were on the 38th floor, they never even told us what was happening so we tried to walk down the stairs, some people on my team are elderly and were out of breath. It could have been a fire, active shooter, anything!!!! We’re still shaken up about this! Four seasons did not even care, we ended up stopping and trying our luck with the elevator but still in a panic because again, we don’t know what’s going on.When we get downstairs we tell the manager and he is talking with another lady who is just as shaken up as us. He gave her a comp 3 day stay. A Caucasian woman he sympathized with but gave us absolutely nothing! This was clearly racially driven because we had a worst interaction and they didn’t even comp us one day! This place is racist, and unprofessional, and I would never stay at a four seasons again! Spend your hard earned money elsewhere!

reviews.title: A hidden gem in Vegas
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time on our weekend getaway. From the complimentary room upgrade to the breakfast buffet and quiet, clean hotel we will always stay there when we go to Vegas. It is an unmatched experience and such an easy walk to allegiant stadium. Thank you Four Seasons Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: Me and my wife checked in for our room on the 8th of Nov 2022. Lady at check in showed us around and she told us this is where we can have breakfast ?(Veranda) from 6 till 11 (not sure of the timing) and she didn't mention we needed reservation or nothing. Next day on the 9th we went for breakfast. Lady on the check in desk (Melissa) was busy on the phone, and she was not giving any attention to the entrance traffic and no single guest was waiting, and no sign saying (wait to be seated) so we just helped ourselves in, found a table and sat down. 10 min later (Christina the Restaurant manager) with too much concern on her face asking me while I am still chewing my food if we checked in before getting in. So I told her no we didn't. she said that we have to check in next time. I told her ok. She asked if we are staying in the hotel and what was the room number? I gave her the room number, and then she had to AGAIN inform us that we need to check in before we get in next time. I told her we understood the first time and no need to repeat that. She was very unprofessional and she was concerned about the rules more than her guests. I felt like I was sneaking in and really unwelcomed. She could have waited until I chewed my food, welcomed us, made a brief ice break (where are you from? bla bla ) and then addressed her concern in a way that she is concerned for us not getting the best experience possible (getting a menu which we were never offered by the way) so naturally with this approach we will end up apologizing for not knowing we needed to check in. Her Lack of experience is so clear, and I bet she is just newly promoted. I went to speak with Melissa at the check in desk, and she kept repeating my words and saying stuff that I am always here (like how come you didn't see me) and her all attitude and body language was just unacceptable. the experience literally ruined my day. I spoke with Lanikai the Director of food and beverage (very professional and nice) he listened to my concern and he made sure I have an amazing experience the next day and he came greeted us by himself. But I have never really been through such an experience before and honestly don't find my self repeating it again or recommending it. Just train your staff for God' s sake

reviews.title: Underwhelming.  Not Four Seasons Quality.
reviews.text: The common spaces of this hotel are lovely — the lobby, lounge, pool.  Unfortunately that’s where it stops.  Rooms are dated, minuscule closets, dust behind the curtains,  a broken iron and our bathroom appears to not have been updated or maintained since the hotel was first built.  Dirty, cracked grout, and the shower water builds up to your ankles before it drains.  Spend your money elsewhere.  Feels more like a mediocre Marriott than a Four Seasons.

reviews.title: Pleasant Experience at the Four Seasons
reviews.text: This property is a definite must stay for us and I highly recommend it for anyone.  It's Casino free atmosphere makes if feel like a relaxing get away, but access to casino activity is just a few steps away.
