reviews.title: One of the best hotels in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Four Seasons hotels are generally very consistent in their service across the planet and this one was no different. Polished, prompt, and friendly service with very nice and spacious rooms. Great breakfast and a relatively quiet pool area (by Las Vegas standards) made for a great stay. This hotel is a wonderful option for people who want a more sophisticated and refined hotel stay but want to still have all of the "Vegas" excitement nearby. The FS Las Vegas is directly connected to Mandalay Bay (it's actually contained within the same high-rise building but has a separate entrance) so all of the casino, restaurants, and nightlife are a short walk away. As a guest, you also have the option of using the FS pool, which is very nice or going over to the Mandalay Bay pool, which is like a small water park and day club mixed together.

reviews.title: Highly Recommend!
reviews.text: This was indeed an excellent stay! I’m so glad there was no casino on the main floor. It was serene and peaceful, away from the hustle and bustle. The staff was very courteous and respectful. The weekend buffet was excellent and I truly wish it was offered on the weekdays as well! Overall we hope to come back for another stay! Only a couple of cons which prevented the full five stars - the water in the sink would fill up fast and not drain fast enough. The fridge didn’t have space to put the water bottles in (sometimes we want to drink our water cold), and the coffee K cups weren’t very good. Definitely recommend overall!

reviews.title: A calm oasis in the desert
reviews.text: Spent a couple of nights at Four Seasons Las Vegas and they did not disappoint. Despite the hustle and bustle of Vegas, Four Seasons provided a quiet serene atmosphere away from the usual casino noise. But it's location on the Mandalay Bay property means that you are just a few short steps away from restaurants, the casino, shows and more. Definitely recommend it if you want to be away from the crowd but have the usual Vegas experience available at a moments notice.

reviews.title: Good brand in wrong city and with dysfunctional reservation system
reviews.text: Do not book this hotel directly. If you book it somehow, make sure print all you confirmations and emails. Be ready to face cold attitude at check in and in general at reception.We had horrible experience trying to proof that we have a room. Solved ultimately, after embarrassment in front of my guests. Breakfast is like in 2 star basic diner.

reviews.title: Enjoy the ride...
reviews.text: Outstanding stay. They have the magic.  From luggage assistance in the room, attending to extra care at breakfast, room service promptness, I felt valued. The room was excellent-layout, cleanliness and products available. Looking forward to see you soon.

reviews.title: Four season Vegas
reviews.text: Fantastic - best hotel I have ever stayed in.Hotel was superb, staff were excellentPool was a quiet, luxurious break from the craziness of Las VegasConf room and food were excellentEarlier check in and late check out was available which really helped as my flight out was 9:30pm

reviews.title: An Oasis in the Madness of Las Vegas
reviews.text: We were on a big road trip to/from Yellowstone.  We chose to stop in Las Vegas for a few days before the final leg of our trip home.  After lots of research (YouTube) and talking to friends, we settled on the Four Seasons.  We chose very well! The Four Seasons is like an oasis in the chaos and crowds of Las Vegas.  We were greeted by the valet and after I joked my truck needed washing.  The valet smiled and said, “we can arrange that for you if you like”.  WOW!The lobby is small but tasteful and quiet!  I mean no hordes of people standing around.  There is comfortable seating.  Check in was a breeze and we were escorted around the lobby as our American Express benefits were reviewed and shown to the elevators.We were in a Deluxe King Room (room 38134) at the very end of the hallway. We had pre-requested (via AMEX Travel) a fan and extra pillows which were already in the room.  The bed was super comfortable and the bathroom huge.  We were leaving the room one evening and housekeeping greeted us by name in the hallway!! Service at the Four Seasons was top notch the whole stay.We rented a cabana (in advance) and spent our day in the heat/sun of Las Vegas in mid-August.  We had great service with ice cream and water all day.  We found the pool to be a tad warm and learned it was heated to 82 degrees.  We used the back gate and headed over to the Mandalay Bay to try out the wave pool and found out their pool wasn’t heated and was quite refreshing.  However, going back to my earlier comment, the Mandalay Bay pools was pure chaos and NOT the calm seclusion we found at the Four Seasons pool.With American Express we enjoyed free breakfast and a $100 spa credit. We didn’t hesitate to book pedicures at the Spa.  Our Nail Technicians (Catherine and Jola) were fabulous! So much fun to talk to and we hated to leave! We believe we got the best pedicure we have ever gotten! Thanks Ladies!Bottom Line: Excellent Service and a gorgeous property - we won’t hesitate to return to the Four Seasons Las Vegas!!

reviews.title: Outstanding Luxury in the middle of chaos
reviews.text: This hotel provides an elegant sanctuary from the Vegas chaos.  Of course the chaos we love is only steps away, so this provides the perfect balance for a great experience. I have stayed here numerous times and the staff create a flawless experience each, and every time.

reviews.title: An Overrated Hotel
reviews.text: A quick recap of my stay at the FourSeasons Las Vegas: I was fed  greasy-spoon food, hassled by pool staff and driven from the lobby bar by loud & boorish patrons unchecked by Four Seasons employees.To call this hotel 5 star is some kind of joke

reviews.title: Serenity amidst the Mayhem
reviews.text: Classy and sophisticated as always and appreciated retreating here while in Vegas.Four Seasons never disappoints. Particular shoutout to the "Hawaiian mafia" at valet and Elizabeth who personalized my stay for me. Thank you also to the housekeeping staff for installing my fridge abd making sure i had a french press to make my own coffee.

reviews.title: Shower drain didn't drain.
reviews.text: Ankle high water when you took a shower. Complained, but it was never fixed. The Veranda restaurant was really good.  The spa service was nice. On the far end of the strip, so had to uber to go anywhere further down.

reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: We stayed here at the end of a trip with a tour company.  It was luxurious and relaxing.  It is a little bit of a walk from the check-in desk to the elevators.  Their rooms are on the top floors of the Mandalay Bay.  We were celebrating our 50th anniversary when we were there - and they gave us champagne when we checked in and they gave us a delicious chocolate cake.  Beds were comfortable and staff was friendly.

reviews.title: Racial and gender discrimination against hotel guests
reviews.text: This hotel prioritizes servicing white males and discriminates female minority guests. On September 1st 2022 at 12:40 PM, I was waiting in line at reception to complete check out and return room keys. A white receptionist asked me to wait when it was my turn. As she was working in front of her computer, a white male guest cut the line and went directly to her asking her for assistance. Though I was first in line, she completely ignored me and started to assist the white male. I kept waiting there until my Uber driver arrived. I ended up leaving without getting a copy of my folio. I have never been treated like this at any hotel. Read other reviews on Google. You will find that another female minority guest recently commented that she felt discrimination too.

reviews.title: Fantastic Family Stay
reviews.text: We had an amazing family stay with our 7 year old son.The service from all departments was first class, however the pool team always make our stay extra special. Great service and a lovely quiet pool.Very comfortable bed and everything we needed in our room.Look forward to returning next year.

reviews.title: Excellent, peaceful stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Four Seasons was the perfect antidote to a busy Las Vegas girls getaway weekend.  We were in town to see Silk Sonic and we loved the excellent, attentive and friendly service, the beautiful and peaceful spaces and the CALM.  The service was above and beyond, the rooms and beds super comfy, and the gym well appointed.  It was my first Four Season stay and I think I'm a convert!

reviews.title: Finest Hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: If your seeking pure luxury without the downside of overly crowded smoke filled hotels, The Four Seasons is the solution. The property is very tasteful and upscale and is the perfect choice for those seeking a more refined, less chaotic Vegas experience.

reviews.title: Truly the best there is
reviews.text: The staff at this property went above and beyond in order to ensure that my family and I had a wonderful experience. They even went as far as to help arrange balloon and gifts so that my son felt special on his birthday when some things we planned for fell through.

reviews.title: Another Wonderful Stay
reviews.text: We have stayed at this property off and on for a number of years but not within the last four or five.  From when you arrive, you would never know you are in Vegas.  Despite being separately within the Mandalay Bay, you would never really know it.  The hotel is quiet and inviting with a wonderful staff, always a smile, always willing to help.  Lobby, restaurant, bar and pool on the ground floor and rooms on the 35th-39th floors with a separate elevator from the Mandalay Bay, though there is a casino stop choice on the elevator.  Very comfortable room with a view of the Strip, very good breakfasts in the restaurant, small pool with plenty of staff but a shortage of shade for those of us who can no longer be out in the sun.  You can also use the giant Mandalay Bay water complex (way too crowded and hectic).  Never disappoints!

reviews.title: Always Excellent!
reviews.text: Realy excellent hotel and staff is exceptional. The conceirge helps all the time through their app text messages, scheduling evyrthing you could wnat including limos and rides. Really clean, food isbgreat. You get all the benefits of being at Mandalay Bay (its in the same building), but when you enter the Four Seasons area its quiet and peacefull. Like a portal from Las Vegas to a quiet peaceful place, and when you are ready Vegas is just outside a door on the casino level. My kids love the wave pool and also the Four Sesons pool because the food and staff are great. Wish i was there now.  Expensive, but you get what you pay for!

reviews.title: 5 Diamond Resort that truly lives up to it's rating
reviews.text: My husband and I don't normally spend as much as we did for our hotel stays in Vegas, but this visit was special because we were getting married. Upon arriving, there was no line, no waiting. We were greeted by the front desk attendants with professionalism and courtesy. They congratulated us and gave us complementary champagne, chocolates, and asked us how they could help. We walked up to our lovely room that had such a beautiful view of the strip. It was really clean. We especially liked the crisp white linens that were extra soft (no stains or foul smell whatsoever). The bathroom had a shower, a tub, and the toilet was in a separate room inside the bathroom with it's own door so that the smells would be trapped in there and also the user had privacy. Everything was clean and we loved how the hotel used l'occitane en provence soaps, shampoos, and lotions. The conditioner and shampoo made my hair extras soft and supple. They are imported from France and are a really high grade quality. Everyone from the door attendants, to the parking valet, the bell hop, the maids, and the front desk attendants were extremely helpful and courteous. They really did all that was in their power to make our stay super comfortable and pleasant. We extended our check out time to 2pm and was able to use the pool prior to leaving which was excellent. The pool side attendants were also really wonderful. They provided fresh towels, cold water, and put up an umbrella by our lounge chairs. We loved using the athletic work out room, the treadmills, stair climbers, and weights. In short, we really loved our stay, and though expensive, it was worth every penny. Thank you Four Seasons Hotel Las Vegas. We will forever have you in our hearts and remember you fondly as we reminisce about our Vegas wedding.

reviews.title: Pet area!
reviews.text: My wife and I love this hotel second time we stayed here but this time two major disappointments. if you bring your dog you will be frustrated for there is nowhere to walk your pet they have a small I would say 10‘ x 4‘ artificial patch of grass in the driveway at the hotel where cars enter the front entrance you must keep your dog on a leash !not only that ! our dog has white paws after she’s finished walking on the small patch of artificial grass Her pawsturn absolutely black! Second disappointment I would not recommend staying here first three weeks of July unless you are a NBA basketball fan! There were three NBA basketball team staying at the hotel with their managers and trainers the hotel elevator is always crowded everybody hangs out in the lobby and absolutely forget about using the fitness center it was packed all times of the day! That being said it really is probably the nicest hotel on the strip and we’ve stayed at many others over the years. The concierge‘s go above and beyond for you everyone is friendly and the pool area is absolutely awesome very quiet and relaxing!

reviews.title: Fabulous Customer Service and Serenity
reviews.text: Our family of four stayed at the Four Seasons during our first trip to Las Vegas. The overall feeling was serene and quiet - a contrast to the fast-paced vibe in the rest of the city! We enjoyed exploring the excitement outside the hotel and then returning to a peacful environment. Kathryne the concierge  secured restaurant reservations at a sold out venue while Tony at the pool took great care of us every afternoon. Dahan ensured that our breakfasts and dinner at the Veranda Restaurant were top notch and sent lovely chocolate covered strawberries to welcome us upon arrival. The room was immaculate and spacious with a gorgeous view of the valley. We enjoyed the soothing eucalyptus scent of the spa as well as the Peloton bikes in the fitness center. The location close to the two shows we attended was very convenient. Would highly recommend this hotel if you are looking for a respite amidst the hustle and bustle of LV!

reviews.title: Vegas, but quiet and relaxed
reviews.text: Ironically, this is both the best hotel in Vegas and the “worst” of all the Four Seasons properties — but that says more about Vegas than it does the hotel! We had a great time and really appreciated the quiet nature of this hotel, which is a segment of the Mandalay Bay building but largely separate from the buzz of the casino and crowded Vegas atmosphere. It was great to have access to both the small/private Four Seasons pool and the large Mandalay Beach. The rooms themselves were not as distinctive or luxurious as the typical Four Seasons, but the service was top-notch. Perfect for a quieter version of Vegas while still conveniently located on The Strip.

reviews.title: Best spot in Vegas if you want everything taken care of- service can’t be beat. I love it’s not fragrance heavy.
reviews.text: Best spot in Vegas if you want everything taken care of- service can’t be beat. I love it’s not fragrance heavy.

reviews.title: Four Seasons in name only
reviews.text: I've stayed at many Four Seasons properties around the world. I've finally found it. The worst Four Seasons in the entire chain.Let's start with the staff. They are smug, not service-oriented, and could care less about your well-being. They act like they have no competition on the strip, and your business is simply unimportant to them.Cost cutting is rampant at this property, from the slim pickings food choices (they closed the nice steakhouse and the room service menu is modest at best), generally slow service, to them appearing to add water to L'Occitane products in the spa (seriously check out the liquidy conditioner). The beds are mushy and soft (not sure if they are using the normal Four Seasons mattresses) and will absolutely cause back pain unless that's your vibe.And it was expensive. You can stay at Waldorf, Bellagio, or any other 5-star place on the strip for less than the Four Seasons.This property is Four Seasons in name only. Avoid at all costs.

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience, enjoyed the pool, restaurant, and access to the water park next door for the kids. The room was spacious with beautiful long views of the desert. Beds were clean and comfortable. Location was perfect. Looking forward to a return visit.

reviews.title: Best Fourth of July!
reviews.text: My new favorite hotel in Las Vegas! Took a family trip here for the Fourth of July, it was amazing! The hotel is immaculate! Understated elegance. Very “non-Vegas”! Booked a spacious one room king suite. It had 1.5 bathrooms, a wonderful convenience to have a half-bathroom! The pool service was extremely attentive- they gave my son “extra” amenities whenever he asked. The pool was lively but you could always find a place to sit. Loved the DJ on Saturday! If you want a larger pool with more activities you can go to Mandalay pool next door. The app makes service seamless. I would text a request and get a response in moments. Also was able to text to request times for housekeeping each day - very convenient! Food was delicious. We mainly ate breakfast and lunch at the hotel and went off property for dinner. Do the Sunday brunch! Worth the splurge! The concierge helped me plan activities for my son - all I had to say was I wanted things to do that would burn energy of an 11 year old boy!We will definitely return!

reviews.title: Step above the rest.
reviews.text: Wonderful trip. Staff is super courteous. I come to Las Vegas for a conference about every 6 months, and will always choose this hotel. It’s quiet, well appointed, and the private pool makes this feel like an oasis away from the strip. House car service is available after 5PM and the staff goes above and beyond.My wife (just found out she was pregnant) accompanied us on this trip, and they surprised us with strawberries (and an entire case of bottled water). Truly a step above the rest.

reviews.title: Classy exclusive hotel except for the location and neighbourhood
reviews.text: Classy exclusive hotelWe checked into this hotel after a long drive from Visalia. We were directed to use the Mandalay Bay premises for food. This was the worst recommendation and worst experience!  The presence of Mandalay Bay next tho this lovely exclusive hotel, sadly gives it away and brings down its standard! Having to go through the latter hotel has been a harrowing experience. Too bad that riffraffs from Mandalay Bay tend to make their way into this exclusive hotel robbing it of its exclusivity! The hotel is quite far away from all the hustle and bustle. As a result it is lacking in buzz and action. A pianist should have been in the lobby to serenade the clients. Upon our arrival the lobby was packed with kids and their parents which made the place a bit noisy and a bit like a circus. The swimming pool is chic and exclusive. Too bad that there’s an inevitable clientele spill over from the next door inferior hotel! The bedroom was super comfy, with an espresso machine in place. The mattress, pillows, beddings and sleep quality were excellentThe toiletries were top of the line! Top quality towels.We were forced to check out soon after a one night stay due to the proximity of the other hotel Mandalay Bay and presence of children, also having to depend on the latter for any other activity. It is also quite far away from all the activities

reviews.title: Oasis in a Sea of Glitz
reviews.text: The resort has the feel of an upscale boutique hotel. Attentive staff, great food and well appointed rooms. Juliet, our private yoga instructor was fantastic. Our pedicures were one of the best ever. Concierge arranged for great dining experiences off property. Truly an oasis, away from the craziness and flashiness of the Strip.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with service as expected from Four Sasons
reviews.text: Went here over Christmas 2018 with a group of 20 of us. From the moment we arrived to the minute we left, we were treated like royalty. The setting is at the end of the strip, and there is a separate entrance from the Mandalay Bay which is nice. It’s a quieter lobby, with a great little coffee bar (Press) where we had great drinks and apps. When we arrived we noticed that one of our suitcases was missing. Concierge was amazing and helped us retrieve it— not to mention another evening when someone in our party left a cell phone in a cab. This service would be unheard of in the other typical Vegas hotels.The rooms are located high up in the Mandalay. We had a three BR suite which was really nice, spacious and comfortable. Housekeeping was great, room service prompt, we were happy with the layout to the rooms. Food was very good. Prompt service, and a bit pricy but not unexpected. We will be back

reviews.title: Close enough to the action and secluded enough to have quiet time
reviews.text: We stayed for 3 nights at the Four Seasons. It is quieter than being in the middle of 24 hour action that is Las Vegas. The hotel is clean, comfortable, and the staff is super courteous. It is at one end of the strip so be prepared to walk a little if going to the busier parts of the strip. There is a free tram that will get you closer to the action on the strip and the LV monorail. Parking is expensive or you will have to park a walk away at the Mandalay Bay Convention center.

reviews.title: Excellent non-gaming hotel and quiet pool
reviews.text: I really love the pool at this hotel, as it's not usually too crowded or too loud, and most of the pool food is very good, like the ceviche and the ahi poke bowl.  The hummus wasn't very good, but I told the whole staff to change the recipe or take it off the menu.  I love the lobby at this hotel, too.  There are no casino games, and the luxurious cool and quiet atmosphere is rare for Vegas.  I will stay here every time I go to Vegas.  Excellent hotel.  I just wish they had a restaurant that was open for dinner 7 days a week.  I really don't enjoy going over to the madness and chaos of Mandalay Bay for dinner after a long day.

reviews.title: Fabulous Birthday Extravaganza
reviews.text: Every single detail was perfect for my birthday weekend at the Four Seasons Las Vegas!  The concierge worked magic in securing the hottest dinner reservations in town at Delilah’s! Spent the day by the relaxing pool with delicious drinks, food and service were phenomenal.  Day two started with a long steam sauna and wonderful deep tissue massage with Kelly!  Ending everyday in our 36th floor suite with a  spectacular view and luxurious most comfortable EPIC sheets & bed EVER! Five Star everything for the Four Seasons Las Vegas….we will be back soon!

reviews.title: The TOP pick for Vegas!
reviews.text: If you want to experience Las Vegas like you never have before here's my suggestion, The Four Seasons!  Truly a step (or 36) above the rest! Located a top the Mandalay Bay Hotel with a private entrance and pool just for starters!  You feel like you are on your own private island of luxury and service in the midst of a busy, crazy and people packed town!  You can leave and experience all that Vegas has to offer (even the Mandalay pools) but you can quickly get back to the quiet and calm of your own little resort!  The service on every level is something I haven't seen since the pandemic, attention to detail and making everyone feel like you are the only ones there!  Solange, at the Press bar in the evenings was so friendly that we feel like we have a new friend (along with Carol and Z at the pool and Dan overseeing it all)!  Honestly they are doing it right!!  Money well spent!

reviews.title: Knock your socks off service
reviews.text: Four Seasons Vegas Brought the family including 2 grandkids 4&7 to Vegas and stayed in the Four Seasons for four nights. Before we arrived the concierge, Denise and Karen were extremely helpful in recommendations and putting our itinerary together. Everything worked out perfectly. Karen , helped me find a Spider-Man impersonator for the grandkids birthday celebration. What a hit that was. Great restaurants and activities. We and the kids had a blast. Upon arrival David the guest experience manager greeted us and gave us a brief tour and showed us to our room, giving the kids these huge cookies. What a welcome. Austin the front desk manager was so helpful with check in. Stephanie the pool manager assured our stay in the cabana was terrific. Ahmed the GM came to meet the family during lunch making sure everything was terrific. I’ve stayed at the Four Seasons all over the world. The Vegas one is tops for service.

reviews.title: Awesome Experience
reviews.text: This was the second trip we made to the Vegas Four Seasons.  We actually started this trip at another hotel, and quickly realized it was not what we were looking for.  We made a quick decision to change plans and head to the Seasons, and it was the right call.  The staff are awesome, from the front desk to the pool deck.  Everything is clean and elite feeling.  The rooms are great.  This was the second time we happened to be in Vegas for a birthday celebration, and the staff put a bunch of nice goodies in the room without being asked for it.  Overall, just a great place.

reviews.title: Nice Respite, Great Staff, Quiet by Vegas Standings
reviews.text: Spent two nights in Las Vegas before moving on to Utah parks.  We have stayed at numerous Four Seasons in many countries and have always had a great time.  Service started long before arrival with my numerous queries to concierge regarding restaurant recommendations, as well as with help arranging tourist activities.  On arrival check in was fast front desk was friendly and efficient.  We were upgraded from a standard room to a 2 room suite on 38th floor with a strip view, likely at our travel agents request. What a great room, with a magnificent view.  Room was clean and well kept.  We liked  that this is a non gambling hotel, keeps down noise and keeps out the riffraff, fine by us as we do not gamble. Beautiful pool grounds not crowded always found a seat in the afternoon. Easy to order drinks and lunch poolside.  Very easy to get car and due to location easy to get out of town.   As always an amazing Four Seasons experience

reviews.title: Staff/Service is why its the best
reviews.text: The staff was excellent and made my stay memorable and enjoyable.  Nice and easy to get in and out of the hotel and not busy and bustling like other.  If they have any more Hawaiian people there, they are coming for the 9th island title.  Felt comfortable having staff from Hawaii coming from Hawaii.

reviews.title: Best place to stay when on vacay in Vegas!
reviews.text: The service is amazing. Love that it’s not crowded with a ton of intoxicated people. Everyone is very polite and helpful. The pool deck and their services are amazing. No wait to get seated at the pool. Four Seasons customer service is second to none!

reviews.title: Extremely poor customer service
reviews.text: Very poor booking experience. Derek from reservations refused passing my request to their manager. I perceived his behaviour very passive aggressive. You would expect some flexibility from the 5-star property. If You want your booking process seamless, don’t stay there. I can’t believe what I have experienced. Extremely low level of customer focus. It appears that the hotel doesn’t care about customer experience whatsoever. Shame on you!

reviews.title: Marvellous oasis of calm in a mad city!
reviews.text: Loved our stay in the Four Seasons Las Vegas. My first trip to the city do I was very grateful for somewhere away from casinos!! The staff are absolutely marvellous and the room / suite was beautiful  I totally recommend this fabulous hotel

reviews.title: No 5star standard
reviews.text: First, as this was mentioned several times here: FS LV is no hidden oasis. It is next to and connected with Mandaly, a cheap casino hotel. Their pool area is just next door.Service Standard at FS is at the lowest. Check in took us 20 minutes and on our leave we were queuing for check out because nobody provided us with the bill beforehands as it is usual in 5star Hotels. The bill we were then provided with contained drinks from the minibar we did not consume. As we booked with Amex platinum we should have been granted a room upgrade. The receptionist was very hesitant to give us one and tried to talk us out of it. Left us feeling awkward about the upgrade we finally got.Breakfast at Veranda was horror. They keep you waiting for a table for 15 minutes although several tables were available. When addressing this the girl at the reception reacted very arrogant and unprofessional. Then they recommended making a reservation for the next day - and did not pick up the phone when we tried to call. The food manager is very friendly and professional and tried everything to make things good.

reviews.title: My UFC Weekend
reviews.text: I just wanted to take a moment and express my family's amazing experience at the Four Seasons this weekend. The staff was so friendly and their service was second to none. We were treated so well and felt like royalty. It's so comforting to know that customer service is still alive at The Four Seasons. As a business owner, we share the same philosophy when it comes to treating our clients well and our customers thank us for it too. Here are the people I would like to recognize and who made our trip memorable. Julie in reservations was attentive in welcoming us to the hotel.I believe his name was Jason at the front desk when we checked in. He checked us in quickly, gave us waters and my daughters some treats. Just what we needed after a flying in.Ivan Cazares-assisted us with reserving the cabana. Noah-Our cabana attendants service was amazing. He made sure we were well stocked and checked in with us like clock work.Room severs were amazing and took time to set up the table in our rom so we could eat together. Beds were so comfortable and the views from that room is amazing.Finally, Mika and her team in valet went above and beyond as our rental car broke down in your parking garage. The attention I was given to get me to my UFC event on Saturday was incredible and unexpected. Mika called the rental car company and completely handled the situation for us. Let me tell you the rental car company was not easy to deal with either. I will not be using their service again. I really appreciated that level of commitment and service your valet department offered which is unmatched in your industry. Again, I just want to thank you for this memorable trip and we will be definitely staying with you again.  I don't usually take the time to post reviews on travel sites, but if it would help you I am willing to do so. Let me know which one you prefer.Jim Murray

reviews.title: Another nice time in Las Vegas!
reviews.text: It was a very nice trip, overall. My mom and I went for Mother’s Day weekend and the hotel is in lovely condition, with magnificent strip view guestrooms. We had a few challenges, but mostly positives: Challenges: 1.	I had sent 2 snail mail letters to the hotel with special requests a month in advanced and was informed that they were never received and the special requests were not noted on our reservation. 2.	It was Mother’s Day and I had requested and paid for a margarita to be sent to my mom at check-in. My mom did not receive one nor was she greeted at check-in.3.	Again, I had requested this upon our return from dinner, which again was not received. Onto the positives:1.	We were allowed to check-in at 1PM and were granted a 3PM late check-out. 2.	Yaritizi at the Front Desk quickly realized none of my special requests or check-in time had been noted, so she offered me an upgrade to a suite at a very reasonable price. This was very kind of her.3.	Karen R. (concierge) was absolutely fabulous. She is very good at her role, doting, and truly cares about her guests. She spent virtually the entire first afternoon catering to my needs. 4.	Ronson (Front Desk) was great to see again from a previous trip. He was very friendly and made our day. 5.	Richard Park at the Spa was so kind and attentive to my needs on my first day. 6.	Myra (Front Office) kindly set-up a nice final day for my mom as a service recovery from our poor first day. 7.	Patricia (concierge) helped us out so much with dining reservations, even getting us last minute dinner reservations at the Eiffel Tower Restaurant! My mom was blown away!8.	Alexandra Fitzhugh honored a 3pm late check-out for us. This really helped us enjoy our final day.9.	Last, but not least, Stephanie Bartizal offered us a pool cabana and a cocktail on our last day at the pool. She was wonderful and your hotel should feel lucky she moved from Maui to work with you all. Thank you for the lovely stay!

reviews.title: Another great stay!
reviews.text: This was our family’s 3rd visit here and it has gotten better every year! The staff at Four Seasons always makes the stay wonderful. They are all so kind and pleasant. The app made it easy to communicate with any of our needs. At other hotels, you have to pay extra for a butler service but at Four Seasons it’s just who they are! We loved Edgar and Zlata at the pool. They made our time at the pool easy and relaxing; always refilling our water and giving us fresh towels. The food at the pool was very good. Lastly, Gamani the bellman, was fantastic! My daughter lost her Four Seasons bear and he ran upstairs to grab us a new one as we were checking out. He was so kind and sweet! Great way to end our stay. Thank you Four Seasons.

reviews.title: Highest quality service
reviews.text: The management  and staff have created a culture of super service.  From cleanliness, to friendly and welcoming atmosphere we were super satisfied with this visit.  We will be back again very soon.  Highest ratings!!!

reviews.title: Perfect in every way.
reviews.text: From start to finish this was one of the best hotels we ever stayed at. Check in was so friendly, the room with the requests was ready and so nice. The strip view suite was fantastic, we loved every minute of the view. The room was kept spotless by housekeeping everyday. If there’s one thing to it’s the possibility to charge your devices by the bed, no outlets on the nightstand. Pool was lovely so was the service, water by the sun beds was always delivered with a smile. When we go back to Las Vegas we’ll be back at the Four Seasons!

reviews.title: Great Experience!!!
reviews.text: Hotel cleanliness, great service from ALL staff was so well worth it!! If a once in a lifetime trip to a high end hotel is on your list, you can’t go wrong with The Four Seasons. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.title: Divine
reviews.text: I just got back from the Four Seasons Vegas about a week ago. I had a blast in Vegas. However, my vacation exceeded my expectations because I stayed at the Four Seasons Vegas. First, I was picked up in a limo from the airport. I just ordered a car service from the concierge desk and a beautiful limo picked me up. Everyday, I would visit the LV strip but I had the pleasure of returning to my beautiful hotel with the beautiful lobby and clean room with 24 hour room service, excellent staff, amazing spa, (you must try to spa), amazing breakfast buffet, and amazing pool retreat area. (A very nice employee was dedicated to cleaning my sunglasses.) She was so nice. The water pressure in the shower was divine. I requested a pillow top mattress from the front desk. Then, I went to eat breakfast. When I returned to my room, the pillow top mattress was made up and done. There is more to add. However, I am just quickly say that you should think of the best of the best and there you have it. The Four Seasons Vegas comes to mind. I am literally planning my next trip back to the Four Seasons Vegas.

reviews.title: The Best Oasis in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We went to Las Vegas for a cheer competition my daughter and I was already dreading doing the Vegas experience with a young teenager.  The event was at the Mandalay Bay convention center and I was thrilled when I found the Four Seasons was so close.  I, of course, paid more for the location, but it was worth every penny.  From arrival to departure, you feel cared for.  The staff learned my name and said hello when they saw me.  It is nothing like the craziness of the other hotels.  There are short cuts directly into the Mandalay Bay.  The second we went into MB, we were reminded how nice it was to be in a serene, quiet hotel.  The rooms are outstanding.  Exquisitely appointed, extremely comfortable beds and wonderful bath products.  Coffee maker in the room, of course.  We had a wonderful view of the strip.  Had room service, which was served from a heated cart and the food was outstanding.  We ate on the patio outside Press several times and it was relaxing and wonderful service.  We went to the Bellagio, the Delano, and the Aria for a few dinners to get some other good dining in.  Each of those hotels made me glad to hop in an Uber back to the quiet, elegant service we had come to expect.  While the location is at the far end of the strip, I did not mind.  Will be staying there again soon,  I am sold.  It is the best way to do Vegas.  Go gamble, eat, and celebrate elsewhere when you want, but go back to the Four Seasons to relax and unwind.  You’ll be glad you did.

reviews.title: A peaceful sanctuary in the heart of Las Vegas
reviews.text: Vegas can get a bit overwhelming, that’s why you should rest your head at the Four seasons, courteous attentive staff and mandalay just a short hop and skip. It’s worth the trip. The breakfast is to die for. I recommend the espresso martini.

reviews.title: Four Seasons Las Vegas
reviews.text: First class property as usual.  Best part is the location at far end away from the Strip - which we preferred.  It's close enough to shows/restaurants but far enough to feel like an oasis.  Would definitely return.  Four Seasons is actually the top 5 floors of the Mandalay Bay which I wasn't expecting, but it was fine and they have a separate pool if you want sometime more sedate than what Mandalay Bay offers although you can use both, so something for everybody.

reviews.title: Exceptional service and comfort
reviews.text: This hotel has been described as an "oasis of calm" on the strip in multiple reviews, and it is easy to see why. It is cleverly situated within the Mandalay Bay complex and offers exceptional tranquility and service level while providing easy access to the typical casino resort offerings of Mandalay Bay. I cannot say enough about the professionalism of the staff...they were wonderfully kind, helpful, and accommodating while respecting the privacy of guests and remaining unobtrusive. Housekeeping was outstanding, the bed was wonderfully comfortable, and the bath products were amazing and replenished daily. The room is also equipped with a Keurig, which is unheard of in other Las Vegas Resorts. This just one example of how FS excels in hospitality service...by making guests feel valued and providing the "extra" needed for an outstanding guest experience. Well done all around.

reviews.title: Definitely worth the extra cost for the calm
reviews.text: We had concerns that due to the location ( south of strip) we would not have the full LV experience but this was probably the stand out benefit.Incredible staff from front desk, concierge, pool staff and restaurant servers. We could not have had such a wonderful 3 night stay to coincide with a ‘big birthday’We will definitely return.

reviews.title: Wonderful, relaxing stay
reviews.text: We stayed at FS Vegas for 3 nights over a weekend, in town for a couple of concerts at Allegiant. The staff were wonderful, especially the pool staff who were very chill and friendly, but also checked in on us frequently.The hotel is within 15-min walk to Allegiant, so extremely convenient. There are connecting doors to Mandalay and you cut through the casino floor to reach the street/bridge over to the stadium.We picked FS after reading reviews that spoke highly of the staff/service and also wanted a hotel that was secluded from all the usual Vegas activity. We definitely weren’t disappointed and look forward to returning when we’re in town again.

reviews.title: Best hotel stay ever
reviews.text: This was my first stay in a Four Seasons hotel, and based on this experience, it certainly will not be the last. The facilities, decor, and service are 2nd to none. The staff in particular make this hotel, they are, in word, exemplary.

reviews.title: Spectacular hotel
reviews.text: This Four Seasons has consistently remained elegant and updated. We were here for the weekend back in November for a Raiders game at Allegiant Stadium. This is such a convenient location to walk over to the stadium. Everything at the hotel was great. I do understand that it is very difficult to hire good staff these days. But I do think a majority of their staff is well trained. We love Las Vegas and will surely be coming back to stay at FS Las Vegas.

reviews.title: MOST RELAXING EXPERIENCE OF MY LIFE!
reviews.text: If you are looking for an actual 5 star hotel this is it. I have severe asthma & anxiety around people and wanted a quiet resting place for my stay in Vegas.  This Hotel is by far the most Luxurious Hotel I have stayed in and that is including Aspen, Colorado. 1,000,000x's worth the Price. Let me start with Leslie! That girl was Magnificent. She was in reservations and helped me figure out where I would stay, what type of room, and every detail I asked she sent me an email with our conversation so that I could review what I was booking. She gave me a recommendation as I was not the party going type for their Spa. She recommended Robert and it was SPOT ON! The STAFF let me tell you is WONDERFUL! They are kind, courteous, and blew my Customer Service Mind! There is true value in employment there.  (No I am not paid for this review, but the kindness shown to me and level of care had me crying tears of relief knowing they were there for me 200%.)Bell Hops were fantastic and opened every door & welcomed me back & brought my stuff up to my room immediately, called taxi's and smiled. The Concierge manager herself quite literally walked me to my room to help pitch my Service Animals tent & then walked me to Mandalay Bay and brought me an umbrella to borrow when I told her it was really hot outside and I forgot mine and she and her staff drew me maps a couple of times when I got lost. The Staff absolutely did EVERYTHING they could to make me feel Safe, Anxiety free, and well informed.  I probably walked up to their front desk and concierge no less than 10 times because I was traveling alone and I forgot most of the things they told me and not once did anyone give me a bad attitude or "starbucks" me when I said the wrong thing. The Spa staff were so sweet & Robert who did my massage was the best massage therapist I have ever had. He had charisma and a great understand and passion for his work. He immediately understand the pain I had in my back and my muscle spasms and delicately avoided those areas whilst working out the tense muscles 100%.  100 minutes of Salt Rock MASSAGE BLISS! As an added note: Jennifer one of their on-call massage specialist cleared her schedule upon my request to have someone work on my service animal the second day. It was not a normal ask and her team allowed it which I am forever grateful for. 20 minute massage for my Service Animal Grell whom had taken a small tumble outside on the concrete while we were out and about on the strip. She & Robert were true gems and I felt so calm and taken care of.  I was here for my BTS concert and the Chef  made me a complimentary Dessert complete with hand shaped chocolate disk and music notes & an edible frame of the concert logo with a little LED Backlit and a red candied Treble Cleff. I brought my service animal and they had bowls, a bed, and a few hand made softbaked daily treats for him complete with a dog menu when I called down to Room service.  I have food allergies and the breakfast staff & chef went and got me fruits I wouldn't alert to when preparing my parfait. The Housekeeping staff cleaned the room and added an air purifier for me upon request and & changed the sheets & pillows to down alternative. As I have asthma Housekeeping made sure I had fresh sheets daily just in case dust settled on them. I was provided a Noon Checkout time and I swear to you I slept better than my own home. All in all I had the best experience of my life and I was there for 2 days. I Highly recommend this establishment and I will be returning for almost every Vegas trip. TLDR = THE TEA = GO HERE YOU WONT BE SORRY

reviews.title: Serenity In The Madness
reviews.text: I recently returned to the Four Seasons after many years. It was just as plush, relaxing, tranquil and classy as I remembered. I have stayed in many Vegas hotels and all of the best ones - The Four Seasons is still up there with the best of them, if not thee best. The service is first class from the moment you check in. It never feels busy, everyone is pleasant and you need to remind yourself you are on the strip at times.From my perspective it's the ideal way to enjoy Vegas - In a first class establishment with an excellent pool in a tranquil setting where you can dip in and out of the mayhem should you desire.Because it's a smaller form factor you are better catered for - The bar staff, pool staff, reception staff, coffee shop staff and cleaners all knew us by name and that personal touch makes you feel special and properly looked after.It's not cheap and neither it should be - But you are paying for a 5 star experience and that's what you get - At every juncture.

reviews.title: Not the Best Four Season Property
reviews.text: Great room service food quality and service. Quiet rooms. Room decor is odd not elegant. I choose Four Seasons for elegance and service. Front desk is the weakest link. Unfortunately we count on front desk more than anyone.

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: I went April 2022 for spring break ..we were family of 4 .My daughter loved the hotel .Excellent great service ..The room was perfectly clean and you can find whenever you need .You pay little bit more than average but you get great service ..Thank you so much for the enjoyable time that we had it ..

reviews.title: Perfect sanctuary
reviews.text: This hotel is the perfect retreat from the Las Vegas hustle and bustle. Smoke free, quiet, prefect rooms, pool and service all make for a little place of much needed clam and relaxation.Couldn’t recommend highly enough.

reviews.title: The perfect place to stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: A great break from the large lobbies, big crowds and casino craziness at other hotels. Troy is the best concierge… I almost gave up my prized dinner reservation at Delilah’s, but he told me it would be a mistake. So true! It was a great night, and the Four seasons was the perfect place to stay.

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: Always a great stay at the Four Seasons Las Vegas.  Pool experience is great.  Service is always very good.  Rooms are nice.  My only complaint would be that the lobby bar closes at 11PM and even when arriving before this, if they have already done last call, they wouldn't serve us drinks.  Not a huge deal or enough to dissuade us from staying in the future.  But would be nice if they served until midnight.  Overall though, our favorite place to stay in Vegas.

reviews.title: Quiet paradise in the midst of  Vegas
reviews.text: I can’t believe how amazing this property is. The moment we walked in after a long travel day, we were greeted with fresh, smoke-free air in a beautiful, calm setting.  The staff are incredible and look to assist with warmth and care.  Our room was a strip view on the 39th floor and we loved how clean it was, the housekeeping service twice a day, bottled waters and the welcome treat. I treated myself to a spa service and had the best spa experience of my life!  Joey (sp?) was spectacular and responded perfectly to my injury concerns. The eucalyptus steam room is a wonderful treat in the midst of the dry desert. Loved the service at the pool and spent several hours there each day. The fresh ice water, towel service, and frequent offers of food and drink service were second to none.  Guests are entitled to use the pool area at Mandalay Bay but the quiet private pool for the property was much more to my liking. We ate at the Veranda restaurant every day for breakfast. Saturday, they served an amazing buffet. I mean everything was fresh, hot, homemade and wonderful!  We laughed because we made the big mistake of eating one time at the Bellagio buffet and it was terrible.  No comparison - and I highly recommend this restaurant. I can’t think of one thing to complain about. This was a wonderful oasis in the midst of a city that is, frankly, too much for me. But this was a peaceful retreat and I would come back in a heartbeat!

reviews.title: Increase daily charge without notice
reviews.text: Four Seasons Las Vegas isn’t even providing Marriott level customer service.  They don’t listen to guest request, terrible room service selection and service, limited restaurant menu for very high prices.   On topOf that, they increased my daily rate 25% without my knowledge explaining they were full those nights and they increased the rate.  Even for existing guests.  With no ability to move out.  That should be illegal to increase stated rates at their whim.  Total rip off and the check out person acted like I am a poor person who should not stay at a Four Seasons.  I don’t want to say more about me, but I do stay at Four Seasons and Ritz level hotels exclusively.   They are degrading the image and reputation is all Four Seasons and should be renamed Marriott.

reviews.title: Two Nights in LV
reviews.text: We returned to the FS Las Vegas after a Covid delay of two years.  The staff and hotel were all wonderful, and they have done a magnificent job of navigating through these difficult times. Things are necessarily different, but at no time did we feel inconvenienced.  We felt welcome, comfortable and safe during our entire visit.

reviews.title: Clean and smoke free
reviews.text: Clean and smoke free. Pleasant experience for both of us while we were there. Close to the volleyball tournament and other restaurants. Four seasons pool was closed but the other resort pool was open.

reviews.title: Nice hotel off the strip
reviews.text: Even though it’s Four Seasons, l liked the fact that it felt more like a boutique hotel with friendly service, they implemented a fairly strict health protocol during the pandemic so that it is enough to provide a sense of security and comfort for all guests.

reviews.title: Highly Recommend!
reviews.text: The Four Seasons is a luxurious tranquil place in the heart of the chaotic Strip. Entering a hotel without winding your way through a casino is such a joy. The room was impeccably maintained and service was timely, caring and attentive as you would anticipate from a Four Seasons property. We dined in room and were really pleased with the quality as well. Although we prefer to avoid the casinos, the Mandalay is easily accessible. Given the cold weather, and that our stay was short, we didn’t experience the pool or spa, but I’d expect these amenities to be excellent as well.

reviews.title: First Class Service!
reviews.text: I booked this trip for my parents - they were impressed with the beautiful property, exceptional service (from everyone - front desk, concierge, housekeeping, food service / restaurant) and personal touches that made them feel like royalty for a few days!

reviews.title: Excellent across the board
reviews.text: Going to keep it short and sweet - everything is excellent at this property across the board. Staff genuinely wants to help you and enhance your stay. Pool area is relaxing and mellow with excellent drinks. Veranda breakfast buffet is solid with many unique offerings. You get access to spa locker rooms with resort fee so waking up relaxing in the steam room is a great way to start the day.I don't review often but feel this property deserves as much recognition as possible. The only thing I wish they had was a dry sauna - everything else its perfect.

reviews.title: Loved it! Totally chill. Great service.
reviews.text: Pros:1. Close to the airport. 2. Nonsmoking hotel. 3. No casino hotel.4. You can access the Mandalay Bay casino easily. 5. Nice pool area. As someone mentioned, "a lovely, quiet oasis from the hustle and bustle and noise of the strip."Cons:1. I wish they had a few more toiletries in the bathroom such as mouthwash, hand cream, toothpaste. Tip:1. They have a happy hour from 4pm to 6pm I think. You have to scan the menu carefully to see it. Draft beer only $8. Some pretty good appetizers like yam fries and curry cauliflower.

reviews.title: Very nice hotel in  Mandeley Bay.
reviews.text: It’s a very nice hotel in the massive Mandeley Bay Complex. It’s kinda of hidden in there. Very nice modernish type hotel, it’s on the very end of the strip by the airport next to the Pyramid.  The room was good size, had those electric shades in the windows, very comfortable bed, linens, good water pressure, towels were soft and fluffy, toiletries were all first rate, staff was polite and courteous and available when needed. (rare find) It’s a great quiet hidden hotel.

reviews.title: Wonderful oasis on the strip
reviews.text: Lovely and quiet.  This was a fabulous stay for our family, 4 rooms, during the Christmas holiday 2021.  Food at Ventana each morning for breakfast was much anticipated.  Great menu, food and staff.   Bar staff were very accommodating and made sure they had our favorite whisky on hand the next evening.  Attention to detail, Santa's visit on Christmas morning in the lobby with fresh mini donuts being cooked & served, too!  We liked being away from the crowded and noisy casinos, yet it is so easy to step thru the connecting door to Mandalay Bay and access to the tram to more central parts of the strip.  Valet staff were terrific.  Surprised to find most all the casinos charge for parking, so it might be easier and cheaper to use Uber.Dog friendly hotel, as is more the norm these days.  We were surprised people let their dogs sit on the lobby/bar area furniture.  I love dogs, but would never let my pet sit on someone else's furniture.This is the place to stay.

reviews.title: First Rate
reviews.text: Four Seasons in Las Vegas is amazing!  Great secluded spot from all the chaos at Mandalay Bay.  Service, room, everything is first rate.  Hotel is clean, calm and smoke and casino free.  Staff is very helpful and room was lovely.

reviews.title: not the same as before
reviews.text: pool closed -  no 24 room service - 40% occiupancy and feels like a dying hotelto bad - I used it several times over the years. They may close soon at the rate they are going- not the same try another hotel

reviews.title: Fabulous! Best hotel on the strip!
reviews.text: My husband and I had a wonderful time at the Four Seasons. We would especially like to thank Cheryllynn who made our experience so special. She went out of her way to check in on us, gave us great restaurant and activity recommendations and even sent a kind gift to our room! The hotel was an oasis of calm on the strip but with great access to everything you would need. I am also very conscious of cleanliness (especially in Vegas hotels) and our room was absolutely spotless - housekeeping was great. If you want a luxurious, personalised experience in Vegas, I highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Shockingly disappointed
reviews.text: This is not a hotel but the top 5 floors of the Mandalay.  There is no atmosphere, no destination restaurant, poor quality spa/gym, a pool within the pool area of the Mandalay, it's expensive.  It is described as being adjacent to the Mandalay but it is not.  If you stayed at the Mandalay on the floor beneath the Four Seasons it would be a fraction of the price.  Most of the amenities are at the Mandalay.   There was no atmosphere...very few people there.  We moved to the Wynn, which at 40% occupancy felt busy by comparison and had a great atmosphere.  We felt totally mislead.  A great pity as we stay regularly at some of the other amazing Four Seasons hotels....so this was not what we expected at all.

reviews.title: Average for a Four Seasons
reviews.text: We choose this hotel because of the chain and because according to the description it’s a not gambling hotel, we here are our impressions: 1. The hotel is located inside the Mandalay Bay so you are inside but apart from the casino at the same time2. Rooms and decor are pretty average and breakfast at the restaurant was average too3. You can access to the Monday which to me is really dated and tacky In general the overall experience was kinda average however personnel in general is respectful and well mannered

reviews.title: Don't use the Bidet!
reviews.text: The bidet wand had feces from previous guests all over it because housekeeping did not know they needed to clean it. One of the grossest experiences of my life. Other than that the hotel is nice and the staff is accommodating.

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: My first stay here want be my last from the time I checked in to the time I checked out they really took care of us food and drinks are a little high but the whole town is that way now with that said if you want to be served this is your place

reviews.title: An oasis amongst the chaos
reviews.text: As a non-gambler who was there for a Grand Canyon visit with my son, I was very pleasantly surprised by how much of an oasis the Four Seasons hotel was.  Great service from start to finish.  From the valet and front desk to housekeeping and pool staff, and concierge…Seamless.I have traveled for both business and pleasure amongst the comfort and luxury hotels for many years and have been endlessly wined and dined.  I am a tough audience. Four Seasons has it on lock.  Color me impressed.

reviews.title: Customer Service is an Art Form
reviews.text: The level of customer service is extraordinary.  The staff go above and beyond to meet and exceed any needs. However the rooms are in need of an update to compete with the modern and automated rooms in he newer facilities

reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: We stayed at the Four Seasons over New Years in a total of 4 nights and we can’t fault it. The service has been amazing - always with a smile, very efficient and they are happy to help you with anything. We felt truly taken care of and pampered. It feels like the people that work here really love and care about each other too and that makes it a transforming experience as a guest.My facial with Shelley at the spa was one of the best facials I have ever experienced, the Four Seasons signature facial, and it was calming and healing just being in her presence. And my skin looks radiant, smooth and plumped.We will come back!

reviews.title: Number One Place on the Strip
reviews.text: Four seasons is even better than pre Covid.   The service is impeccable.  Every person there is going out of their way to my time worth while and encourage me to come back.   The steakhouse is closed for now.  But everything else was spot on.  The bar /coffee pressers.  Was excellent

reviews.title: A luxurious hotel on the strip
reviews.text: As soon as I walked in this resort I fell in love. The room view was spot on gorgeous as we got a strip view. Beds were super comfy. Staff were super polite and made us feel truly at home. The resort made us a special desert we were surprised to when we entered our room. I really enjoyed our stay here. Can’t wait to come back soon. I highly recommend this place if you are in the Las Vegas area.

reviews.title: If you want to avoid gambling in your hotel, the place to be
reviews.text: If you want to avoid casinos in Las Vegas that’s the hotel you should go to, one of the few without gambling area.It is located on the strip and it has a connecting shuttle which saves time going to the main attractions on the strip. It is located in the top floors of the Mandalay hotel. Rooms, common areas will not disappoint four season enthusiasts.House keeping was phenomenal.Breakfast is served around the pool.On the negative side, some of the employees at the bar and the restaurant didn’t meet the quality service of other four seasons hotels.We were told one morning that there were no seats for us for breakfast because the restaurant is open to the public (not residing in the hotel). I had to complain and remind the hotel that we were staying in and should have priority.In summary an excellent hotel but not the best four seasons hotel we have been to.

reviews.title: It was a magical first visit to Las Vegas, with our first stay with the @fourseasons brand.
reviews.text: Pros+ The staff here is exceptional. Every person we encountered went above & beyond even for the simplest requests.+  We booked a Strip View studio room & were upgraded to a Strip View One Bedroom Suite, a spacious, well-appointed room for our stay.+ Great location on the #lasvegasstrip that is far enough away for a respite from the crowds.+  Fast, reliable WIFI.+ The @fourseasons app allowed for easy, prompt communication with staff.+ In-room @nespresso machine, comfortable robe & slippers.+ Delicious food from hotel restaurant Veranda.+ Daily housekeeping & turndown service. + Large gym with Peloton bikes, free weights along with a plethora of equipment.+ The bed was so comfortable, I truly did not want to get up & leave each morning.Cons- Pool was closed, could use the adjacent Mandalay Bay pool.- Daily $45 resort feeGreat hotel, already looking to book our 2022 stay.

reviews.title: Great stay as always
reviews.text: 3rd time back here and will always come back here, very accommodating as always and will book again as soon as possible. The entire staff is great and they will treat you like family as always. You will not be disappointed!

reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel - Best in Vegas.
reviews.text: Loved the experience from check-in to check-out despite COVID restrictions the Staff is 'the moment of service" and I'll be back. Nice to be in a resort absent the Vegas Hustle and have a quiet place to conduct business.  Too bad Charlie Palmer's is closed but the dining was still great.

reviews.title: 4 seasons hoping for a Covid shutdown
reviews.text: Las Vegas has a mask law for Covid 19. The 4 seasons has decided to do nothing to enforce it. This is not “woke” stuff. I was in Vdara and Aria and the AWS conference in Venetian the week prior and they were on the ball. Seems like 4 seasons is on a different path.

reviews.title: Oasis on The Strip
reviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

reviews.title: Nice, Clean and Quiet
reviews.text: We stayed in Four Seasons the day after Thanksgiving 2021. The hotel's atmosphere radiates a calm vibe, which is a treasure in Las Vegas. It was very clean and the staff were very polite and friendly. The room was very clean. We loved spending the evening in the garden by the fire. Note that it's hotel and not a resort, so it does not have a casino or multiple pools, which is a plus if you want to retreat from casino smokes and overcrowded pools into a beautiful and quiet corner in the evening. It is inside Mandalay Bay, so you can just walk indoors to a casino if you want that.Our only issue is the perks provided by the hotel to Amex Platinum customers which are very limited compared to other Vegas Luxury Hotels and Resorts. The $100 Experience Credit can only be used in Spa (and not dining etc.), the breakfast credit is not daily and can only be used starting the day after check-in, and the upgrade we got was very mild at best (if we got any). These limitations make the value of the stay a bit questionable.Overall it is a nice hotel to stay in the heart of Vegas if you want to relax a bit and if you do not care about the value much.

reviews.title: Fabulous stay at Four Seasons Vegas!
reviews.text: We stayed three nights with our three kids and it was a fantastic experience. The pools were still open, easy access to swimming/wave pool at Mandalay, but also could retreat to Four Seasons for quieter experience. Beds were SO comfortable, the buffet was spectacular (the mini donuts!!!), the drinks were delicious and it was simply an amazing stay. Vegas can be a bit crazy, but the Four Seasons provides this amazing oasis. Quiet, attentive luxury. We loved it.

reviews.title: Best place to stay!
reviews.text: I really like this hotel because it 1. Does not have a casino.  So you don’t need to walk through a smoky casino to get to your room.  2. It is attached to the Mandalay Bay so if you want a casino, you can have one. 3. The rooms are spacious with a large bathroom. 4. The service from entrance to exit is just outstanding!!

reviews.title: Not the Four Seasons we know and expect
reviews.text: It started at 6pm when they tried to tell me our room wasn't ready!  I try to be understanding but I still expect more from the Four Seasons!  I don't expect "average" from their staff and I don't feel I'm paying for "average".

reviews.title: Beyond expectations even during the pandemic !
reviews.text: I recently stayed four nights at this property and had the most relaxing and comforting stay in over two years .  All systems are go here like 24 hour room service and twice daily room attendant.  The room and property were pristine in cleanliness and hand sanitizers everywhere although more demure in their locations! The pool open and lovely including food and bar service . The nail bar open with many options for nails and toes ! Super clean and a bit pricey !! The steak house formerly Charlie Palmers is closed and not to reopen I believe but the Veranda has very nice options both indoors or out on the patio for all your meals .  They do close in between lunch and dinner and you need to check with them to confirm their opening hours . The ambiance and food is very good . The service was a tiny bit slow but all of Vegas is short staffed so not a problem !! Inside the elevators and hotel everyone wore their masks and all the guest were kind and respectful. Of course mask were removed for eating or drinking .  I think the tea service is closed at this moment ?? Room service was good hot and fresh and very timely even after midnight !! Their is coffee makers in the rooms and also a place in the lobby called Press that has excellent coffee !!! I was completely grateful for my stay and the many employees who took care of me !! Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Beautiful but everything is extra
reviews.text: The grounds are amazing and loved the access to the Mandalay pools!!  I just was so taken aback that everything is extra from the tube for the lazy river (after paying a $45 resort fee), the first two rows of chairs at the wave pool ($50+ per chair), parking $45/night.  And the way the bottles of water and snacks are laid out in the room without any prices, makes it seem like they are complimentary.  But come to find out that it's $7 for the little package of Oreo cookies.   At other resorts that I've stayed it, when you pay a premium for a room, you don't feel nickle and dimed,  But here I felt like any chance to charge extra, they do.

reviews.title: Tom W
reviews.text: What a quiet oasis on the Vegas Strip. Everyone was courteous and helpful making sure that we had what we needed. The bar staff made sure we were taken care of the Tommy at the restaurant bar was a joy to converse with. I highly recommend the Four Seasons Las Vegas

reviews.title: As good as I remember.
reviews.text: The brand speaks for itself. With a few minor issues at the pool on a exceptionally crowded day , you can expect to be well taken care of at the Four Seasons Las Vegas. It’s a lovely oasis that transports from the typical Vegas scene. It’s our second visit and looking forward to the next!

reviews.title: Best Hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: The Best Hotel  in Las Vegas. The extra cost does not equal the quality of service ,food .and property    Everyone was so friendly  and willing to do whatever needed with a smile Front desk.  Janel.   Pool wait staff.  Z was a friend after 4 days Pool chair    The head  attendant remembered everyday Spa.  Felicia was greatBreakfast Sunday buffet brunch $35. This is a unbelievable value. Omelet and mini doughnut station The Four seasons is a quiet spot away from the craziness but close enough when you want that side of Vegas My compliments to the management on bringing back service with a smile

reviews.title: Just what we wanted after days of hiking! A bit of pampering.
reviews.text: We expected wonderful service and a lovely stay, and that's what we got! We ended a family trip to a bunch of national parks at the Four Seasons Las Vegas and it was perfect.  Relaxing and comfortable! It was nice for us and the kids to be able to use both the Four Seasons guests-only pool as well as the main pool complex of the Mandalay Bay.  The app was also really helpful for any questions or requests.

reviews.title: So Civilized
reviews.text: We have stayed at nearly all the high end properties on the strip and like this best. They all have good beds and bedding but at the Four Seasons the pool is relaxed while others are crazy. Most importantly, you can have a leisurely breakfast without the noise of the machines in the casino. The housekeeping is outstanding and it really feels clean, something of increasing importance during covid. Their adherence to protocols with all staff wearing masks and the ability to eat meals outdoors was reassuring. We had a wonderful stay and will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Love this hotel- the view, the service, the comfy bed!
reviews.text: Wonderful experience at the Four Seasons Las Vegas. I have no idea what these other negative reviews are about. We came for a conference and have stayed at this Four Seasons as well as others across the country. Yes, it is the top floors of the Mandalay Bay so it will not be exactly like the other Four Seasons across the country but this is Vegas for gosh sakes. From check in where I had trouble with the app on my phone and TWO front desk employees spent 10 minutes helping me, to the room service which we got each day and was incredible, to the room with the best strip view of anywhere I have stayed, to valet who texted on their own phones to find me a taxi, to the bell service in which three employees helped to load our luggage in the taxi for our last minute trip to the airport! We had a first class experience from beginning to end and I highly recommend this hotel if you don’t want to smell like smoke constantly due to walking through casinos. The most comfortable beds, pillows, sheets and comforters, towels, robes- I love the four seasons and will always stay at this brand!

reviews.title: Five Stars No More
reviews.text: This is perhaps the worst representative of the Four Seasons chain. Looks like they haven't spent any money or efforts to maintain its physical appearance in the first floor areas. The heat and air conditioning systems in the rooms are extremely noisy and fail to keep the room warm. Tough to sleep with the noise. The massage therapist ignores where you request working on needed areas. Service in their one and only restaurant is abominable. They lack front desk personnel so calls are ignored and not answered and check-in waits seem forever. Touching any item in the refrigerator triggers an automatic charge even if you don't actually remove anything. This hotel cannot match my recent positive experience at the Encore. This is a 3 star hotel at best.

reviews.title: Is this really a Four Seasons?
reviews.text: Is this a real 4 seasons? If you are lucky enough  to stay at a 4  seasons you know they are classy,  discrete, impecable rooms and service. This one may be a fake? Let's start with room. Single beds. See picture (i did not believe it), never seen single beds at four seasons). OK so then you go down for dinner. There is no restaurant inside hotel. Eat at bar. No placemats. Next to garbage bins. See picture. Three entre total option. See pic. Want to eat somewhere else go find something inside Neighboring hotel. We can't be bothered. (Mandalay Bay next door overwhelmed  by conventionares. Back to dinner at bar. Maybe placemats at 4 seasons would be nice? (Asking for a friend...)  see pic.  On the plus side. Hotel quiet. No casino to walk through. Rigatoni very good. Drinks good. Bartender knows what he is doing. My sense is they grafted a few floors of Mandalay Bay Hotel on and called it a " four seasons"  this hotel and its general manager really hurts the brand.

reviews.title: Not run like a Four Seasons
reviews.text: Chose to stay here as I was presenting at a conference at another hotel and wanted a quiet COVID safe hotel.Restaurants were closed and or used for private parties. Had to eat outside at their lounge. Service was terrible and 6 guests sat and smoked cigars in the outside restaurant. Had to leave and eat in my room. So much for this being a non smoking hotel. Although masks are required inside many guests did not wear them and hotel staff did not enforce the rules. This hotel is not run like other Four Seasons.

reviews.title: Always Good
reviews.text: Have stayed at the Four Seasons several times and as always the beds are the most comfortable of any chain, the rooms are clean and well maintained.Only issue is we had issues with the shower and hot water.

reviews.title: Overall excellent experience.
reviews.text: The hotel and room were very well kept up and modern.  The staff at the hotel, the restaurant and lounge were all very helpful and friendly the food at the restaurant, lounge and meetings were very good.  The walking distance from the lobby to the guest elevators were a little long.  This was a nice diversion from the noisy over-crowded casino hotels.

reviews.title: Wonderful experience!
reviews.text: This was our first time at a Four Seasons and we loved every minute.  The staff greet and assist you as soon as you step out of your car.  Check in was easy.  Our room was made ready very quickly even though we arrived several hours before check-in.  Communication was convenient (chat option) and responsive prior and during our stay.  The hotel was a wonderful quiet oasis after the loud and crowded Strip and casinos.  We stayed in the Studio with Strip View.  It was huge!  We had our own walk in closet for two, the bathroom includes separate shower/bath, the bed was comfortable, there are black out curtains and even a sound machine was provided.  We didn't hear a peep from others during our stay.  Lovely!  The pool was great - relatively small, but also not crowded.  We had lunch poolside and that turned out to be a better option economically then most of the other nearby restaurants plus it was delicious - try the nachos!   Service was fantastic.  I had a mani/pedi at the spa.  Yes, more expensive than other 'nail places' in strip malls, but the quality and sanitation was at a much higher level. If you're looking for a party atmosphere, this is probably not the hotel for you, but if you're looking for a romantic or quiet family getaway, I can't recommend this hotel enough!

reviews.title: Wonderful Refuge on Strip
reviews.text: This place is truly the best on the Strip. Unlike other “luxury” Vegas hotels, this Four Seasons has never treated us like a number. The restaurants are a little dated, but the food and service are impeccable. Rooms are lovely and thoughtful. And if you need to host an event, Megan Early and team can help you plan an unforgettable experience! If gambling is down your alley, it is a short walk to Mandalay Bay which has tables of nearly all limits. Pool is quaint and quiet. Very relaxing.

reviews.title: Most relaxing hotel in Vegas!
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed at the Four Seasons Hotel Las Vegas for one night in February 2021 on our way to Amangiri and were so glad we added it to our itinerary.Despite the fact that this is a Vegas hotel where rooms counts of flagship properties are typically in the thousands, the Four Seasons has around 400 rooms and more personalized service than I have seen elsewhere on The Strip. We received a warm welcome, excellent service at the spa and gym and especially wanted to highlight Marama at the Concierge desk who was instrumental in coordinating transportation from the airport and to rural Utah around our stay.I regret not taking photos on this stop as the facilities were excellent -- particularly the large gym by the pool, our room with floor-to-ceiling windows and the lobby areas. Everything was sparkling clean, smoke-free, relatively quiet and the reception from staff was warm and energizing.The room itself was representative of many Four Seasons rooms though definitely had some Vegas aesthetics sprinkled throughout. You'll find plenty of space, great views (the hotel rooms start on the 35th floor of the Mandalay Bay), a large soaking tub in the bathroom and a giant television and oversized desk to work from.The food was also excellent. We did in-room dining for dinner and breakfast at Veranda. Both meals were delicious, and brought quickly with great service.The proximity to all of Vegas nightlife with a lower room count, amazing spa, and smoke- and casino-free ambience makes this a great option for anyone wanting to have an active Vegas visit without any of the drawbacks of Sin City. I am excited to stay for longer on our next trip to Vegas!

reviews.title: The Best Kept Secret Oasis in Vegas
reviews.text: I really don’t know where to start!  So much goodness here!  Firstly the staff…A++++ from Daniel Gomez the front desk manager to all the Food and Beverage managers.  The GM Ilsa Harley is terrific and orchestrates a truly beautiful experience. We have been here twice this year and have 2 more stays planned before year end.  Every time we come we are treated with such warmth and hospitality that I usually ask my husband if we can stay another day!  The Veranda food is beautiful and I highly recommend the meatballs on the lunch menu.  We ate dinner several times at the Bar and the steak is terrific!  What we love is that we get the fun of Vegas but when we are done we get to escape to this magical retreat tucked away that is an island of its own with no gambling and no cigarette smoke.  And it you want to gamble you just take the elevator down to the Mandalay Bay casino.
