The pool is really lovely and they keep you well hydrated in the heat of Vegas with ice water and also come around occasionally with little sweet treats.  Also the gym is REALLY nice.  It’s all just amazing.  I wish they had Residences!

reviews.title: Everything we expected and more
reviews.text: Everything that we thought it would be and more.Loved being in a non-casino hotel. Felt very private and safe. Couldn’t have asked for better staff and instantly felt like we were part of a family.Nothing was too much trouble and even a small issue with a strange smell in our bathroom was dealt with efficiently and more importantly very quickly.One night we couldn’t get an Uber to a show and instantly they arranged for the hotel car to take us. The valets were particularly helpful.Rooms were very comfortable and welcoming with great coffee.The pool was very tranquil and staff very attentive.Will definitely be back in our next trip. Thank you for a great stay.

reviews.title: Good stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Good hotel located on the top floors of Mandalay Bay on the strip. Large rooms well furnished. But who sleeps in Vegas. Loved the stay. But the staff at the front desk and concierge didnt match the four seasons standards. Not beyond expectations

reviews.title: Anniversary at four seasons
reviews.text: We spent four nights at the Las Vegas four seasons, overall had pleasant and relaxing time, this is one of the few hotels on the strip without onsite casino if you are not interested in gambling. Very friendly staff, great service, breakfast, and lunch options but limited dinner options onsite.

reviews.title: First class hotel and staff in Las Vegas
reviews.text: I would definitely recommend the Four Seasons Las Vegas. It is on the upper floors of Mandalay Bay and has it’s own separate entrance. The entrance is beautiful, the lobby is elegant  and the hotel is a great option for those that are not really into gambling (although you can easy go to the casino at Mandalay Bay). The staff is outstanding. Reception helped us get into our room a little early, after along flight, concierge got us dinner reservations for the same night, and the bell woman got us ice and was so helpful and friendly. You can go to the Four Seasons pool which was quiet or you can go to the Mandalay Bay pools. There are several pools including a wave pool and lazy river. Just be aware that if you want two chairs and an umbrella for shade, it’s expensive ($150). You can find some chairs in the shade (free) near the lazy river. Recommend a room with a view of the Strip, which is quite a site at night. This was a great option for a stopover on our way to Zion and Bryce in Utah.

reviews.title: Everything you wish - and more!
reviews.text: The Four Seasons in Las Vegas was great. Unbelievably good service. Great views, great service, great food, and good drinks! The only thing I didn't like was the club on the roof top. There was club music unti 2am on weekends. However, it's Vegas and each room has a white-noise machine. It was definitely not too bad and the Four Seasons still deserves an excellent rating!

reviews.title: Best Quality Vacation
reviews.text: The reservation staff was excellent, and she made me feel excited even before I arrived at the hotel.  The weekend valet parking crew was extra courteous and very thoughtful.  The driver filled ice cold water in the car when we took our car out for dinner.  This was extra nice especially in a hot dry climate like Las Vegas.  The doorman greeted us by our names and was very kind holding the doors for us. The Assistant Manager, Tianna Loyer, is a master of her craft and should be training every Four Seasons Managers about “how to address customer concerns and give the best customer service that will last through generations.”I had experienced an unfortunate event the previous night and notified the front desk about it. When I got a call back from the Assistant manager, Tianna, I thought I had to explain the whole situation again which I hate to do. No, Tianna, the Amazing Assistant Manager, smartly summarized the incident so I didn’t have to.  The truth is when you repeat the worst experience out loud, you go through the same experience over again which makes you more upset than before.  She eliminated the unnecessary added stress. Finally, despite of the horrible experience on the first night, my family was finally able to relax even if it was just for one night.  One night we will never forget for the rest of our lives.  Tianna’s best customer service also extended to my son which he had already shared his experience with his friends and made positive impact on his choice of future hotels. This is the quality of customer service any company would desire to achieve.  Thank you, Tianna for your marvelous care you showed our family.  We have experienced the true Oasis in the Desert!

reviews.title: Cant wait to return.
reviews.text: Had an amazing experience. Everyone was very helpful, kind and professional. Truly a remarkable experience. Every employee was very courteous and truly cared about making us feel welcomed. Room was very clean and comfortable.

reviews.title: Perfect Oasis!!
reviews.text: This stay was perfect.  Separate entrance from the Mandalay Hotel. separate pool and restaurant.  Everything in four seasons side was as perfect as we expected. Then, we had easy access to everything Vegas at the Mandalay and beyond.  You have access to their pools and the private four seasons elevator stops on the Mandalay casino floor if you want.  I love Vegas.  Been there over 10 times over the years.  First time I tried this balance between four seasons paradise and then Vegas when we wanted it. Best travel decision I have ever made!!!!

reviews.title: Wow!  So glad we stayed here!!
reviews.text: We loved every minute of our family stay at the Four Seasons Las Vegas!  It is located conveniently by the Luxor Hotel and the Excalibur Hotel; Four Seasons shares the building with the Mandalay Bay.  We enjoyed going through the special door to get to the Mandalay  Bay, and we used the free Tram service

reviews.title: The Four Seasons Touch
reviews.text: Everything about our stay was exceptional. From the moment you walk in, you are treated like a VIP guest. This was replicated at the front desk, the pool, and even their restaurant, Veranda. At a time when many hotels are cutting back on amenities and personnel, the Four Seasons Las Vegas goes above and beyond.  Housekeeping came by twice in one day. (At one point, we received a surprise birthday treat in our room accompanied by a card.)  It's what my wife and I frequently referred to during our stay as “The Four Seasons Touch.”  Other Las Vegas Strip hotels, take note.

reviews.title: The Best by a MILE!
reviews.text: 5 days in the Four Seasons. They have everything right. They respect the customer. They respect COVID, and they run the best hotel in Vegas. We visited Resort World, maybe they should send staff to the Four Seasons to train.

reviews.title: Easy 5/5, very efficient and friendly personnel
reviews.text: I stay here for leisure about three times a year, always have a great stay, from arrival with the friendly valet and bell staff and desk agents, to departure with the same crew, always a great time.  Rooms are always the quality of the FS brand, never had issues, and cleanliness, maintenance and covid protocols are always in place.I'll give special commendation to Fruzsina.  On the FS app, I asked if late check out was available.  Very promptly, Fruzsina responded and arranged for what I needed, just like that.  Thank you Fruzsina!  FS, this person is a great ambassador to your brand.  The remaining good qualities of this hotel are covered extensively in other posts.  Oh, if you need food, booze, groceries, check out the little plazas across Las Vegas Blvd. Huge liquor store with everything, and a couple of family-owned eateries as well as corporate restaurants.  Enjoy your remaining summer travels, fellow readers!

reviews.title: Las Vegas in a relaxing environment
reviews.text: Excellent support staff. All details were well taken care of. This hotel allows you to avoid the typical Las Vegas crowed atmosphere. Excellent pool experience with attentive staff and excellent food. Easy to check in.

reviews.title: oasis of calm
reviews.text: Four Seasons service in the midst of the crazy.  I particularly enjoyed the relaxing pool.  Also, we liked the private door into the next door casino with easy walk to the convention center.  With time for a great lunch, the concierge found a table at the Bellagio with a view of the fountains.  Online information kept fluctuating about closures due to covid regulations.  However, the concierge came through!

reviews.title: The only place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Escape the smoke and riff raff of the casino when you want to by staying here. Fantastic, quiet rooms and extremely clean. Delicious food and five star service. Highly recommend this hotel if you like peace and quiet.

reviews.title: Nice hotel, couple of unpleasant interactions.
reviews.text: We had some unpleasant interactions with some of the staff. Particularly two incidents. One with the person cooking the omelettes in the buffet. His tone wasn’t polite, he was rushing us to pick the ingredients, asking for our plate by saying “plate!”, and making the whole thing uncomfortable. When he asked for our plates to put in the omelette in, I had to say “Excuse me, you can say please” and he immediately changed his tone, and another couple also said “yes, don’t be rude to us” The other one was a room service person. He brought the wrong tyoe of sodas and when I pointed it out, he opened the mini fridge looking for diet soda, and he lifted many item from the shelves in the fridge (the shleves have a sensor, so it charges whatever is lifted) which were later charged. He also said I had to call back because he couldn’t take care of that. On top of all of that weird interaction, there was a hard language barrier, so we couldn’t really understand what he was saying.The hotel is very nice and clean. It is apart from the Mandalay so you don’t run into any big crowds or people partying. Food could be better, particularly in-room dining. The buffet is alright I guess. The concierge staff and check in are phenomenal and extremely helpful. The app is also fantastic to get help right away.The room’s windows are not thick enough to block the noise from outside, and mind you, we were on the 38th floor.

reviews.title: Resort Fees, really?
reviews.text: Why would a top hotel brand hotel like Four Seasons charge resort fees at their Las Vegas property? Really cheesy and just pure greed generated from their new corporate bosses. Now they've diminished themselves to the level of a 3-4 start hotel. They claim it is for the gym and internet, really?

reviews.title: Comfortable and just the best staff
reviews.text: The staff at this hotel is absolutely the best.  Extremely friendly and helpful.  Never a delay in getting a response on any request.  The spa is beautiful and the massage therapists are excellent.  The rooms are comfortable and large.  My only complaint is is I think the rooms need an an upgrade.  A little outdated.  However, I highly recommend this hotel as it is quiet, comfortable with no casino and you cannot beat the staff.  They were all wonderful.

reviews.title: Perfect in every way!
reviews.text: Everything was excellent! If you are a frequent/repeat Four Seasons guest, the Las Vegas location delivers Four Seasons quality you already expect. From booking to checking out, everything is taken care of for you. All you have to do is show up and you will definitely be pampered. All your preferences achieved without saying a word. Four Seasons is really excellent in paying attention to details. The property is pristine, smells good and clean. Staff are polite and approachable. Our suite was kept clean, well-stocked and comfortable. Food was high quality and very delicious, both in-room dining and cabana, we never ate out! In-room dining is less than 20mins wait from the time you call. The pool area is clean, quiet and has the perfect atmosphere for relaxing. You don’t have to deal with crowds. The pool staff were amazing, always available and attentive. The perk of Mandalay Bay pool access was really great because the kids enjoyed the wave pool.

reviews.title: Not impressed
reviews.text: We always stay at luxury hotels and was excited to stay at 1500sf suite at the Four Seasons.  I bit disappointed in the furniture which appeared overly worn and possible not changed since the hotel opening in 1999.  The room was not properly cleaned as there were finger prints on the TV chest and open Ritz Crackers in the cabinet.  There are many other luxury hotels in Vegas whose rooms far exceed the Four Seasons especially at this price point.

reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text: Clean rooms, great customer service and they were welcoming to my small dog, which was the deciding factor on staying there.  It's at the end of the strip but you can walk through the shopping area to get to other casino's. We will definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Enjoyable stay
reviews.text: We returned to this hotel after a staying once a couple of years before. The staff are friendly, and the service is top notch. We experienced a few issues with our room, and in order to compensate for our troubles, we received a wonderful room upgrade. The property and pool were very well kept, and the food at Veranda and Press were good. The hotel is located at the south end of the strip, which is great if you want to be away from crowds but difficult if you want to go anywhere. A car is necessary, and we drove to Town Square (south of the hotel) for dinner a couple of times, which was nice. All in all, we had an enjoyable stay.

reviews.title: The best experience for my kitty!
reviews.text: Would come back ten times over! Great staff and atmosphere, lovely food via room service and strong drinks at the bar! ATM downstairs, and cleanest casino in Vegas. Beautiful view of the Luxor from floor 35.

reviews.title: NOT COVID Safe, despite 4 Seasons Global "Lead with Care" Program
reviews.text: Anyone who comes to Las Vegas at this time needs to be aware of how generally dangerous the COVID situtaion is there. The  Vegas 4 Seasons Hotel is clearly more interested in courting the same careless clientele, to recover lost revenues from the pandemic as all the other competitors on the strip. I expected so much more from trusting in the promotions. It will be a long time before I will trust staying at another 4 Seasons property and cannot imagine myself EVER returning to stay at the 4 Seasons Las Vegas Hotel.

reviews.title: Lower your expectations, if you're familiar with the Four Seasons brand of luxury stays
reviews.text: I am a frequent traveler, as well as a frequent Four Seasons guest. If there is a Four Seasons in the area that I am traveling to, I always choose that option. When I found out that I would be going to Las Vegas for work every two months, I was "ok" with this because I thought "at least there is a Four Seasons". Hmm... Four Seasons it is not. The two BEST things about this "resort" and the only reason why I am giving it two stars is the valet attendants are super nice and pretty amazing (way overworked, though) and the pool staff is great (but only 50% of the time). I stayed here, most recently, from July 5th-July 15th, 2021. To start with, the Reception Desk Attendants act as if they are doing you a favor by working there. Their attitude sucks. Multiple times, we requested our vehicle from valet through the front desk, the front desk never notified valet. My dog came with me as well. Each Four Seasons is different on their pet allowances: some don't charge anything, some charge a one-time fee, some charge a nightly fee. Four Seasons Vegas was $75 per night for my 1 dog plus hotel fees. This is the most I have ever spent at a Four Seasons for a pet and there is literally no where safe to take your dog out for a walk or to use the restroom. Here's the deal: they have a "pet relief" area that most people's home bathrooms are larger than. It is out in the middle of hotel traffic and NEVER has poop pick-up bags refilled in the container. The pavement is so hot to cross traffic to the area, I had to carry my dog each time. The room was alright, but I paid for a nice room. The room was NOT Four Seasons standards. The sheets were awful, like something from a dollar store. The toilet paper was one-ply. GROSS. The bathtub and shower were dirty with hair and lotion all over the bath and lavatory area. Disgusting. The food/hospitality menus were very much lacking. The supposed "Italian Kitchen: Verandah", was so minimal and Olive Garden has more Italian options than they did. All of the menus from Room Service to Press to the Pool are basically all the same 10ish things. No options. Not what I was expecting at all. I ordered Room Service roughly 7 times or so. It was wrong EVERYTIME and LATE! They could never get their business together. They would be missing an item, and it would take 40+ minutes for them to come back with it. The food was cold by that time. No charges were ever removed when they did this. The pool was alright, when "A" Team was working. If anyone was out of off for the day, it was a huge mess. Wrong drink mixers in wrong containers, leading to wrong drinks going out. Water pitchers empty for hours, when its super hot outside--unacceptable. I've stood at the Check-In desk at the pool multiple times when your lifeguard just stares at her phone and doesn't even let a Pool Attendant know anyone is there. I get that this is a rough time for a lot of businesses, but you're the Four Seasons. Managers and Concierge should be working anywhere they need to. Instead, I continued to see your Concierge frequent the pool area to flirt with an employee. I had asked for reservations and recommendations for one evening (with a 48 hour notice), and she just quoted me times from OpenTable, didn't even attempt to call. I called myself and had no problem getting a reservation for the time that I wanted. What is the point of you offering this service? Everytime that I told room service that our order was wrong, they wanted to "take it off the bill." I am not staying at Four Seasons to complain about the bill and have items taken off. I shouldn't have to complain in the first place, as it should be superior service. This is not only the worst Four Seasons experience that I have had, but likely the worst hotel stay. The snack area above the mini-bar is also weighted. But instead of using common sense, they put empty glasses there. So every time I used an empty glass to have a glass of tea or water or whatever, it charged me to use the glass. It isn't worth my time that it takes to explain this for the $9 plus fees I was charged each time. When sitting at the bar at Press one night, I ordered a cocktail off the menu that the bartender says "This cocktail is really bad. Don't get it." Why is it on the menu? I was also told multiple times that a manager would be contacting my room from Room Service. No one ever did. I left on the 15th, no one ever contacted my room. Needless to say: stay elsewhere, if you like luxury stays. I am sad to say that I will be coming back to Vegas every two months for work and will not be staying at the Four Seasons. I have already canceled future reservations.

reviews.title: Best place in Vegas to stay with Kids
reviews.text: We travel to Las Vegas just to stay at the 4Seasons and do outdoor hiking to Red Rock canyon and Zion National Park for a day.  Th El Dorado Canyon mine where 3000 miles to Graceland was filmed is only 45 min away and and unbelievable experience for kids. We don’t even gamble or drink but love the hotel so much and since it’s within driving distance of San Diego, Ca. We always end up there as a odd year vacation.

reviews.title: 5 stars is not enough
reviews.text: If I could give more stars I would! From before our arrival to our departure the service was beyond remarkable, we were contacted in advance and offered a free suite upgrade, upon arrival - Raymond walked us to the front desk and during check in Cyril gave us complimentary champagne to celebrate our business's first year anniversary. The hotel is spotless, secure, and just beautiful. Our room was luxurious, what you would expect from a 5 star resort. The In Room Dining food was tasty filling and delivered quickly everytime. Our pool experience was did not disappoint as once again the staff was the spotlight, Tony knocked it out of the ballpark with attentiveness! If we could fix just one thing it would be the cost of the cabana (cabana 8 is on an upper level so a distance from the pool and no misters so you had to be in the water for any relief from the heat).

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel but avoid the breakfast at veranda restaurant.
reviews.text: Stayed at this property before and it’s still, if you want a quiet, clean and calm atmosphere, the best in Las Vegas. Check in staff all very nice and check in very smooth. The rooms are well maintained and good sized and well appointed. Also, if you want access to a huge pool complex the four seasons connects to the Mandalay Bay hotel pool, which is one of the nicest in town. Only downside to staying here is the food. We had one of the worst breakfasts ever at the Veranda restaurant. The quality of the food was very poor, embarrassing for four seasons hotel. I had a word with the food manager about it but he seemed unfazed. Probably why the good is so bad. Anyway, enjoy the great hotel but eat somewhere else.

reviews.title: Four Seasons - 5 Stars
reviews.text: This was our second stay at the Four Season Las Vegas.  For years we had been loyal guests at the Mandarin Oriental.  When it changed hands to become a Hilton Waldorf property, we changed to the Four Seasons.Here’s why I would recommend this property:1.  If you don’t want a Mega Resort experience where your one of thousands of faceless guests, this place is for you.  The staff at Four Seasons know your name as you pull-up to begin your stay.  They make you feel extremely valuable.2.  If you want a pool without a DJ blasting euro techno and Bro’s with bottles of Champaign, this pool is perfect.  No scene, very peaceful and terrific service.3.  Super, super, clean rooms.4.  Great lobby bar and restaurant.If you want an oasis from the chaos of the strip, the Four Seasons is perfect!

reviews.title: Excellent service on the Vegas strip.
reviews.text: Just an overall fantastic stay on the strip. From check in to checkout, the service was top notch. The team at the door and front desk were great about getting us checked in, proving recommendations and making us feel at home. The room was exceptional. The pool was maintained (towels full, service great), and the food and bar service poolside some of the best in Vegas. If you’re looking for a quieter place to stay in Vegas that has exceptional service, this is the place. And if you want to gamble, it’s connected to Mandalay Bay casino and their pools.

reviews.title: Convenient to airport
reviews.text: We chose this hotel because it was very close to airport. The rooms were large and clean. The beds were very comfortable. The bathroom amenities were great, L’Occitane.  One was the oil bath gel which our skin needed after being in a dry climate that our bodies were not use to. The only negative was that the air conditioning didn’t work as good as we hoped. The room never got really cool. We ordered room service since dinner options were limited here. We ordered 3 items but they only delivered 2. We were only charged for the 2 and didn’t want to wait another 40 minutes and didn’t reorder. The four seasons seems to occupy the top floors of the Mandalay hotel. It has its own pool but guests can use the Mandalay pool as well. The staff was very friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: None better on the Strip.
reviews.text: Nothing on the Strip can be better.  Exceptional service from the front desk, concierge, pool attendants, wait staff and housekeeping.    Actual turn down service, not just a towel replenishing.  No matter where you enter the hotel the noise and clamor of Vegas  immediately stops.  Private elevators keep wait times to a minimum.  Private pool for FS guests only.  Clean, quiet and well taken care of.  You will not be disappointed.

reviews.title: Elegant and excellent customer service
reviews.text: The customer service was excellent in every aspect! So easy to chat with hotel for requests through app. Hotel staff was always prompt, friendly and professional. Had the hustle and bustle of Mandalay Bay so close but the four seasons offered a quiet, elegant, friendly and comfortable retreat. Will definitely return.

reviews.title: Amazing Anniversary
reviews.text: Excellent staff/service, rooms, dining.  Marama at the concierge desk was absolutely amazing, very knowledgeable and kind.   Pool was never over crowded. If you wanted to mingle more or go to the wave pool, adult pool, or bigger pools, you get the use of Mandalay Bay's pools.  However, the Four Seasons pool is for their guest only which is perfect.

reviews.title: Best of All Worlds
reviews.text: We splurged for a recent getaway to Las Vegas.  We wanted a very nice hotel away from the noise and the crowds that was still close to gaming and entertainment.  I've traveled all over and I think this may be the finest hotel I've ever visited.  The rooms are outstanding, the amenities are top notch, and the service is like nothing I've ever experienced.  The private elevator to the Mandalay Bay casino is the cherry on top.  Expensive to be sure, but worth every penny.

reviews.title: Luxury Stay While Away from the Bustle of the Casino
reviews.text: Connected to the Mandalay Bay but without having to deal with the usual crowds. This was the perfect hide out from the crowds for folks not ready to mingle without masks. That doesn't mean folks here are masked (Staff are masked), some nice folks are masked, others are not that's for sure. Good breakfasts and lunches at the Veranda. Pool staff are attentive, keep you hydrated, and banana-coladas for the win!

reviews.title: We could all die here!
reviews.text: The fire alarm went on at 3:30am for about 15 minutes. We walked out to check all emergency exits that we saw, and all of them were locked!!! We and other guests were trapped in the middle of the hallway, and didn’t know what was happening and what we should do. That’s ridiculous.

reviews.title: The Pro's and Con's
reviews.text: The Four Seasons has pros and cons. The pros The rooms are very comfortable and the beds outstanding. Best sleep we have ever experienced in a hotel.  The hotel has it's own pool and has access to the 5 pools at Mandalay Bay. The Four Seasons pool is smaller but never had a problem getting a chair and the service was quite good. Frozen drinks were very good and the pool is quite.The cons were the distance from the main strip. You either needed a car or take a cab way to far to walk.  Felt like we weren't even in Las Vegas You can gamble in Mandalay Bay, since the Four Seasons doesn't have a casino. Next time will stay either Bellagio, Pallazo or Encore in the middle of the action.

reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.text: We stayed from 13 Nov – 15 Nov and I’ve been meaning to post this review because I thoroughly enjoyed the high level of personal service. Every single employee I encountered was an absolute pleasure, from check-in to check-out. Jazzy answered the phone and she always knew how to handle my request, even anticipating my next question. For example, I would ask for turndown service and she would ask what time we were leaving the room.Eileen at Press was a delight, even offering us a glass of champagne for our anniversary. Dejan Todorovic checked on us at breakfast each morning. And the concierge, Marama Nengel, was simply the best. She was exactly how a concierge in a 5-star hotel should be. It’s a forgotten art, and it was so refreshing to interact with a professional concierge for a change. I had given up based on my experience at other hotels.  The next time we return to Las Vegas, we will be sure to stay at the Four Seasons.

reviews.title: Disappointing.
reviews.text: Pros:Very nice staff. Good gym. Fantastic views. Very nice, aesthetically pleasing public areas. No crazy casino atmosphere.Cons:They need to fix the air-conditioning problem; you need to keep the AC at 65° and on high fan setting in order for the room to be cool and it’s a little bit noisy under those settings for sleep. Engineering came up twice to to try and remedy to no avail. I spoke with another guest who was encountering the same thing in his room, so it wasn’t just mine. Bed linens did not have that smooth, cool feel to them and the mattress was mediocre. No water at all to be found in the room!?? Junky Keurig coffee machine.The rooms are underwhelming; I’ve had better rooms at the Mandalay Bay itself and also at the Cosmopolitan recently. I’ve had fantastic stays at other Four Seasons properties recently that I would return to however this one I would not. Not a bad choice, but I think there are better options in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Unparalleled Service & Attention
reviews.text: The attention and service start to finish was phenomenal.  Upon arrival, our contact - Amanda, had champagne brought to the room with macaroons.  The patience and the recommendations of the Concierge team of Patricia, Carolynn, Arturo and Cryil were top notch.  Patricia routinely forwarded ideas and suggestions while revising plans as needed.The views from the strip-facing room were wonderful.  Beyond the stellar service, the resort is quiet, which is a nice break from other resorts.  This offers a secluded experience.  Wonderful staff, attentive service with fabulous views and food translate to an unforgettable experience.

reviews.title: Excellent Service and Breakfast Buffet
reviews.text: From the beginning as you pull up to their front door, your car door is opened and greeted by staff members.  Everyone is cheerful and helpful.  The breakfast buffet needs to be reserved in advance, it gets filled up quickly.  The salmon is smoked, bagels are freshly made, yogurt parfait is topped with fresh berries, granola, and mango sauce, freshly made pastries, omelet station made to order, and a hot plate with fluffy scrambled eggs, scrambled egg whites, homemade sausage, bacon, homemade french toast with homemade chunky berry sauce.  I'm sure I missed a few other food items but, anyway everything was fresh and delicious.  The hotel is quiet with no casinos and family friendly with a children's game room and pool.  Excellent get away for relaxation.

reviews.title: First trip back post Covid vaccination!
reviews.text: I would have rated this hotel with 4 stars however the general upscale feeling I felt at this hotel and many others this visit was absent.  It seems Vegas and I speak for most hotels I was in , have lowered their rates and in turn attracted let's say some shady characters.  We saw several getting taken down by security, others walking through the glitzy lobbies half dressed, no shoes, no shirts, let it all hang out kinda deal.  The local bodegas required shoes, and shirts or no service but not the upper scale Vegas hotels??  Also be prepared and be warned all the hotels charging a hefty "resort fee" per night for this less attractive ambience ($50-$60/night).  Overall, it seems making up lost revenue after Covid  is most mportant to Vegas hotels and casinos than their guests.  I say skip Vegas for a few years, go back in 2023 it may be back to normal but pretty scary at the moment.

reviews.title: Quiet oasis in Vegas
reviews.text: Luxurious non smoking non gaming hotel. Stayed in strip view studio  - expensive but worth it! Easy access to Mandalay for wide array of restaurants and gaming but then return to the quiet oasis of the four seasons. Not easily walkable from the rest of the strip but since traveling with family en route to national parks that was not a priority for us. Highly recommend

reviews.title: We had a great 9-day stay; we highly recommend it
reviews.text: The 1 BR suite we had was perfect for us--it had an additional 1/2 bath. It was very comfortable and well-equipped. We were treated royally and thoroughly enjoyed having our in-room dining breakfast delivered to us Hot! Rooms manager Austin Price, the concierge staff (particularly Patrica) and the front drive staff were helpful, friendly and professional. In Nevada in May 2021 no one who was vaccinated needed to wear a mask; the brothels were open but the hot tubs were not. Go Figure. We love hot tubs and would have enjoyed the Four Seasons hot tub. Oh well.

reviews.title: Relax-lux oasis in Vegas
reviews.text: We wanted a calm oasis from Vegas fun, and Four Seasons was an excellent choice at the south end of the Strip.  It is farther from the action, but we realized we could have mostly stayed in the Mandalay Bay complex and had a very satisfying trip.We booked as Preferred Partners and enjoyed benefits of resort credits and included breakfast onsite.  The bed was comfortable, the robes were cozy, and the bathroom with a separate toilet closet was nice!  We spent an afternoon at the pool being pampered and attended to.  Every employee were interacted with was helpful and friendly. Our room was so quiet except the last night the people next door had a party at 1 am, we woke up to clapping, laughing and shouting. We called the front desk and the situation was handled swiftly, and the noise stopped within 15 mins.  Other than that group, the guests were all chill.First trip to Vegas and it was fun; but for us, the relax-lux experience at Four Seasons made the whole vacation.

reviews.title: Great resort within Mandalay
reviews.text: Incredible upgraded room.  My friends were super impressed as I was.  As unrelaxing as Vegas is(and I like it) this was a nice little spot to unwind before the craziness continued.  Overall loved the service at the pool and the front desk was very professional!!

reviews.title: Two marvelous visits
reviews.text: We bookended a trip to Jackson Hole with nights here.  We chose the hotel because it has no casino.  It also, probably consequently, doesn’t have many children.  The result is an extremely comfortable and relaxing time in Las Vegas.  We don’t gamble, and don’t really get into the Vegas thing, so this hotel was perfect.  Being attached to, although separate from, Mandalay Bay, gambling was easily available if desired.  We stayed in rooms 38133 and 39133.  Each had a view of the Strip and the airport.  The rooms were of equal size and were spacious.  The bed and bedding were totally fantastic.  There was a desk, chaise, lots of storage space, plenty of outlets and good lighting.  Bath amenities were l'Occitane, so were excellent.  Towels were big and fluffy.  The shower was very good.  There is a separate tub.  The minibar is one which automatically debits when anything is removed.  Service was typical of the chain, which is to say, there are loads of staff on hand to see to your needs in a friendly and professional manner.  There are several dining options here, including poolside.  The pool was relatively uncrowded.  We ate breakfast in Veranda, and dinner in Press.  All meals were excellent.  We were very pleased with our stays here.  Particular kudos to assistant manager Daniel, who was most helpful.  Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Tiny room compared to other night end vegas hotels and far fro luxurious. Nothing high end about the room. Really pretty average. Wifi doesn’t work well. No info on how amenities work. Very disappointing, especially for the price. Would have much rather stayed at venician. Room is twice as big and nicer furnishings.

reviews.title: Only one issue
reviews.text: Second time here and I love it.  It really is an oasis of calm.  I agree with all of the wonderful things others have said and have only one complaint: the pool closes too early.  After a day trip to Zion, we got back to the hotel and hit the pool at 530.  Bar was closed, kitchen was closed.  Water was to close at 6p.  We’d been looking forward to a snack and a beer with a swim before going up to shower for dinner.  As we were in the pool, the lifeguard had a count down- “you have 15 minutes”, etc and started setting up a rope barrier around the pool.  Speaking of life guards, one fell asleep in the high chair.  Kinda comical.  He was spoken to by a manager type.  Anyway,I hope pool hours get extended in the future.Shout out to Bill and Noah- super friendly and accommodating servers at PRESS.

reviews.title: Great visit
reviews.text: Compared to other Las Vegas Strip hotels Four Seasons provides the best experience. Checkin was easy, no lines, which   are common at other Vegas hotels. The pool area is not overcrowded and the pool side service was great. Overall, we had a great visit due to great management and staff.

reviews.title: So Good
reviews.text: I adore this hotel. From the second you step foot on the property the high service standard is on display. Staff are uniformly polite, helpful and caring. It's a nice Four Seasons touch to greet guests by name, but here the kindness behind the greeting always comes through. My room was spotless. Nice that there's still a hotel left that puts out the tiny bottles of shampoo, etc. (L'Occitan) instead of those gross dispensers. The bed is fabulously comfortable, and a great place to laze about and watch the 65" TV, or look down at the Strip.The only gripe I have has nothing to do with the property or the staff. Resort fees are bogus. They cover things that most guests would think should either be included or are unwanted. A resort fee at a property of this caliber is particularly off-putting. Enough said.I love this hotel to death and will never stay anywhere else in Las Vegas. Highly recommended.(multiple stays--similar experiences)

reviews.title: Comfort and Tranquility
reviews.text: This is an island of civilization in the craziness of Vegas and a wonderful home base from which to roam. The beds are deliciously comfortable and the service everything you’d expect from a Four Seasons. The concierge in particular was brilliant with some wonderful restaurant recommendations. There’s no casino in the hotel but that allows for a little downtime which is not a bad thing.

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text: From check in to check out, the stay at Four Seasons was above reproach. I wish the hotel was NOT connected to Mandalay Bay, but I guess it could go both ways if you want casino action. However, casinos are all within walking distance. The food was absolutely delicious and well prepared and presented. They go out of their way for personal touches as well. The furnishings, bed/bedding and personal use items was luxurious. It was everything you would expect from a Four Seasons (along with the price!)Travel Pup Corner: I think a luxury hotel like this accepting pets is going above-and-beyond and it was greatly appreciated. I WISH they had more areas you could potty your dog though. The area around the hotel and surrounding it did not provide suitable or adequate areas for going potty. The area they do provide is tiny and a bit dangerous with all the cars going in and out.  However, considering they allow dogs at all... this could be overlooked.

reviews.title: Great spot for families in Vegas
reviews.text: We had an amazing 4 night stay here. It was first time bringing kids to Vegas (several adult trips previously). We loved our stay-quiet, no smoke or casino noise. Pool at Four Seasons is heated and kids loved the Family Lounge where they could play air hockey and other games. Excellent service. Pool occupancy at Mandalay Beach is limited and people were lining up 3 hours before pools opened. We were fortunate in that we had booked a cabana so didn’t have to wait long but looked like a huge hassle otherwise. No wait at Four Seasons pool. Highly recommend for families. Thank you for the wonderful stay.

reviews.title: Service is top notch though some caveats.
reviews.text: Some good things.Very responsive/attentive staff via the chat app. Really love using the app. Overall the room we had was clean. Found some dust balls near the door hinges. Towels were plush. Could use better toilet paper. The ones we had felt like sandpaper. And quick check in/out and fast valet to bring car around. The not so good things.Way too many kids here.Looking for a getaway as a couple but soon realized this place feels like a day-care center. Even during the night at the Press outdoor fireplace, kids screaming/crying while parents trying to enjoy wine. They should have just stayed home.Then there is the non-stop kids screaming and running up and down the corridors starting at 7:30 am. We wanted to use the FS pool but at the sight of so many kids, we went to Waldorf instead. (HH Diamond member). Here's the thing we heard. Mandalay overbooked their guests and hence sent some of their guests over to Four Seasons. Started wondering if these guests paid Mandalay prices for FS.  Probably. Then are we morons for over-paying to stay at FS?  Makes me wonder. Will we stay here again? Unlikely.

reviews.title: The Best Hotel in Vegas for Families
reviews.text: What a fantastic hotel. I love many hotels in Vegas but honestly, this place is perfect for families. (With the caveat being if you don't have little kids, be aware, there are a LOT of kids here). The service is impeccable - it is the Four Seasons - everyone is invested in making sure you have a great stay, the temp checks, masking and social distancing are on point, they are so kind to the kids, the pool is great with excellent food and drink service and is big enough to not feel crowded but small enough so you can see your kids at all times. Plus seats were always available for our family of four. We had a penthouse suite that was more than enough space and had fantastic views over the Strip. It was so nice to leave the Strip behind and come back to this oasis in the desert. And we could be in our room from door to door in less than five minutes. After walking through many casinos this week, that was a huge perk. Every single thing about this hotel was perfect for our family. They even had robes and slippers for kids (you request them through their teriffic app) and wrote the kids' names on the bathtub along with giving them free kid tote bags with snacks when we checked in. So thoughtful. I truly don't know what they could change. Outstanding experience.

reviews.title: Five Star... with a few qualifiers
reviews.text: We loved the Mandarin Oriental for our Vegas trips, but with its changeover to the Waldorf Astoria (and its somewhat iffy reviews), we thought we'd give Four Seasons a try. It's our favorite hotel brand, but in this case, I had been reluctant to stay so far down the Strip. Now that we've been there and back, I'm still of the opinion that it's farther from the heart of things than I would like.But there are lots of good things to say about it. Every staff person we encountered was kind and hospitable. The rooms are nice... I wouldn't say the decor is dated, but it's also not especially sleek and modern. Suffice it to say that if you put a premium on clean surroundings and a comfortable bed, you should be happy here.We lucked out on having nice weather during our late March visit, so we spent a lot of time at the pool. Everyone who worked there was super friendly and efficient... things got busy and they were hustling. We rented a cabana on the hottest day of our trip, which was an excellent decision. Back to the location, which remains top of (my) mind: right before we left, I figured  we'd be taking cabs everywhere. Once we arrived, I realized the glitch in that plan: since the shutdown, approx. 75 percent of the cab drivers haven't returned to work. And Uber/Lyft doesn't seem to be quite as much of a player in Vegas as it is in other cities. So we did end up waiting more than we thought we would. Not a deal-breaker, but something to factor in for the future. I will say that having the Mandalay Bay casino downstairs -- without having to walk through it when we didn't want to -- was nice. And being someone who loves to watch planes take off and land, having a view of the McCarran runways along with the Strip from our room was great!

reviews.title: Safe escape
reviews.text: Needed to see family in Las Vegas but wanted to stay as secluded as possible during the pandemic. The Four Seasons offered a safe, clean, and relaxing escape. There is no casino so social distancing was a breeze. The staff are welcoming while still being on top of making sure everyone has a great but safe time. As always the hotel was clean and luxurious.

reviews.title: Fantastic Service and best nonsmoking hotel for babies
reviews.text: My family absolutely loved the Four Seasons. It is the best non-smoking hotel on the strip! When we booked the room we let them know we were bringing a baby. They went above and beyond with a crib and baby gift basket including towels, diapers, a teddy bear, bubble bath set, and rubber ducky which we still use in every bath. It was a wonderful little extra that made our experience more memorable. The service was always quick and the staff were all very kind. There is a fantastic aquarium in the same building which is great for families and the food was always delicious. I definitely recommend the Four Season.

reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text: The rooms are fabulous and well kept! I have stayed here many times. The service is beyond amazing. We came for my husband’s birthday and he got sick while in Vegas. You wouldn’t believe how far the hotel went to help us. They couldn’t do enough to help us. It has been stressful being away from home with an illness but everyone at the hotel especially security, front desk and whomever responds to the message app have eased the stress. Four Seasons you definitely care about people and THANK YOU for everything!!!

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Stayed here based on all the reviews and not a single thing referenced was anything we encountered..  no champagne welcome, no hot towels, no welcome gift for kids, etc.    Room was basic and amenities unremarkable.   What I can say is the food was excellent - room service, pool and Veranda breakfast.  The pool staff and bellmen are super helpful remaining staff not overly helpful or friendly.- overall let down on many accounts..   this was our first stay at a Four Seasons property but would hesitate before booking again.

reviews.title: Book Without Hesitation
reviews.text: My partner and I stayed for two nights at The Four Seasons Las Vegas in March 2021. I visit Vegas frequently and had been interested in staying at this hotel, but never had the bravery to do so due to the far location from the center of the Strip (Four Seasons entrance is past Mandalay Bay). If this is your concern, I must tell you to go ahead and book immediately, with no hesitation. Below are my ‘Top 10 Reasons to Stay at Four Seasons Las Vegas.’ These are just some of my experiences, none of which I had found at other Las Vegas properties:1.	Relatively affordable rates for the accommodations provided, with great packages – you feel like you are the only guests in the hotel!2.	Champagne at check-in for two3.	Small gift for my partner at check-in4.	Water-bottles, warm towels, and umbrellas immediately provided to guests in the front drive for the day ahead5.	All staff referring to you and remembering your last name6.	Never any delay in seeing the front desk or concierge team7.	Taxis readily available and no confusion as far as ride-share pick-up as the drivers come straight to the front drive (not having to find the ride-share pick-up area frantically)   8.	Although the spa, fitness center, and pools were fairly small (for Vegas standards), the level of guest personalization and homey feeling was like no-other.9.	Direct and full access to all Mandalay Bay amenities 10.	Best full strip views in Las Vegas from guest rooms (I believe the rooms are on the 35th-39th floors of the Mandalay Bay). Need I say more?The following staff members were particular ‘stand-outs:’1.	Daniel Gomez (Front Desk) – greeted us with champagne and gifts at arrival2.	Lana (Spa) – hilarious and so, so welcoming at the spa3.	Solange (Bar) – took time to really get to know my partner and I, we felt like we were having a drink in her home4.	Fruzsina (Front Desk) – delightful and provided my partner and I a generous deal on an upgrade – Thank you!5.	Magdalena (Housekeeping) – remembered our name each day and assisted me in enhancement of my Spanish language skills6.	Marama Nengel (Concierge) – very knowledgeable about the area and went so far as to Facebook Message her concierge friends to find a very rare item for me – a large Las Vegas snow globe7.	Ronson (Overnight – mahalo and aloha ;) ) – very hard-working and was great to get to know late at night and so helpful when I called down for requests8.	Shunhyung Kim (Guest Services) – showed my partner and I different signature suites we plan to book on future stays9.	David Ayala (Front Desk) – friendly face to see each time we went to the front desk, extremely professional and genuineThank you for reading my letter and the wonderful time your hotel provided!

reviews.title: Really great stay and felt very safe
reviews.text: We had a wonderful and relaxing stay at Four Seasons in Vegas. It is at the very south end of the strip and if you wanted to avoid the strip and the crowds it’s a great place to stay. No casino and no smell of smoke in the hotel.Room was extremely comfortable the hotel felt very safe and complaint with covid necessities.The staff checked our temperature at entry and had us sign statements on our health symptoms etc The lobby and restaurant were not crowded at all. We were socially distanced from other folks.The NYE celebrations was very safely and well plannedService was excellent We went for a bunch of hikes to parks and national reserve areas and it was a really good experience. We walked through the strip one time mostly outdoors unless we needed to go in.... we were glad we were at Four Seasons  since mid strip seemed very crowded and we didn’t feel as safeThe only reason I am giving it a 4 stars instead of the 5 is because we had one bad experience that marred our otherwise perfect stay. We chose a pet friendly hotel with really great reviews so we took our 7 lb terrier Ace with us.... Ace was with us when we were checking in and we sat with him and ate dinner right in front of the check in counter after we finished checking in.The next day we had to leave our dog for about an hour or hour and a half to view the shark reef which would not allow pets. While waiting to get into shark reef I got a call from the hotel front desk asking if we had a dog in the room and I said yes..... I was sharply told that I had to pay and declare if we had a dog! It was the first time we were informed and had no issues with paying any fee and would have gladly had done so right at check in...... it could have been handled much better by asking and informing to get this sorted. The way it was handled seemed rude and accusatory rather than informing us. We were told there were complaints about our little dog barking and they would need us to return immediately to take care if it. When we explained we were next door and will be back in an hour or so it all was sorted out and fine. We paid the pet fees as charged and we received a pet bed and bowls and treats for our pooch. Ace loved the treats provided All but this one incident was exemplary.....service cleanliness comfort and food

reviews.title: We spent the 1st Day of the new year here
reviews.text: Such a great stay. Myself, daughter, and singing Shih Tzu stayed for one day. The service was to notch. Even gave my dog a bed, water dish, food dish, and 3 delicious bone treats and King Caesar went wild. He truly felt like a King! The room smelled great! It was super clean. We saw the strip, and the service again was excellent.I am SUPER picky about where I stay. At the highest level and this hotel is in my top 10 all time hotel stays. I will stay here again for sure.

reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience!  This hotel is like a magical, little oasis in the middle of wild Vegas!  Aileen and Solange at Press made our son, Ashton feel so special every night!  Marama, the concierge, went above and beyond!  She was amazing!  Donna in room service was so nice and made our son’s birthday morning extra special!

reviews.title: Perfection and charm
reviews.text: I see Mr. David CHARM Ayala already has his own fan club here on TripAdvisor and it’s not surprising.😊 From the moment we got out of the car we were surrounded by impeccably professional, warm, and personable people. The lady at the valet was extremely welcoming and friendly (I’m sorry I did not get her name!), and she then led us to superstar David Ayala at the front desk who helped us get into a beautiful one bedroom suite. He absolutely went above and beyond to make sure all our wishes were met - but then again, “above and beyond” seems to be just normal at this Four Seasons. Service at the bar was pleasant, and Nick at the coffee bar totally remembered what type of coffee drink I like the next morning! Impressive. The gentlemen at the valet also went out of their way to give recommendations on where to eat (Thank you, Jimmy Chang!). The property is beautiful, easy access to the Mandalay Bay, and our suite had breathtaking views - sunrise and Las Vegas Strip. The rooms are not as modern as in some newer hotels, but the amazing staff at this hotel more than makes up for it. The people are definitely this hotel’s greatest asset. I am grateful I got to experience a stay at this Four Seasons. ❤️

reviews.title: A Must Stay!
reviews.text: Our initial greeting with Mr. David Ayala was amazing. He made us feel so welcomed. He and his entire staff are stellar. Okay ladies he’s cute but I don’t know that he’s single lol. Anyway...I am a hard reviewer as you see. However the Four Seasons in Vegas has left nothing but a good taste in my mouth. We will be back! Customer service awesome! Food awesome! Housekeeping awesome! Concierge awesome! If I could give 10 starts I would. Look for my separate review on the spa which was great as well! And yes there is a TVs in the mirror of the bathroom. 🎉Dr. Shaunda Cooper

reviews.title: Thoroughly enjoyable
reviews.text: Quiet and tranquility can be found here, which is exactly what I wanted during my stay in Las Vegas. Extremely comfortable bed, nice outdoor dining area, extremely quiet and comfortable rooms, along with a helpful and friendly staff make this a great escape from the frenetic pace of the strip.

reviews.title: A Wonderful Place for Non-Vegas Folks
reviews.text: Our trip to Vegas was due to the impossibility of securing a marriage license in NYC. FYI- it took 15 minutes at the Clark County marriage bureau. Our ceremony was beautiful in the Valley of Fire. Thankfully our six days at the Four Seasons in a one bedroom suite was wonderful. Neither one of us gamble or find glitz and glam appealing. A high end non casino hotel was important to us to celebrate our special event. The Four Seasons did not disappoint. The staff are great. Very personable and warm. We received lovely chocolate gratuities and genuine interest in our having our needs met. Bottles of water were ample, cleaning was thorough and steadfast. Lastly, the food and room service was great (albeit expect to spend $$). The truffle fries and chicken soup is amazing. I also loved the shrimp tacos in the restaurant. Running into one of my favorite celebrity chefs was also a nice treat. Overall a great experience and a top notch luxury hotel.

reviews.title: First Class Experience VIP
reviews.text: I loved my stay there. It was an amazing experience starts in the Check in Counter with Mr. AYALA an excellent Host with Champagne toast and because My birthday was on the 19th I received a gift in my room a piece of cake. Room Service is excellent too works every hour and an superb way. I Look forward to staying again in  Four Seasons Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Top Hotel in Vegas; First Class Experience!!!!
reviews.text: It's hard to put such a world class stay into words, but I'll do my best.  Having stayed in hundreds of hotels, I have to stay that hands down, this was simply the most wonderful hotel stay we ever had!!!  It was truly beyond exceptional!  First of all, a shout out to the wonderful Hotel Manager, Ahmed.  He is a true professional, a consummate host, and incredibly friendly, caring, and approachable.  He ensures that the hotel provides a truly world class experience to every guest.  There was literally not a single thing that the Four Seasons team could have possibly done to make this trip better!  From the amazing views off the desert and strip, world class staff that aim to ensure a perfect guest experience, the heavenly bedding and pillows, remarkable location, relaxing pool area, top of the line toiletries, and incredible array of diverse and delectable food and beverages, this trip was simply divine!  I'd also like to shout out to Austin, the Director of Rooms, and Andreas who took such great care of us by the pool.  Thank you again for creating these wonderful memories for us!  We can't wait to return!

reviews.title: Rough Start to a Polished Finish
reviews.text: Pros: 5-star finishes, large suites, knowledgeable staff, amazing gym for a hotel, delicious breakfast, accepts pets, provides doggy bed and food bowl, good selection of in room dining. Great valet, even helped get our items out of the car after it was parked downstairs, sanitized it, and provided water for the road. Pet relief area 100’ from the main entrance. Food was delicious. Air conditioner worked flawlessly and separately in both rooms; and WiFi was great. Upscale L’Occitane bath amenities, great shower pressure, hot water etc. Had screening at main entrance for Covid, including temperature checks, though they didn’t enforce the 24hr re-check requirements. Cons: Missed opportunity with FHR automatic room upgrade at check in. Got it fixed, but took a phone call and significantly impacted our arrival experience. FHR breakfast should be covered instead of a credit - b/c credit isn’t sufficient for two adults at these prices, especially if you order up to your room (Covid). King size bed seemed smaller than usual. Overall: Definitely 5-Star and would return during warmer months to enjoy the pool.

reviews.title: Luxurious Resort
reviews.text: The Four Seasons Las Vegas occupies a portion of the upper floors of Mandalay Bay. As you might expect, it is a very nice and luxurious Hotel. Due to COVID-19 we were able to book the room at a very low rate.  Note that there is a $45 per day resort fee on top of the room rate.We stayed in a standard room. The room was fine and nicely appointed, but it was a little on the small side. The bed was very comfortable, and the room was very clean. I especially liked the shower setup in the bathroom, and I liked the separation of the sink area from the toilet area.One disappointment is that rooms do not come with a refrigerator. Instead, there is a fully stocked mini-bar, which we do not need. I did request a refrigerator, and the staff delivered one to the room. However it was on a beat up cart and not exactly in the greatest condition.The hotel only offers valet parking. However, you can park at the Mandalay Bay self parking. Getting to the lobby is a bit of a trek as you have to cross over the convention center, but once you're checked in and have a keycard, you can enter from the casino level which greatly shortens the walk. We had no problem spending two days going back and forth to the self-park garage and avoided having to pay and deal with the hassle of valet parking. Overall, the Four Seasons Las Vegas is a very nice hotel. It is very clean and well-appointed, and service is exceptional. The rooms generally offer good views, though mostly we could see the airport and the southern portion of the strip.  You will definitely enjoy your stay.  However,  I can't imagine staying at this hotel under normal room rates.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: This hotel is perfect for a Vegas visit, but even more if you want to escape the craziness of the strip.  It's not 'walkable' distance by some standards, but if you're just leisurely walking and taking up time then yes.  If you want to be in the mix and middle of all the action stay elsewhere.  However, I walked around a lot of different hotels on the strip and none compared.  If I returned to Vegas, I'd gladly do whatever I needed to do and retrieve to the FS.  The hotel entrance is next to Mandalay Bay and I didn't know the setup before I got there... so the FS is on the top 5 floors of the Mandalay Bay building/tower.  The entrance, parking, lobby etc are separate and unless you go to a specific level you can't reach Mandalay Bay or interact with the guests of that hotel.  But the FS guests do have access to that hotel.  The service is top notch! every single person we encountered from the front desk and door staff, as well as the attendants by the pool referred to us by name Mr. and Mrs., always friendly and asking if they could help with anything.  That is the type of service one would expect at any hotel, but especially this one.The grounds are immaculate.  The courtyard outside the lobby was beautiful decorated and perfect for a night under the stars.  The pool was very relaxing and enjoyable, the service and food were also great there.  I didn't see any restaurants open but they do offer room service.  The choices are a bit limited but it helps to have it and not be forced to go out.  The food was good, not great and again, it's fine if someone just wants to stay in.  I don't think this hotel has a casino either, but I was glad.   Access to the Mandalay Bay casino is available should one wish.  The bed is super comfortable, the room we had was tastefully decorated and the view was amazing.  If you are looking for luxury, great service and peaceful surroundings in the chaos of Vegas then this is the place.  I absolutely recommend it and would stay there again without question.

reviews.title: Personal touch
reviews.text: We were traveling with young kids and the four seasons went out of their way to make out kids feel at home. When we arrived there were small small gifts in the guest room that distracted the kids and made them feel at home. In the restaurants the staff had patience and treated the kids as kids. They could really just be kids. And this made our stay really easy.

reviews.title: Luxury!
reviews.text: My husband and I had been to Utah, and decided to stop in Vegas on our way home. We have never stayed here, and wanted to try a quiet, non casino hotel. What can I say , it is gorgeous .  Started off with the Bellman /Valet Capt. Kirk, and Gaminj!  Attentive and so nice . Excellent staff all the way around . Temps taken upon arrival which I appreciate . Everyone , and I mean everyone went above and beyond with service. Our suite was luxurious, quiet, and so clean . Beds amazing ! Bathroom gorgeous ! Such a top notch hotel. My husband and I travel all over the world, and this hotel is on the top of our list ! Thanks for a great stay !

reviews.title: Wonderful hotel
reviews.text: The Four Seasons Hotel Las Vegas was a wonderful haven in busy Las Vegas. We chose this hotel because we wanted a non-casino and non-smoking hotel. It is attached to the Mandalay Bay, but you'd never know. It even has it's own separate entrance. Because it sits on top of the Mandalay Bay, you do have easy access to the Mandalay Bay casino and additional dining options. We used this a few times and it was very convenient. The hotel was close enough to the strip to enjoy all the fun, but our favorite part was coming back and enjoying our quiet and comfortable room. We stayed for 3 days in a Strip View King  and we were surprised at how spacious and comfortable it was. The bathroom was also very large. The beds, linens and pillows were very comfortable as well. Customer service is always number one at a Four Seasons Hotel, but it always amazes me how they go above and beyond. The staff was absolutely incredible and we had great interactions with everyone we came in contact with! They even sent us a special anniversary treat to enjoy when hearing that we were there to celebrate our 10 year anniversary. We utilized valet parking, room service and even enjoyed relaxing massages at the spa. Because of COVID, the hotel took great measures to make sure we were safe. All staff and guests wore masks, they took daily temperature readings at the hotel and even provided personal sanitation wipes/gel and masks. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone traveling to Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Fantastic stay at the Las Vegas Four Seasons
reviews.text: Took the grandkids for a quick fall break.     The staff went above and beyond to make my grandkids welcome.  Play tent set up in our room was a great surprise.  The staff gave teddy bears and even wrote their names on the bathtub.  Childrens robes And child toiletries were ready and waiting when we arrived. The pool area is beautiful and serene.   Water was heated just right.  Pool attendant graciously set up our lounge chairs every day and provided endless towels for the kidos who were in out of the pool.  Treats were even passed out at the pool.  FYI Four Seasons hotel guests have privileges at all the Mandalay Bay pools. Food at Veranda was great.  It is open from 6am to 3pm.  Press is serving dinner out on the patio and in the lobby.  My family very much enjoyed eating dinner outside on the beautiful patio and then having dessert by fire pit.Another pulse is it is all non-smoking.  Also no gaming but if you want to gamble Mandalay Bay casino is easily accessible.They still have valet parking which made my stay that much easier.The staff and the service can not be beat.  The Las Vegas Four Seasons is a beautiful hotel.  I very much enjoyed my stay there and felt rested after my stay.  Where else in Vegas can you say that.PS - You must see the poodle made from crayons.

reviews.title: Every Moment was Perfection!
reviews.text: This wasn't my first stay at The Four Seasons in Las Vegas, we have probably stayed a half dozen times. We checked in the day after the property opened, 9/26. Every single moment was pure perfection. The bellman, the door greeter that took our temp and asked the standard COVID questions, the front desk associate and the GM. Everyone of those greeted us with appreciation and excitement. I took my teenage daughter and my BFF brought her two children. We needed a vacation badly and the FS Vegas did not disappoint. Our room was perfect, a strip view studio suite. Spacious, clean, well appointed and comfortable. The FS beds are like no other. If you haven't ever experienced one of these, you must. Pure luxury. We spent our days poolside and were pampered by our usual pool servers, both have been working at that pool for 20+ years. Both ladies are beyond amazing. The pool guy that helped with umbrellas, water and towels was so helpful as well. I cannot say enough about the service and this property. One million percent amazing. Thank you!

reviews.title: Above and Beyond in every possible way!
reviews.text: Four Seasons made my first trip to Las Vegas fabulous!  From the moment we arrived to the moment we had to leave, we felt like truly special guests.  The staff is second to none - The Manager - Ilsa, Concierge - Marama, the fantastic Pool Staff - Zlata and others went above and beyond to offer every accommodation possible before we even needed to ask.  The gorgeous hotel is sparkling clean and the Covid precautions were very well implemented while not overly invasive.  We loved the tranquility of the beautiful pool (and the 'breakfast in bed' trays!) each morning and the peaceful reprieve after touring each day.  I cannot say enough about this outstanding Hotel. We HIGHLY recommend Four Seasons Las Vegas!

reviews.title: An Island of Tranquility
reviews.text: My wife and I had the pleasure of staying here on reopening night as well as the next day.  We actually weren't supposed to stay here, as we originally booked a Panoramic Penthouse at Delano.  However, they overbooked and tried to "upgrade" us to a larger yet inferior suite.  We cancelled that stay, walked through Mandalay Bay and decided to stay with Four Seasons instead.  That was a wise choice.  The experience at Four Seasons was like night and day compared to Delano.  FS staff were all extremely polite, helpful and kind.  You could tell they all loved being back to work and helping guests again.  Thanks to the great check in staff we were able to secure a Sunrise Sunset Suite at a fair price.  This suite features views of The Strip, the stadium, and the mountains/pool/airport.   The suite itself has beautiful, expensive furnishings done in an art deco style with a modern twist.  It was clean and comfortable.  Was offered champagne at check in, which we accepted and enjoyed on our way to our suite.  There were a few minor issues with the suite that were related to the hotel being closed for so many months but were quickly addressed.  Again, you could tell that the staff really cared.  How a business handles problems is a reflection of the company's culture.  Four Season's is exceptional.  What is also exceptional is the water pressure in the shower which is the best in Vegas, the same with the Bulgari Au de Vert toiletries.  They lather well and smell very nice.  The view was also beautiful.  One night we went to sleep with the curtains openly, and fell asleep to the twinkling lights of Vegas.  I would suggest adding another lamp in the bedroom and perhaps in the living room.  I like mood lighting but the option for a bit more light would be helpful at times.  Had breakfast en-suite, room service is now 6 AM - 10 PM, FYI, however, the quality of the food and the presentation has not declined.  Everything was warm and tasty.  Note, they offer three types of room service. 1.) Traditional where it is set out for you on your dining table if you have it.  This is the option we chose .2.) Left outside your room on a cart.  3.) Put into a to-go container.  The wonderful thing about Four Seasons Las Vegas is the fact that while you can easily experience the craziness, the FS itself is like an island of peace and tranquility.  You don't have guests racing scooters through the hotel or acting loud and obnoxious.  Guests here are truly better.  This was a spur of the moment last minute stay for my wife and I and I am glad that thanks to circumstances beyond our control, we ended up at Four Seasons despite it costing more money.  It was money well spent.

reviews.title: The Four Seasons is Open!
reviews.text: Being that this is my favorite hotel in Las Vegas I had to come visit opening weekend. It did not disappoint.  They take all safety precautions from taking your temperature upon check in  to sanitizing pool lounges.  It was wonderful to see all the staff is back. I enjoyed being pampered in my quite oasis.  5 Stars!

reviews.title: My Favourite Hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: I stay here because the Four Seasons has no casino which will inherently be cleaner, more peaceful and less tourists. Wherever in the world, the Four Seasons has great reliable service. The rooms are spacious and modern. They think of everything. Dining options are not bad and the amenities are perfect. I stay here every time.

reviews.title: Fantastic service!
reviews.text: I’ve stayed at many Four Seasons locations across the world and this one is fantastic.  Rooms are very updated and clean, you have a few options for food and beverage, and the pool service is great.I highly suggest the steakhouse inside the hotel as well as the breakfast place.  Caution - buffet is fantastic when they run it.Finally, they have a great place to have drinks at in the lobby.

reviews.title: Always Impeccable
reviews.text: It's long overdue for a review of one of my favorite places anywhere, the Four Seasons Las Vegas. We were there just before the national shutdown started, and like always, were treated like royalty. We've been coming on business for a number of years, and it's such a treat to be greeted by name and have your favorite martini at check in!From the rooms to the Impeccable service, the standard for which all hotels should aspire!

reviews.title: The Best Hotel In Las Vegas
reviews.text: This Hotel was wicked!!! The rooms are very clean, There are great water pressure in the shower and a giant flatscreen TV. It comes with a small minibar and glass cups. They have many great restaurant.

reviews.title: Great spot in LV
reviews.text: We stayed here over Christmas (2019) and chose the property because it’s the only none Casino hotel. In reality it’s on the same site as the Mandalay Bay, but the moment you enter the FS, you are in a sanctuary away from it all. We had one of their one bedroom suits which was fabulously spacious with the most gorgeous bathroom. As typical for FS, the bed was super comfortable and the service great all around. I’ve been to Vegas multiple times and I would now only want to stay at the FS. It’s great value too!

reviews.title: Restaurant not great but all else well
reviews.text: Came here with some buddies on a weekend trip to LV. Everything about the hotel was great. Standard luxury.I knock off one star because the restaurant wasn’t great. Overpriced for the food quality you get, and the proportion sizes are unnecessarily large. I’m a pretty big guy, too, and I was feeling stuffed just after my appetizer.Hotel’s fine, but avoid the restaurant.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, incredible service!
reviews.text: Our family of four (children ages 13 and 10), stayed at the Four Seasons for our Spring Break trip last week! While I've been to Vegas many times, this was my first time at Four Seasons. We chose the hotel at the recommendation of our travel agent so our children would not have to enter a casino to get to the rooms! It was the PERFECT place for us to stay - quiet and peaceful! We had two adjoining rooms and loved that setup! Also, did I mention the service? Just what you'd expect from Four Seasons. My name was used the entire time I was there! And, upon check-in, the manager came to greet us. I told her our flight was delayed and I was worried we weren't going to make our dinner reservation. She immediately said, "I'll have our concierge call right now and have that reservation moved back an hour for you. Is 7:00 convenient" In 2 minutes, the reservation was changed and we were on our way! From BEGINNING to END, this was the PERFECT experience (even with COVID-19 craziness). Four Seasons can't be beat!

reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.text: So if you are looking for a laid back casino/hotel that isn't as busy as they other resorts then this is your place. It is modern enough with all of the luxuries that you aren't missing anything. It just doesn't have a fancy catch theme. I personally think there are better casinos to gamble in. But overall nice quiet place to stay.

reviews.title: An Exceptional Hotel.
reviews.text: What an experience!  World class service, super clean rooms and a great nights sleep. When you look at the nightly rate it seems pricey but when you stay there you get to experience what the “royal treatment “ feels like. Worth every penny and we will definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Stunning and Relaxed
reviews.text: With so many of the major hotels in Vegas full to bursting with tourists and gamblers, The Four Seasons was a peaceful escape. Stunning views of the Strip from our 35th floor suite and a huge amazingly comfortable bed gave us the perfect base to recharge and keep our long days on track.

reviews.title: Good option in Vegas
reviews.text: The infrastructure is great, but the hotel is located far from most touristic sites in the strip. Limited dining-snack options. The rooms are well kept, and the ammenities were fine. Good wifi connection. Uneventful checkin-out.

reviews.title: Simply the Beat
reviews.text: Hotel is always great, but the staff is over the top. You feel welcomed and they care. Thank you team! I look forward to my next stay.The best part is that the hotel is non-smoking (real non-smoking).

reviews.title: Best place to stay in Vegas - Hands Down!
reviews.text: I've stayed at Four Seasons properties around the world and been to over 80 countries. Let me say that this is among the best I've experienced. Pros:Very Quiet (rare in Vegas)Excellent food and brunch and room serviceSpacious rooms with wonderful comfort and great bedsGreat wifi in the rooms and lobbyAwesome gift shopWonderful spa and nail salonGreat public art collection and interior decorIncredible views no matter what room you have as the hotel starts on floor 34The best concierge staff I've ever encounteredValets and bellmen who are professional AND personableCons:No wifi for FS guests at the shareable pool at Mandalay BaySpa facilities aren't accessbile after spa closing via a room key. Most FS do allow this. No slippers in the rooms...first time I've ever seen that at a FS. **This will 100% be where I stay every time I'm in Las Vegas and even though I don't love Vegas, this makes me want to go more just to stay here and experience the awesome service. The management team of Shruti, Scott, Daniel and Austin are incredible and exceeded any and all expectations. I recommend asking for any of them!**

reviews.title: Great relaxing Las Vegas stay
reviews.text: We had a great room on the 38th??  floor I think.  We use to stay at the Mandarin Oriental but with the sale to Waldorf/Hilton didn’t like the reviews from past guests.  We have stayed at several four seasons properties and like them all this one doesn’t disappoint.  We have stay here twice in the last three months and will be back again soon.  Highly recommend this property.  From the lobby to the room every space is in great shape and the staff are very helpful and attentive.  You won’t regret you choice to stay at the Four Seasons Las Vegas. It is our new go to hotel on the strip.

reviews.title: The BEST Hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: It is hard to contain my enthusiasm about the place that feels like my home away from home when we are in Vegas. The level of service and care taken by everyone is first rate and consistently excellent. A special shout out to the people that took exceptional care of my family and my son (who took ill on the way there): Shruti, Alayna, Kyle, and the rest of the Front Desk staff. You were all AMAZING, and our family has such gratitude for the warmth and hospitality. I should probably let people know about the rooms and hotel too... The rooms are nice, contemporary, clean and comfortable. The Four Seasons bed is divine, as always. Press is a great place to have a relaxing cocktail, and I actually had a super delicious filet there on a Sunday when everything else was closed. Truly, this is a place that far exceeds comfort and expectations.

reviews.title: Great location and hotel within walking distance to convention center
