reviews.text: The two of us stayed at the Four Seasons for one night in September:  spectacular!  For mostly business and some pleasure trips over the last few decades, I have been in Vegas at least 30 or are times...staying at Bellagio, MGM, NYNY, Paris, etc....as a result of our customers wanted. But the Four Seasons blows them away in terms of care, design, comfort, service...a great hotel.  Yes it is in the top five/six floors of the Mandalay Bay Hotel but it has a separate entrance, lobby, elevators, common spaces, restaurants, rooms, etc.  And you can use the elevator to exit at the "C" level just above the lobby and get to the gaming center of Mandalay Bay.We were just blown away at the "specialness" of the Four Seasons.  We will always use them on return visits to Las Vegas.  Further, we recommend the Four Seasons totally with no reservations.

reviews.title: Still a nice place, but lots of loud children by the pool and facilities
reviews.text: We have stayed here a couple of times.  This is still probably the nicest and most tranquil hotel on the strip now that the Mandarin Oriental is gone.  Our room on our most recent stay was starting to show it’s age, but still quite enjoyable.  The biggest issue is that the pool, restaurant, etc was full of screaming misbehaving children and their discourteous parents.  The Four Seasons staff had no control and didn’t seem to care that these groups were ruining their other guests stay.  We are not sure where to stay on our next adults-only trip to Las Vegas bowls now.

reviews.title: Wanted To See It For Future Visit
reviews.text: We are big fans of Four Seasons in Europe and the US.  I really couldn't figure out how this hotel factored into the Mandalay Bay even after reading the reviews, so we took a cab down there.  What was more confusing was we were told it was a stand alone hotel not connected to the Mandalay Bay.  I knew at one point it did occupy the top floors but thought maybe they built a stand alone hotel since I last checked several years ago.It is in fact part of the Mandalay Bay but a has  its' own entrance, elevator, and lobby.  So it still occupies several top floors of the Mandalay Bay. We liked that there is a security guard stationed at the elevators to be sure only Four Season guests enter.  We asked to see the rooms and they got one of their staff to show them to us.  Just lovely, with great views.  You can request a strip view or the airport which is literally right  there.  They have their own pool as well, just for Four Season guests, but you can use the Mandalay gigantic pool if you want.  We heard there was a secret door to the casino at the Mandalay Bay, and we probably took it to get to the casino, but could not find it to get back to the Four Seasons.  That is another plus if you want a non-smoking, non-gaming hotel.  You can always go to the Mandalay Bay to gamble.  This Four Season fits the bill for us.  That is where we will stay when we return.  Also, has a house car to take you to the strip, not to return, but to get you there.  Uber/Lyfte can also pick you up right outslde the front door,  unlike the pick-up areas at  bigger hotels, which  seem to be in the hot garage areas. The one at the Venetian was a far walk through the hot garage then standing and waiting.  We chose to take a cab instead which was easier to get as there are so many out front. Still hot, but easy to get with the valet keeping things moving quickly at the cab stand.

reviews.title: 5-star
reviews.text: This hotel does not have a casino in the lobby.  We don't gamble so this was a plus.  The casino is on level C and is shared with the Mandalay Bay.  The pool was so nice.  We enjoyed the restaurants.  I loved the spa.  I also loved that the room was on the 36th floor.  We were pleased!

reviews.title: One of the best times in Las Vegas
reviews.text: My family and I recently spent a long weekend at the Four Seasons.  We have gone to Vegas on a number of occasions and had stayed at casino hotels in the past including the Bellagio and never have we had a better time then we did on this trip.The best part was the hotel was separate from the casino and felt like staying at a true five star hotel without the Vegas mayhem.  We got the benefit of the Mandalay casinos and restaurants but could retreat to our own world in the Four Seasons.Check in was friendly and effortless.  We book a one room suite and was quickly on our way after being warmly greeted when we pulled in to the private drive of the hotel.  The room was amazing, perfectly clean, roomy and functional.  The bed was heavenly and the twice daily maid service kept everything spotless and well supplied.The hotel has its own pool so no fighting for chairs and searching for service.  You walk out and the attendants set up everything for you, bring you water and come by to check on you frequently.  My son loved spending lots of time at the pool and it was a pleasure with all the service.The concierge helped us a number of times, on the four seasons app you can just chat and ask for reservations and they handle it, need a car they handle it, everything on your phone, loved it !As we were checking out, everyone checked with us to see if we had a great stay, our car was ready out front and everything was loaded.  A real personal experience well worth it.  We will definitely return !

reviews.title: bad internet service
reviews.text: not many amenities..internet service horrible and staff pretends to fix..no restaurant and far walk to rooms..rooms need to be refurnished and modernized..old, dated bench at end of bed..no complimentary hotel coffee

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: We stayed just for a quick weekend getaway.  Definitely will be coming back.  The resort as always was very Clean, fun and relaxing .  Room service was excellent.  Massages at the spa were great.  Overall a good experience.

reviews.title: Gamble free hotel
reviews.text: Beautiful and very clean hotel with professional staff who made sure our accommodations were of the highest quality. My overall experience was good, l arrived very early and the check in process was seamless.

reviews.title: Gable free hotel!!! Yes!
reviews.text: This gamble free hotel is what you need in Vegas! Comfortably seated at the south end of the strip, it provides the full Four Seasons experience AND it is only 5 min away from the craziness- if you need it. Small but beautiful pool. Staff is a group of professionals who took customer service to the next level. Important to know that the hotel is attached to the Mandalay bay hotel, with a different entrance... but still.  If you are traveling with kids/teens this might be another advantage.

reviews.title: Never Disappointed
reviews.text: This was our second stay at the Four Seasons Las Vegas Resort.  It's the only Vegas property we stay where we can avoid the craziness and relax.  The staff, rooms and service are perfect - highly recommended.

reviews.title: Helpful staff
reviews.text: Stayed at Delano.Reason for review of Four Seasons is the treatment my wife and I received in a time of need.After walking out in front of Mandalay Bay to gauge how far the Welcome to L. V.  sign might be, we decided to walk it and maybe catch the Deuce back. What a mistake!!!After about ten to minutes of strolling in the 9:30 A.M. sun my wife (a fit sixty something) was overcome by the heat and unrelenting sun. Our first option was a police station RIGHT THERE, but it was closed. We sat for about five minutes and she said she was making a bit of a comeback so we made our way back to Mandalay.On our way back we saw the exit from the Four Seasons and walked against (light) traffic to find the valet/taxi area. The staff there couldn't have been more helpful to us insisting she sit and have a couple bottles of water and just finding herself. We pointed out that we were staying at Delano and they were glad to lead us in the right direction.If I remember correctly there was a doorman, a valet, and a bell person.This is our way of saying THANK YOU! And we know the people staying at the Four Seasons are very lucky indeed!

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Four Seasons Las Vegas. We had a strip-view room on the 37th floor, which provided an excellent view of the strip and the desert. Be aware that part of your view may include the airport - but the sound-proofing was excellent, so this didn't impair our enjoyment of our stay. The service was top-notch, room-service was among the best we've ever had. We'd highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Business trip Las Vegas Four Seasons
reviews.text: I cannot compliment this property enough.  The minute you walk in you know your experience is going to be a good one.  The personnel is exceptional on all levels and the service received was second to none.  Food, pool, rooms, and atmosphere was so nice I hated to leave.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is gorgeous, clean, up to date and well appointed. The staff was excellent. The shower and tub combo in the room was a great touch. The mini bar was expertly stocked. The furnishings were beautiful and comfortable.

reviews.title: Just a great stay
reviews.text: Visited Vegas many times but first time with the family, we opted for Four Seasons at it seemed to offer access to Vegas with a family friendly exit option when you just wanted a high end resort. To that end, they’ve got it spot on, walking back into the oasis that’s the 4S always felt welcoming and relaxing after the strip.The positives - The staff - we were at the hotel for 5 nights, at the end of our stay it seemed as if everyone knew our names and recognised us with a smile.  We always felt welcomed back to the hotel and the service from the pool team was absolutely top notch. Couldn’t fault the service or how engaged the team are here - The pool - the 4S pool area is relatively small but we never struggled to get four loungers together with some in the shade.  Good options of food and drink at reasonable prices, our kids loved having access to the Mandalay Bay pool complex with wave pool and lazy river.  It was always nice to get back to the more tranquil 4s pool though.- Restaurants - we only eat at the pool and the Verandah (breakfast and dinner).  Good options, good quality and well priced, service was great in all of them- Room - we had an executive suite facing the strip, room was plenty big enough for the four of us and immaculately maintained.  The maid service was top notch, even down to putting ties on our iPhone cables to keep things neat and cleaning sunglasses then leaving a sunglass cloth.  My tips for the maid kept increasing throughout the trip, really above and beyondImprovementsThe one spin bike in the gym had a slipping saddle and no-one would tighten the bolt required to fix it due to ‘liability issues’.  I offered to tighten it myself if someone would give me a spanner.  The rest of the gym was spotless maintained with fresh towels and headphones always on the machines, but it was annoying to have the only spin bike out of action for the sake of one bolt.In summaryA great stay, the staff are a real asset to this hotel and we loved our time there.   It’s not often I look at a resort bill and don’t begrudge a penny of it, but this was one of those times.  It was great.

reviews.title: Relaxation in Las Vegas
reviews.text: If your looking for relaxation look no further the staff and facilities are amazing and nothing is to much trouble. The pool staff couldn’t do enough for us and made our days effortless. Pool food was amazing but just be warned of the portion sizes. One is enough for two people.

reviews.title: Our favorite hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: We are here at least annually and this is by far our favorite hotel to stay at. Great amenities, helpful staff, the room service quick and tasty and it quiet. The location is close to the airport and right at the top of the Strip. The beds are so comfortable and the rooms are very clean.

reviews.title: An Enjoyable Weekend in Las Vegas
reviews.text: My fiancée  and I enjoyed a weekend at the Four Seasons Hotel in Las Vegas.  We arrived Friday afternoon and were politely greeted by the parking valet, who handed off our luggage to a bell hop to be taken to our room.  We then checked into the hotel; there was only two people in line ahead of us.  Such a nice change from the usual Las Vegas experience of having to wander through the casino then wait in a long line before checking in.  The check in here was more typical of high end resort hotels I've stayed at in the past outside of Vegas.   Our deluxe room at the Four Seasons was fine.  It was large enough for us and decorated in contemporary fine furnishings.  The bathroom was large too.  We had an excellent dinner at the Charlie Palmer Steakhouse, which I will separately review.  We had the breakfast buffet each morning at the Veranda Restaurant.  They were okay, but nothing special.  It was nice to be able to go easily to the casino, restaurants and shopping at the adjacent, Mandalay Bay Resort but then when we were done pass through an almost hidden locked door (which took us some effort to find the first time) into the empty quiet of the Four Seasons elevator lobby.  We enjoyed a couple of hours on the hot Saturday afternoon relaxing in the Four Seasons pool, with staff keeping our thirst away with frozen margaritas.  The pool staff were exceptionally courteous and solicitous of our needs, particularly considering they didn't get to cool off in the pool like we did.

reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.text: I think this may have been my favorite hotel we have stayed in.  The staff were warm, helpful, and always trying to help us improve our stay without us asking.  The pool is a perfect oasis in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Great experience at Four Seasons LasVegas
reviews.text: I stayed at 4S for a week which included New Years Eve. My Family chose this hotel due to the competent rates compared to other hotels such as Bellagio and Venetian.I am impressed with all the amenities they offered from Spa services and massages, room service quality and presentation, to the L'Occitane soaps and shampoos (Bvlgari in the suites) was well beyond our expectations. Concierge services were prompt and curteous. Service in the Verandah restaurant was slow and the menu limited, our busboy told us that is always a major concern and that the restaurant is always understaffed (even in this season when the hotel is fully booked). All in all a good stay

reviews.title: Expectations Overexceeded
reviews.text: You usually expect above average service at premium hotels. My early arrival provided that my room was not available. I checked my luggage and went to my event. I got a text message that my room was available. After I replied that I would not be returning for 3 hours I got a phone call from the manager on duty telling me that they sent my luggage to my room and to stop by and pick up a key at my convenience. Nice touch!

reviews.title: Nice grounds and facilities
reviews.text: The Four Seasons Las Vegas is located within the grounds of the Mandalay Bay hotel. This can be both a good thing and, a not so great thing, depending on your preferences.The good thing is that the Four Seasons offers you all of the luxury and services of a true high end hotel. The "not so good" part is that, due to sharing the grounds with the Mandalay Bay hotel, it lacks a bit of the exclusive feel that you would normally find at a Four Seasons hotel. On the other hand, it does have it's own quieter grounds, while still offering access to the big casino type resort, so it really depends on what you're looking for in that sense.  The Four Seasons private pool area is rather small, although not at all lacking in services. The pool area at the Mandalay, which is accessible to guests staying at the Four Seasons, is huge, but also very crowded, as is the hotel, in general. All in all we had a wonderful experience at the Four Seasons Las Vegas. The rooms are large, clean and very comfortable. Great staff.

reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.text: We visited the Four Seasons this week and had the most amazing stay. Upon check in they had left Teddies and kids toiletries for our children.  The rooms and grounds are immaculate. Access to Mandalay Bay lazy river and wave pool was an extra bonus to keep our boys entertained.There is no casino in the resort which means it is smoke free. We visited all the other hotels on the strip and were always relieved to return to the family friendly Four seasons.Best of all is the amazing service that we received from everyone in the resort. It was world class. Some of the little touches in our room were fabulous.Thank you four seasons.

reviews.title: Excellent quiet business hotel but not outstanding like other Four Season's hotels
reviews.text: This review is the subjective opinion of an individual traveller and not of Tripadvisor LLC nor of its partners. Tripadvisor performs checks on reviews as part of our industry-leading trust & safety standards. Read our transparency report to learn more.

reviews.title: Best choice for non-casino hotels
reviews.text: We visited LV although we do not like gambling at all. The atmosphere of large casino hotels in particular. Having said this, the FS LV is definitely a great choice. Very quiet although located in the middle with easy access to Mandalay Bay and the strip.  Nice view on the strip (see pic taken from our room). Good service, nice pool area. Negative: Breakfast brim over without any relaxing atmosphere which you would expect at such a location and at such a price. Although they “normally” offer buffet only during weekends ( we stayed Monday - Thursday), they switched to buffet to help them manage the crowds somehow.

reviews.title: Exceptional Service
reviews.text: From our arrival to our departure our stay at the Four Seasons Las Vegas was exceptional. Upon our arrival we experienced no lines.  We are personally greeted and our requests are considered and acted on.  The rooms are clean and well decorated.  The service is beyond excellent.  The staff attends to our every needs and the level of excellence extends to our departure.

reviews.title: Great family place
reviews.text: Great non gambling and non smoking option. Pool was not overly crowded. I do wish the pool was open later than 7 pm. All staff we encountered were friendly and helpful. We will definitely stay there on our next trip.

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: Love a little staycasion at this place. Great dinning options, shows and pool. This is a must stop hotel in Vegas. I will be back soon for another amazing stay. Rooms are great with beautiful views of the entire strip.

reviews.title: Top Hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: I've been to Vegas a few times now, this is by far the best five star hotel I've stayed at in Vegas. As others have commented having access to the Mandalay Bay pools and facilities were superb, myself and wife could stay in the private pool of the Four Seasons whilst our teenage daughters used the Mandalay. Beautiful rooms, great beds and really nice large bathrooms. What impressed me most was the staff, they were excellent throughout the hotel. A particular mention to Gabriel the pool life guard, during his breaks he would spend time chatting and suggesting activities within the area. Having polite staff like this is the back bone of any five star hotel globally, I will only ever stay here again when in Vegas

reviews.title: It’s Not Vegas.  It’s a Four Seasons That Happens To Be In Vegas.
reviews.text: One of the few hotels in the world that is consistent around the world.  This one takes you out of the noise and heat and crowds of Vegas. Like an oasis in the middle of the original oasis.  And the staff is as amazing as every other Four Seasons! I’m

reviews.title: Always A Sure Bet
reviews.text: My absolute favorite hotel in Las Vegas and in my opinion the best. The service is wonderful. It is an oasis from the rest of the hotels and casino's where I find peace and quiet. The food at Verandah is wonderful. The pool is the perfect size with friendly staff. The rooms are well appointed and the beds are the most comfortable I have ever slept in. Concierge service is beyond compare. Nothing they cannot do.

reviews.title: Stunning Four Seasons quality!
reviews.text: I love the Four Seasons because they never disappoint, delivering levels of service and quality others aspire to.We chose this particular stay, as the lack of casino on the property really appealed (there is more than enough of madness on the strip!) and for its position. Am so glad we did.Right from the valet parking start to the spa showers departure, it delivered true 5 star quality all the way. The room was huge and furnished beautifully, with every detail considered. The bed was impossibly comfy, and the property offered true peace and quiet in Vegas when you need it, where else can say that?The staff were super friendly, warm and helpful- again, Four Seasons quality.The stand out star for me was the stunning pool area, probably the best I’ve ever encountered. Peace and serenity abound, and all the while facing the magnificent wall of gold that is the Mandalay Bay .What a vista!Just one small point, don’t bother visiting the aqua pool at the neighbouring hotel - even though complimentary- it’s a complete zoo, making you beat a retreat back to the confines of your private haven.The Four Seasons Las Vegas, is the city’s best kept secret, but I guess I’m sharing that now! Go stay and truly indulge in this wonderful vacation within a vacation.

reviews.title: Very nice, but...
reviews.text: While I normally stay at another very nice Vegas property, I decided to give the Four Seasons a try in late July/early August.  This is a nice property, there is no doubt about that.  Separate from Mandalay Bay, yet connected - offering the best of both worlds.  The spa/workout facility and pool were fantastic - as were the staff and general feel of the place.  The rooms felt dated though.  Lights were dim at best (in all areas of the suite) - only one single receptacle at base of lamp to plug in phone/watch/etc. (you get to pick only one) on each nightstand - manual curtains/drapes - all acceptable, but not up to what other properties offer.  My biggest gripe though, the bathroom/shower!  I/we stayed in a one-bedroom suite, which was nice and quite roomy - yet the bathroom only had one sink and possibly the smallest shower I've ever encountered in a high-end hotel suite (so small, that my girlfriend literally got out of the shower and into the tub to finish shaving her legs (she is 5'7'' and weighs around 110lbs - doesn't take up a lot of shower space)).  For that reason alone, I would not recommend this property even though I'd like to.  The rooms are plenty big enough - but the bathrooms need to be rethought and remodeled - hence the average rating on an otherwise very nice property....Gave sleep quality 3 stars due to suite being directly across from new Raiders stadium under construction (I usually prefer the mountain view over that of the strip - but not in this case) - lots of ambient noise at night coming from there.

reviews.title: A more peaceful stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel, staff were all very attentive. They took care of all of my family. This hotel is exceptional. You can have as much of Vegas as you want as it is connected to the Mandalay Bay. There is no casino in the Four Seasons so the stay is more peaceful.

reviews.title: Good hotel if you don't want to be in a casino
reviews.text: This hotel takes up the top 5 floors of Mandalay Bay with its own entrance, pool, spa, gym, restaurant and bar. You get the Four Seasons service with prices not much more than Mandalay was charging (at least when we went). There is a locked door with key pass to get directly to Mandalay casino if you want. They had security at the entrance to the hotel and elevators. I gave it 4 starts vs 5 mostly because the bar area is a bit weak and the rooms are not quite up to a lot of other Four Seasons resorts (still good though)

reviews.title: Don't use card for deposit/hold
reviews.text: I have been here multiple times before. Good hotel overall. The hotel used my card twice for the deposit apparently the first one failed they used it again and it worked but the bank is saying they're holding the amount twice. Therefore I'll have to wait for a month to get the wrongly holded amount back. I called the front desk about the issue so they can writee an email to get the wrongly holded amount back. The frontdesk lady was rude and told me I may have spent the discussed money somewhere else :). So I highly recommend paying in cash.

reviews.title: Favorite hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: Top quality hotel, of course. Total serenity without the noise and smoke of much of Vegas. At the far end of the strip but if you want to gamble, then there is access to Mandalay Bay on the2nd floor. The monorail also goes from Mandalay Bay to Excalibur.  I don't recommend leaving 4 Seasons though! Love the outdoor area and restaurant. The rooms have great views (even those without strip view) and the beds are very comfortable.

reviews.title: second visit - just as good!
reviews.text: this was our second stay at the four seasons and we weren't disappointed to return. The customer service is impeccable. we had a suite and the rest of our party had double rooms. our suite was spectacular. Large sitting room and bedroom with two washrooms. The location is it at the end of the strip which we prefer as it is a little quieter. You do not need to go through a noisy casino to reach the check-in desk, which is another plus for us. pool area is small but really lovely, we had a cabana for a couple of days which was a real treat. we like the frozen fruit delivered to you by the pool. breakfast was busy in the restaurant but there is a small coffee bar in reception which was ample. ate one night in the restaurant and it was good but to be honest there is so much to choose from on the strip you are spoilt for choice. we would highly recommend this hotel and i will be our choice again when we return to vegas.

reviews.title: Four Seasons at it's best!
reviews.text: The Four Season's prides on customer service! We stayed 4 nights for leisure and honesty we could have stayed in our room the entire time. It was so peaceful and relaxing. Looking forward to a future stay.

reviews.title: Pretty good nice luxury rooms
reviews.text: Good location as is at the quieter end of town so suited us. Bit of a mission to get everywhere but good so you can see everything but it is far from everything. Service great expensive though.traffic full on so tram it from mandalay bay.

reviews.title: OK
reviews.text: Rooms are spacious, I love the fact that we could access the Mandalay Bay as we were on the 35th floor. However at around 2am I had to call the front desk to have a handy man fix the ceiling of the bathroom which was leaking!As I saw all the cirque du soleil show I was advised by the lady at the concierge of the Four Seasons, an extremely disappointing  show named Absinthe. I was told that if I could laugh about myself by the concierge, it was a show for me!! It was just such a cheap and tasteless show! I was so extremely disappointed that I left after an hour the show started! Luckily I was recommended to 2 wonderful ones, Janet Jackson and Criss Angel!! Which made up for the lousy one.

reviews.title: Best hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: As mention many times, with Four Seasons you will never go wrong!The property is really nice despite is part of the Mandala bay hotel.In this occasion the FS Las Vegas it looks like more as a boutique hotel compared with the huge properties in LS.It is definitely the best hotel in Las Vegas, the FS service is incredible and impeccable, the food was very nice at he restaurant, and the pool service was outstanding!Very nice Spa facilities! If you want experience real luxury in Las Vegas you must go to the Four Seasons!I will definitely coming back!Thank you!

reviews.title: I've never had a perfect stay at a Hotel!
reviews.text: So many of the hotels on the Strip claim to be 5 Star properties, but Four Seasons LV truly is one!!! I work for a meeting planning company, so I do a lot of traveling throughout the year. This stay is one to remember!  Service was impeccable!!! Everyone from bellman, pool service, front desk, Press bar, Veranda Restaurant and everyone we ran into was charming, sincere and very hospitable. Also, the food was amazing! In fact, the best I’ve ever had in a hotel and I have traveled too many! I can’t forget to mention the Four Seasons Beds… wonderful!!!It was also so nice to get away from the casino yet you still have access to one with a connecting private door. If you are looking for a very nice comfortable hotel on the strip, this is the one!

reviews.title: Certified Smacking
reviews.text: Four Seasons hotels SMACK. It was the most smacking experience I've ever experienced. Hotel smacked, staff smacked, the food most definitely smacked... It was just a smacking experience and I cannot wait to visit there again!

reviews.title: Four seasons las Vegas
reviews.text: First of all,  four season hotel is within the Mandelay Bay hotel. It takes few floors of the building. It has its separate entrance.You can access the pool and the facilities of the Mandalay via the the four seasons. For example if you want to go to the casino just press level C on the elevator.I really enjoyed my stay at the four seasons hotel. The room was amazing and big enough. The staff are very attentive and helpful.I was passing by the reception area of one of the major resorts and saw the long lines of checkin and just thought thank God I am staying at the four seasons.The only thing I would suggest is to do something about the noise coming from the glass. I could hear the music from the pools downstairs. But it was not something that bothered me.

reviews.title: an oasis in Vegas
reviews.text: Great for families who don't want the casino part of Vegas in your faces all the time.  Service is amazing, and access to various pools is great.  Guest services easily accommodated our early arrival and had cookies ready for us.  Dinner/breakfast at the hotel restaurant was tasty.

reviews.title: Georgeous Hotel
reviews.text: I cannot speak highly enough about this hotel. My 2 teenage boys and I had 3 nights recently towards the end of a 3 week stay in Western USA and it is probably the loveliest hotel I have stayed in for at least 10 years.  Without any Casino floor in the lobby it's an oasis of calm, understated relaxing luxury with charming attentive staff who genuinely care about your guest experience. 100% recommend.

reviews.title: Best Vegas Hotel!
reviews.text: This hotel is the best in Vegas. No casino (but a direct entrance to the Mandalay Bay casino if that’s something you’re into), a more boutique hotel feel amongst Vegas’ massive properties. The pool is very well maintained with plenty of spots to lay out. Service is some of the best I’ve ever experienced anywhere. They really go above and beyond to make your experience positive (I.e. a little cake waiting in our room for my birthday, and pool side chocolate covered strawberries also for my birthday...all of which were delivered impromptu and complimentary). If you want Vegas but without the craziness in the hotel, this is the best spot!

reviews.title: Outstanding Service
reviews.text: Expectations were set very high, it’s The Four Seasons and Las Vegas were service is everything. I was pretty disappointed the room was not available 1 hour after checkin time but after we decided to go elsewhere they very quickly rectified and overcompensated for the issue. From there everything was smooth sailing. Four Seasons staff was just outstanding. We typically stay at Wynn but I wanted the Mandalay amenities for kids and a place to skip away too once the Mandalay chaos was enough. This is hands down place to stay if you have kids since you get best of both worlds. Little touches at Four Seasons make this property stand out from others - shammies placed under you glass and sunglasses, frozen peppermint patties at the pool, water placed next to your bed at night, cookies for kids, a anniversary cake delivered to the room, a text on my phone before bed checking that things were good - I can go on but you get the point.  Pool services were a standout. Very well done Four Seasons staff. You still beat out the other guys on the strip and I can’t wait to come back.

reviews.title: Exquisite
reviews.text: We spent two nights at the Four Seasons in early May 2019.  The hotel occupies the upper floors of the same building as the Mandalay Bay, and connects at the lobby level, but it is separate from the Mandalay Bay and feels completely different.  One big plus is that the hotel is non-smoking throughout, something hard to find in Las Vegas.  Our room was beautifully appointed and appeared to have been recently renovated.  It had an impressive view.  The housekeeping was immaculate.Breakfast was served outdoors, delicious but expensive.  The prices are high, but you do indeed get what you pay for.  Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Our favorite place to stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: If you like us and are looking for privacy, relaxation and luxury, this is the best hotel in Vegas. The Four Seasons never disappoints. Heading back to our room after a long day is like a relaxing oasis! Not l like other hotel casinos with hundreds of people in the lobby and long lines at the desk. The restaurants are great, the pool is great and the spa is great. The proximity to Mandalay Bay Casino through what I like to call "the secret door" is also great. While it is not at the center of the strip, we actually prefer this so it is more quiet. They have a house car to transport you to anywhere on the Strip and you easily walk to Luxor, Excalibur without going outside and NY-NY and MGM with a short walk outside. I would highly recommend this 4S for vacation or for business.

reviews.title: An excellent hotel experience.
reviews.text: Worth it. Excellent hotel inside a hotel. All the large amenities of Mandalay Bay with none of the hassles like crowded check in, Grand Central valet area, mass crowds for buffets. Casino is in Mandalay so none of those folks roaming around the floors or lobby or pool of the Four Seasons property. Excellent experience.

reviews.title: luxury by the pool
reviews.text: The Las Vegas Four Seasons Hotel provides the ultimate in luxury service and accommodations in both the room and pool areas.  From the quiet rooms, high speed elevators, and comfortable beds to the thick towels and great poolside service, we felt like valued guests. We can't wait to return.

reviews.title: Ultimate privacy
reviews.text: We had a wonderful 4th of July weekend! The Four Seasons Las Vegas  staff is extremely attentive, caring and kind. The fireworks were amazing and the drinks at PRESS are fantastic! The food at the Veranda is so delicious! and the service is truly outstanding! The staff at the pool make everything nice! The SPA is wonderful! The service is Impeccable and so relaxing! Heather is such a caring therapist! Our housekeeping lady always kept our room so nice and clean! Her attention to detail showed all the time.We had the pleasure of meeting Ismar from room service! He is a true gem! He is been working for the Four Seasons for almost 29 years!We have a very special love with the Four Seasons; our most important events of our lives have been celebrated with you.Your high standards on service are always impecable!Four Seasons Las Vegas is truly a perfect getaway! It is a beautiful property! You can experience all the fun of Las Vegas in a very private way! No crowds and no constant slot machine sound!Thank you so much for an amazing weekend!See you next time!

reviews.title: One of a kind stay in Vegas.
reviews.text: I came to Las Vegas with my partner in June, 2019 for 6 nights. We were initially booked in a king room strip view, but when we checked in, we were given a special rate to upgrade to the Executive Suite on the top floor (39th floor). What an upgrade! Three times as big!My partner and I decided to stay with the Four Seasons after hearing and reading so many reviews about the property and how attentitive and personable the staff are. We are not gamblers or smokers, nor do we enjoy that kind of atmosphere, so staying on a non-smoking, non gaming property was huge for us. Especially since we were there for a week.I want to point out how impressed I am with house keeping. Always working around my schedule day or night to accommodate me and my partner, always coming by with fresh linens, turn down service and restocking our fridge. They pay attention to every detail, never missed a spot or made me think twice if the room was clean or not. One morning, I had my medication sprawled out on the table in addition to some personal belongings, and they organised it all so neatly for me! I didn't even mind that they touched it, but it was so kind of them to make it look nice for my arrival.There's one staff in particular I'd like to recognise for her hard work ethic, amazing personality and how much fun of a person she is. Her name is Zlata. She was our poolside attendant when we rented out Cabana One. She was extremely accomodating, always checking in our party to see if we needed cold towels, popsicles, drink orders or food. I felt like a prince! She is a huge reason why I will be returning the hotel (and the pool). If I was a business owner, I would definitely want her on my team. Please give her my regards!The restaurant dinner manager in the restaurant, Veranda, was absolutely wonderful. Unfortunately, I did forget his name but I was blown away by his knowledge on the dinner and drink menu. He stopped by our table on several occassions to check in with us and speak about how the dishes were made. The food was impeccable, and the service is excellent! I had one experience during my stay here. Fortunately, I didn't let it impact my stay, but I hope the Four Seasons can take this feedback to improve their service in the Valet department.Night-time valet attendant, Rob, was hostile, rude and abrupt to my party on three separate occassions over the course of two nights when we dropped off our car. The first time I let it slide, but the following two times I found it unacceptable especially for the amount I was paying to stay here. On that second night, I went back and forth to the hotel two times throughout the night. Both of those times, I was wearing the same outfit, arrived in the same car with the same people, and he still had the audacity to confront my party to question if we were guests of the hotel. Rob would ask questions such as "Are you a guest here?" or "Did you mean to go to Mandalay Bay" or "Are you lost?". Pulling up in a Range Rover, I'm certainly not lost.After my third interaction with Rob, I was livid. I've never been so upset with a hotel employee for making me feel unwelcomed. I thought this was supposed to be a tailored experience? I confronted him offering to provide my ID, and the reservation since he was so quick to assume I wasn't a guest. He said it wasn't necessary. It came to a point where I felt scared to use valet at night thinking I was going to be humilitated again. I hope valet can continue to improve.Despite my one bad experience, I still rate this hotel 5/5. I am looking forward to returning to the Four Seasons next time as I refuse to stay anywhere else now!As a seasoned travel agent, I strongly recommend staying here for a one of a kind experience in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Best Customer Service!
reviews.text: I love the consistency of the Four Seasons Customer Service.  They always surprise you with little extras, like frozen watermelon balls at the pool on a hot day.  The housekeeping department went above and beyond to meet my requests and the concierge was able to get us great last minute reservations.  The staff at Four Seasons exceed expectations in every way!  Thank you for a wonderful, relaxing stay!

reviews.title: Vegas without the “Vegas feeling”
reviews.text: Great way to experience Las Vegas without the constant noise and crowds of folks.  The coffee shop in the lobby has great drinks and quick snack.  Staff is like all other four seasons they are there for the right reason to make sure your stay is what you expect it to be.

reviews.title: Amazing Amazing
reviews.text: This was my second stay at this hotel. Every moment in my room was perfect. From check-in to details in the room- it was a gorgeous stay. The toiletries, the coffee, the sheets were just wonderful. The first stay I officiated a wedding there so was too nervous to really appreciate the stay. I savored each moment in the room. Vegas can be so overwhelming but the Four Seasons makes it so different. The pool was perfect and the service outstanding as well!

reviews.title: Predictably Classy and Perfect
reviews.text: The Four Seasons in Las Vegas is always predictably classy and perfect a cut above the rest including the Waldorf Astoria/Former Mandarin Oriental. It is in a class of its own, a cut above the others including Mandalay Bay, Aria, Cosmopolitan, Bellagio, Caesars Palace, The Venetian and The Wynn!

reviews.title: Just exceptional!
reviews.text: We have visited Las Vegas a number of times over the years but first time staying here.  I cannot recommend this place highly enough!  It is just exceptional!  The staff, the service, the rooms, the hotel in general - just everything.  Our room was perfectly appointed with welcome water and fruit when we arrived. Poolside service is amazing from making up your bed to the complimentary iced water, sunscreen and hourly treats - anything from frozen pineapple to mini muffins. The hotel itself is very well taken care of and staff are excellent too. Even upon departing we received a tray of chocolates wishing us Bon Voyage!  All of this personal service is simply unheard of in Las Vegas.  Thank you Four Seasons for an amazing stay!

reviews.title: These guys really give a @#$# about your needs
reviews.text: We love this hotel.  It is an oasis away from the maddening casino crowds and smoke.  The rooms are nice, the service outstanding and there is even a complimentary car service.  The concierges are amazing.  The poolside experience is as good as it gets ... hourly complimentary treats, fresh ice water constantly, delicious food.  The Wynne and  the Mandarin have more luxurious rooms bit this is my default hotel when I travel to Vegas.

reviews.title: One of the Best Four Seasons properties
reviews.text: The entire stay was perfect, from arrival to the rooms and the view. The hotel staff for exceptional throughout my stay. Location is a little away from the hustle of the strip so if you want the peace away this is the perfect place to stay.

reviews.title: Perfect stay!
reviews.text: It is a very good hotel. The staff is really friendly. And that’s why you feel welcome and comfortable straight away. The rooms are big and clean and luxerious. The pool is great and the pool staff is very kind👍At the Four Seasons they go the extra mile to make you as comfortable as possible.

reviews.title: Excellent room, without smoke, casinos or noise
reviews.text: I know, why be in Vegas if you hate smoke, casinos and noise? Because our tour of national parks ended here, that's why.This hotel is beautiful.  Artwork is amazing, service is attentive, rooms attractively appointed with everything you could need.  It was a bit of a hike to our room - 38th floor, room 330.  Almost in the Mandalay Bay but very quiet and nice.We had a great view of the Airport, right across the street - however, you don't hear any planes take off or land.  In addition, the air conditioning is terrific.  It has to be, it was over 100 degrees outside in early June.The hotel is located at the very edge of the "strip." Leave 15-20 minutes for your ride to the airport.  Although it is across the street, you have to drive all the way down one side, then turn and drive right back up to the airport.

reviews.title: Wonderful (smoke-free) stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Stayed in the Four Seasons with my 10-year-old daughter.  Great service, beautiful room (with art work I'd like to have in my own apartment), comfortable bed.  Daughter was thrilled with the cuddly bear she received at the end of our stay.

reviews.title: Excellent family Las Vegas hotel!
reviews.text: If you want Vegas without walking through casinos and smoke every time you go to your room and also excellent service and professional staff take a look at Four Seasons!Excellent hotel for family trips !!!

reviews.title: Oasis in vegas
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel, where you can forget Vegas exists, but it’s right in the middle of it when you want it! (Just press the c button in the elevator!). The decor in the room was a perfect mix of modern and contemporary.  The pool area with its waterfall fountain is a little oasis away from the craziness next door at manadaly bay (but just steps away if you want to enjoy the facilities there) Look forward to returning again someday,

reviews.title: Exceptional Property and Staff
reviews.text: We loved our stay at the Four Seasons in Las Vegas.  This is an exceptional property with a wonderful and attentive staff.  IF you are looking for a Las Vegas experience that departs from ordinary and provides exclusivity in the midst of all of the available entertainment, you should consider the Four Seasons.

reviews.title: Luxury personified
reviews.text: We stayed here for my birthday celebration. It was wonderful. The rooms are big and spacious. The bed is so comfortable you almost don't want to leave your room. The pool is luxurious and the staff is amazing. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.title: Another Fabulous Stay
reviews.text: The Las Vegas Four Seasons is the finest hotel in Las Vegas. The service, management, concierge, housekeeping, valet staff are all excellent. You will not fine better service or be treated better at any hotel. From greeting to departure every experience with the staff is exceptional. The rooms, pool, restaurants and common space are all beautiful. The one bedroom suite is a great room with plenty of space and wonderful views. The hotel does not have a casino but has easy access to the Mandalay Bay. Wonderful to enjoy the peace and quiet of a fine hotel and yet be so close to all Las Vegas has to offer. Special thank you to concierge Cheryllynn who was very helpful with suggestions and reservations and Four Seasons driver Tony who assisted us with airport transportation when we needed to depart early due to medical issue.

reviews.title: Wish I could stay longer
reviews.text: We stayed here as part of a tour and we were impressed.  So luxurious and comfortable.  Unfortunately we arrived late in the afternoon and left very early the following morning.  The bed was like sleeping on a cloud.  The bathroom was large, clean, had nice soaps/shampoo, super bright with a magnifying mirror.  Even though this hotel is large, the room was very quiet.  Downstairs where you check in was noisy since there seemed to be a party going on in the lobby, but once you take the elevator up, you would not know there was anybody else staying there.  Our view was of the airport, or pool depending where you looked.  Dinner that evening was held at the Desert Willow Room and the food was incredible.  We left at 3:45 a.m. and were given a breakfast bag to go.  I would love to come back when I could stay longer.

reviews.title: Perfect Sanctuary
reviews.text: We booked a suite here for three nights to kick start our road trip holiday. It was our first time visiting Las Vegas and we were so happy that the hotel provided a sanctuary to escape the madness. It's still super easy to get about town between the mono rail, cabs and ubers, and it was refreshing not to have to walk through a casino at times to get to our room which was pure luxury.100% would recommend. Comfiest bed ever too!

reviews.title: Pamper Yourself
reviews.text: Although this hotel is at the far end of the strip, it has benefits. To be away from the congestion makes dealing with Vegas easier to handle. We just took Ubers to shows and restaurants. Loved that there was no casino and few shops, The hotel occupies 5 floors in the Mandalay Bay Hotel but it has a separate entrance, pool, spa and restaurants, all elegant. Mandalay Bay does have a nice casino so we had that option. Loved the service at the pool. They had everything from sunscreen and constantly walk around filling your water pitcher and giving you frozen treats.We had breakfast at the Veranda restaurant with amazing service and food and dined on the patio and inside. The weekend buffet was scrumptious as well as the a la carte menu. The concierge,front desk and door staff were great.The hotel even has a private car, if your timing is good catching it, that will take you up to 3 miles from the hotel.One night we did not even have to leave the property - dinner at Charlie Palmer, then the Michael Jackson One show at Mandalay and finally a visit to the Skyfall Lounge to view the city at night.Our only disappointment was not getting a room facing the strip. We, instead, faced the desert mountains and the air field. So make sure to request when you book.This is now the only hotel we will stay in Vegas, far from the madding crowd.

reviews.title: Unexpected serene gem in Vegas!
reviews.text: This is my second stay here. I love this hotel because it is at the end of the strip, has no smoking and no casino. The pool is so lovely and the hotel attendants hand out fresh frozen fruit 🍉 I especially love the eucalyptus steam room in the spa which is free if you are staying here. All in all, I love this hotel.

reviews.title: Short stay
reviews.text: The Hotel accommodation is situated on the top floors of the Mandalay Bay Hotel and has its own separate reception .The Breakfast was excellent though service a little slow The pool area was exceptionally well appointed and the staff service tip top even included providing sun tan creams and free fruit

reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is amazing. It has everything and it is one of the best hotels I have ever visited. I can strongly recommend this hotel. The service is outstanding and the breakfast buffé is so good. I have only good things to say about this hotel.

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text: I stayed at the Las Vegas Four Seasons on business and was not disappointed by the service or the staff. Both were excellent. Highly recommend to anyone who is planning a trip there. The meeting facilities and food were wonderful

reviews.title: Epitome of Four Seasons Service & Hospitality
reviews.text: Four Seasons Hotel Las Vegas was wonderful.  Hospitality was warm and inviting.  Staff took care of our needs.  The children received sunlight changing sunglasses upon check-in.  A lovely touch.  The kid sized bathrobes is always a hit too!

reviews.title: Loved the place!
reviews.text: Loved this place! The pool was our favorite spot. I stayed with my 3 year old son, we both enjoyed every minute of our stay and service!Next time we are in Vegas- we will be staying here!  Thank you!!

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful. The rooms were spacious well appointed and very clean.  The service was truly superior. The pool staff is extremely attentive.  They refill your ice pitchers constantly and come around with iced fruit throughout the day

reviews.title: Family weekend trip
reviews.text: This is one of my favorite Four Seasons to visit and we've hit many.  The staff, accommodations, and food are top notch.  My only issue on this trip was that the pool temperate was very, very cold.  Maybe OK for lap pool, but uncomfortably cold for just hanging out and having fun.  It was my third trip back to the FS and look forward to returning.

reviews.title: Lovely hotel/resort, service much higher quality than facilities
reviews.text: We were here for four nights in April for business and holiday. We have stayed at other Four Seasons properties and were never disappointed, but the Four Seasons Las Vegas did not measure up compared to other Four Seasons properties...and not other hotel properties in Las Vegas.As always, the overall service at the Four Seasons LV is fantastic. No complaints there, except the housekeeping staff was not up to the quality we expect at a Four Seasons. Housekeeping service was uneven and inconsistent. The room was comfortable but small by Las Vegas standards, it was about 1/2 the size of the standard room we normally get at the Aria. The furnishings in the room were acceptable but nothing special, save for the Four Seasons mattress and bedding which are always stellar. Checking in was made more difficult by the location of reception in relation to the lobby bar. There was a huge crowd at the bar when we checked in, making it almost impossible for us to hear what the person checking-in was saying to us...we literally had to yell to be heard. Not fun. However, the service is the difference at the Four Seasons. The service at breakfast was outstanding as was the pool-side service. Service is always impeccable at Four Seasons and Four Seasons LV was no different. Would we stay here again? Perhaps, if only for the pool-service. However, given the price of the rooms, I can rent a suite twice as large at most other LV properties...but of course, they would not come with the Four Seasons service. Compared to other Four Seasons properties, the Four Seasons LV is not a flagship.

reviews.title: Tranquility on the Strip!
reviews.text: The customer service was outstanding! As Vegas becomes crazier and crazier, the Four Seasons shines as an example of peace, tranquility and style. From our cabana at the pool to an upgraded room because of a party in the room next to ours, the service was incredible. Never pushy, but always aware. I will totally be back to this property.

reviews.title: Daughters 40th Celebration
reviews.text: Everything you can expect from a Four Seasons, the food, and ambience without the jingle jangle of slot machines. Easy access to the Mandalay Bay casino. Our suite overlooked the strip and the new NFL stadium. I look forward to going again.

reviews.title: Quiet, luxurious, stylish
reviews.text: Las Vegas is nice for a couple of days. The buzz and the endless attractions. but being able to return to this hotel is a treat as well. All is there in the quietness of pure wonderful luxury. Top. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: The Four Seasons Experience is Irreplaceable
reviews.text: It's safe to say that the Four Seasons Las Vegas is an oasis amongst all the chaos (or excitement) on the strip. Their location is unbeatable given the 5-10 mins proximity from the airport. But what it stands out the most, is definitely its renowned service level. While the FS hotel occupied the top floors of the Mandalay Bay hotel, it offers an unique experience Mandalay Bay simply cant compete with. Simple things like putting my glasses on the FS logo microfiber cloth. These are the touches that showed the hotel does care about its guests. On top of that, the FS guests has its own exclusive pool access to the FS pool as well as the Mandalay pools. Wonderful food and service. After staying at both Mandalay Bay and Four Seasons, the winner is clear and FS Vegas will definitely have my business in the future

reviews.title: Great relaxing stay
reviews.text: Pool area and staff- great, attentive and bonuses like watermelon, snickers and Moët samples. Plenty of sunshine, one bedroom strip view suite-awesome finishes and comfort, though strip view gets a 75% as the view is a bit better than a peek a boo with a better view of the parking area and the NFL stadium being built, restaurant-amazing brunch, concierge and front desk- very helpful and responsive. Quiet stay with easy access to Mandalay Bay if you want to gamble. All in all exactly the service I would expect from a Four Seasons property and would recommend.

reviews.title: Another great stay
reviews.text: We are fortunate to have stayed here previously and second time around it didn’t disappoint. This time we had two children in tow aged 6 and  7 and it’s a great spot for lots of reasons. Without getting into the debate about kids in Vegas - Four Seasons offers a haven from all things Strip if you need one. The pool is fabulous - quiet, exclusive and we loved chilling here with great service from the team on food, drinks and anything else you need. You can use the Mandalay Pool too if you’re looking for excitement but for us the peace at FS was just perfect. Loved the little touches from house keeping including special toiletries for the kids and even their name written in the bath in soap on arrival. Mini robes, a goodie bag and teddy bears all made us feel super welcome. Absolutely loved it. Fabulous hotel and staff second to none.

reviews.title: Only place I will stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Just got back from a stay over Memorial Day Weekend. I have never seen such exceptional service. Upon checking in, our children were offered a large cookie and a pair of really cool sunglasses that change color in the sun. Right off the bat, the hotel felt warm & welcoming. We checked in to our room, and not 5 minutes later the bellman was bringing up our luggage. Seeing that we had a young child, he offered to bring us up a crib for him, along with a refrigerator and a microwave (if we needed it, we did not.) They brought slippers and bathrobes for our kids which was such a lovely touch. They even baby proofed the coffee table for us. Such attention to detail.The pool was also exceptional. We got there early (mostly cause our kids were up and the pool opened at 8am) We got chairs set up by the pool attendant, all of whom were so friendly. The lifeguard was amazing, and knew our kids names, and even helped them swim, and played diving games with my daughter. Another wonderful surprise was snacks throughout the day. They brought frozen pineapple, watermelon, and grapes throughout the day. Thank you for a wonderful stay, I am already planning my next trip.

reviews.title: Feb 2019
reviews.text: Ok hotel but would not stay again. The room was spacious and had a great view of the strip. Unfortunately, the bed was on the wrong side of the room, so you couldn’t see the strip while in bed. One night the shower did not have hot water....and this is Feb in Vegas when it literally snowed outside. The gym is horrible: small, old treadmills, no views, and various staff coming in and out. The building shares the parking entrance/exit with the convention center so when we exited the valet entrance, we got stuck in ridiculous traffic.

reviews.title: Janet in Vegas!
reviews.text: Loved the hotel! Staff was amazing! Great location away from the “madness” that is Vegas. We were confused about the “hotel within a hotel”, and would’ve preferred a brief explanation about the fact that Four Seasons occupies floors 35-39 only, and that there are secure entrances for guests who are staying at Four Seasons. All in a 4 out of 5 star trip. What prevents the 5th experience for me? Not having a Nespresso machine in my room, and having to walk to Starbucks for coffee early Sunday morning. The Keurig machine doesn't go well with the décor of the room, the coffee is weak, and certainly does not compare to Nespresso brand. I’ve stayed at other Four Seasons properties where Nespresso machines were in the rooms, so the inconsistency as a brand was a little off putting for this amenity. We will be back, and look forward to rating our next experience a 5-star one - especially if Nespresso machines are in guest rooms. And finally, I tend to book through Amex FHR, and though I understand that room upgrades are available upon checkin, providing you have the inventory, I was disappointed that we were offered an upgrade to a room category that was two rooms above our booked category, but also told it was an additional $1300.00 per night. Why offer if you’re not going to give it complimentary, and wow an unsuspecting guest?Just a thought.

reviews.title: if you go to vegas
reviews.text: You must stay at the four seasons  unparalleled  service and quality like no where else in Las Vegas. I have been visiting Las Vegas for the past 26 years. I have stayed everywhere. The past 14 or 15 of those years it is the Four season and no where else.

reviews.title: Wonderful quiet hotel in great location
reviews.text: Every aspect of this lovely hotel was spot on.  From the staff, to the rooms, to the pool area and restaurants.  All of the staff were delightful and could not do enough to look after your needs.  Noah in the pool area was particularly attentive and kind.  We enjoyed two meals in the Veranda restaurant that were fantastic.  Dinner one night and breakfast the next.  My husband enjoyed the extensive buffet and I had an incredible poached eggs & avocado toast dish.  Bottomless mimosas were a special bonus! Our waiter for dinner, Ricky, was wonderful.  Our waiter for breakfast, Javier, was equally wonderful.  Our room was spacious, clean, well appointed and the bed was quite comfortable.  Our room overlooked the back of the hotel, we could see the new Raiders Stadium that is being built, which was fine and quite quiet.  Being able to walk into Mandalay Bay for a bite to eat, some live music and if you're feeling lucky, gamble a bit was quite convenient.  We also were able to walk easily up the strip.  We had an incredible stay and couldn't recommend this hotel more.

reviews.title: Only Hotel I Will Ever Stay At In Las Vegas
reviews.text: Every detail is looked at during your stay at the wonderful hotel. We stay here every year and it’s always perfect. If you want to get away from the craziness then this is your hotel. If you want 5 star service and food, this is your hotel. The swimming pool is quiet and only for the guests of the Four Seasons. Breakfast by the pool in the morning is a plus. Make sure you have the avocado toast poolside. I can’t recommend this hotel enough. Thank you once again Four Seasons for a perfect stay.

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: I always visit this hotel and it never fails. Love the staff at the reception and the way they handle things. The food is great and the guys in the front are always friendly. Would always return since I’m a Vegas resident.  Keep up the class!

reviews.title: great hotel
reviews.text: I stayed at Four Seasons for a meeting and had a very nice stay. As someone who travels for business most weeks, I am pretty accustomed to hotels, but I particularly enjoyed the four seasons for having very nicely appointed and comfortable, large rooms. Our meeting was very well organized and planned with wonderful staff. Thankyou! Highly recommend

reviews.title: Don't bring your cashmere.....
reviews.text: While the hotel is, as always, very special and better staff and service cannot be found in Las Vegas, my visit was apparently during MOTH season!!Hopefully the moths that visited me in my room were not laying their eggs in my cashmere and wool sweaters

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: We had a nice stay at this Four Seasons, with impeccable service (housekeeping was fantastic), a decent fitness centre for a hotel, a lovely spa for massages, and amazingly soft beds! We liked our pool/desert view room, though didn't like the fact that we could hear the big pool party next door until 6pm when trying to take a nap, and we also disliked the very crowded Four Seasons pool where we had to wait 2 hours to get lounge chairs and even though we hung out by the pool the whole time we were waiting we didn't even have one server ask if we wanted a drink. We did enjoy our lunch at the pool bar and the staff at the bar were very attentive. There are a lot of families staying here and quite a few guests staying at the Mandalay Bay use the facilities as well. All in all we had a nice experience but this was definitely not our best four seasons stay.

reviews.title: Watch the rules for cancellation. They won't make exceptions.
reviews.text: Stayed here for conference and gave 48 hr. notice to cancel one of three days. Rules is 7 days and so I paid for a day I didn't stay there. Staff not to blame rahter management for not allowing staff to make exceptions. Plenty of other hotels to stay at and of course the silly resort fee's per night ($35.00) is a way to hide extra costs. Most people are not fooled by this practice when exploring room rates.

reviews.title: Only for the young.
reviews.text: Beware, long walk to elevator and long walk from elevator to room. If you have an elder with you that struggles to walk long distance better look for another option. Also no self-parking, I didn’t mind the tips to the very kind valet employees, but it’s kind of uncomfortable to be watched and waited on every time you come in or out of hotel.

reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: I have had the pleasure of staying at the Four Seasons in Las Vegas every year for nearly 20 years.  I absolutely love this hotel, the service is impeccable in every facet, from registration to bellman, to room service, to cleaning, to bed turn down.  They are in tuned with what guests needs.  The bedding in the Four Seasons is by far the best I have every had.

reviews.title: Amazing Escape Away From Crowds
reviews.text: This hotel is wonderful. Definitely a luxury 5 star resort. Staff is helpful and friendly. Treated me with such grace. Rooms were spacious and clean. Hotel pool relaxing and clean. Everything very well maintained. Loved that this resort was non smoking and non gaming. Thank you for a wonderful experience. Will definitely stay here again if I come back to Vegas.

reviews.title: Perfect and quiet place on the Strip
reviews.text: Perfect hotel, quiet with excellent service directly on the Strip. Room, food, service, pool, spa... everything is perfect at this hotel. You can go there without any fear, the staff is awesome and the customer is our priority.

reviews.title: Business in May
reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay at the LV Four Seasons. It is a good value for the quality of the location. I found the rooms to be clean and updated. I will stay at the location during my next visit to the area.

reviews.title: Not up to par for a FS
reviews.text: We have stayed at this hotel many times however it seems a bit short of meeting typical Four Seasons standards lately. Biggest issue is two days in a row our room was not cleaned until after 4 pm....after having to call to tell them. Both days we were out of the room for most of the day. When room was cleaned a poor job was done. Must be understaffed. Disappointing.

reviews.title: Annual Vacation
reviews.text: Excellent place to relax and unwind with ever feeling pressured.  Staff very friendly and curtious without being overbearing.  Just the right amount of personal touch.  A great place to stay in Vegas, not having to walk through the casino to get to your room

reviews.title: Best of Vegas
reviews.text: No casino and that is a big plus.  Mandalay Bay Hotel’s casino is steps away from 2nd floor or elevators.Service totally 5 star actually higher if that is possible.Pool was very comfortable and warm and just right as there was a chill in the air for a few day.

reviews.title: 100% positive experience and worth every penny!
reviews.text: My wife & I experienced perfection during our 4 day stay at the Four Seasons Las Vegas! Accommodations and amenities were perfect! Charlie Palmer's & The Veranda both had great staff, great food & excellent cocktails. The service at the pool area was next to none and we are looking forward to our next stay in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Outstanding experience
reviews.text: A hidden jewel within the Mandalay Bay. Felt like we away from the hustle and bustle of the strip, but just a footstep away whenever we wanted to be in the action. Impeccable service, incredible rooms, and just an outstanding experience.

reviews.title: Amazing experience!!!
reviews.text: The staff and the property was amazing!!! The conference hall and the food service was good. Location was just right. Not to far from the action of Las Vegas. Just need more USB power stations beside the bed.

reviews.title: Amost a Luxury Hotel
reviews.text: We chose the Four Seasons Las Vegas because we were protesting Steve Wynn's behavior.  The Four Seasons is not in the same league.Check-in was easy.  We went to lunch so I never saw the room until I entered.  It has a lovely view from the 39th floor overlooking the pools of the Four Season and the Mandalay Bay hotels.  The suite was quite roomy, but furnished in a 1970's Currier and Ives motif.  The suite had two bathrooms.  One, the main bath had a shower and a tub.  The tub required deep knee bends to use. The inside edge of the shower entrance was broken and jagged and remained that way for the duration of my stay.  The shower has one small shower head; no wand. The main bath was well-lighted, but had one sink and a WC in a small closet.  The other bath was dimly-lighted with one sink and a WC in an alcove.  It was an orphan.The housekeeping service was excellent.  (A daily tip helped!).  Requests for such as extra towels, often, were ignored.  Room service was a joke except the bill.The Veranda Café served a lovely breakfast with excellent service.  The only other dining options were a short walk away to the Mandalay Bay.  Lots of options; poor quality.Compared to the Wynn, the Four Seasons is much alike a Hilton.

reviews.title: Classy!
reviews.text: Las Vegas is full of great hotels but I wanted a classy and quiet place where I could relax after busy days of sightseeing. I also wanted a view of the Strip, a great spa and a touch of luxury. Four Seasons delivered on all fronts. The service was outstanding throughout my stay and the breakfasts were excellent.I stayed in winter so I didn’t go swimming but the pool area looked great. It’s a bit of a walk to the other end of the Strip but I was prepared for that.

reviews.title: Four Seasons Service, What more can I say.
reviews.text: We stay here because the brand assures us a certain level of service. This franchise does not disappoint. Front desk and staff were great. Rooms were lovely. Stay at Caesars to watch the toothless and tattooed.  No risk here when you click reserve.

reviews.title: Love the four seasons!
reviews.text: Love the Four Seasons hotel at Mandalay Bay! Only place to stay in Vegas! No casino!! But still close enough in case you just can’t help yourself. Sorry gamblers there is more to do in Vegas than gamble ;o)

reviews.title: Outstanding service by caring staff
reviews.text: Absolutely love the Four Seasons Las Vegas.  Staff and service at the pool are exceptional and worth the visit.  We particularly love that the hotel is apart from the casino, yet close if you wish to gamble and  visit Mandalay Bay.  Regardless of room you always have an outstanding view atop Mandalay Bay.

reviews.title: Weekend in Vegas
reviews.text: Stayed  on 38th floor. Beautiful hotel very comfortable bed and extremely clean. You can go from peaceful room to casino level within  2 min. Highly recommend would stay here again, GREAT STAY!!!!!! We ordered rooms service a lot, never disappointed  and the food was quick to arrive and tasted great :0)

reviews.title: outstanding hotel
reviews.text: it was one of the best hotels i stayed in. well done every one in the team showed a great involvement on providing outstanding services. the room was well organized. nothing needed. the hotel amenities are great.

reviews.title: Unexpected retreat on the strip
reviews.text: This hotel is everything you’d expect from the brand. Such a unique gem to have a quiet and upscale retreat in the middle of the chaos of the Vegas strip. The rooms are well appointed, the staff is beyond accommodating, and the access to pools, restaurants, and casinos is just phenomenal.

reviews.title: My service expectations of USA weren't met so I struggled.
reviews.text: I know there is always one review amongst lots of wonderful reviews that is negative. My rating is very specific based on my expectations and I don't know if this is normal for the USA. First time to the USA, I had heard the service in USA was amazing. I had experienced good service in other countries through my travels so my expectations of service in America was HIGH. VERY VERY HIGH. I arrived after a 36 hour trip to Vegas (yes very long) i was 2 hours early for check in. They told me my room wasn't ready - OKAY. I would wait, I expected they would speak to someone to get my room done ASAP. They didn't. I watched while other guests arrived early and were lucky enough to have their rooms ready to go in. When I finally asked after 90 mins (yes I'm still early) how was my room I was told it would be ready by the guaranteed check in time. I think after 36 hours of traveling and 2 hours of waiting in this country whose service is supposed to be amazing that simple trained response made me angry. Finally my room was ready, I asked if I should get my bags to go with me and I was told No they would be waiting in my room. Which I thought was impossible as I just collected my keys and I was walking up at that exact moment. I was too tired to argue. Of course I got to the room and no bags (because its impossible to get there before me) BUT already angry and tired I was again disappointed in the service. All I needed was, Your bags will be in your room in the next 10 mins. Manage my expectations. Not having my bags in my room and being told they would be there I didn't know what time they would turn up. AGAIN after 36 hours travel, I was desperate for a shower. I waited 5 mins for my bags and then I couldn't hold off. I showered. The poor man delivering my bags, walking in on me in the shower. I felt for him. Later in my stay, friends and I went to the pool for drinks and lunch. Someone walked past and we asked to place our order and were told only our server could take orders. HUH? Maybe its standard but that meant another wait till our server found us. Simple thing to change for better service. It doesn't make sense to me. We left the pool after being told we had to sign out. We asked to pay our bill and were told again only our server could get our bill. WHAT? just ring it up and give it to us. We don't need a specific person to hand it over to us. So we waited another 15 mins because the message to our server that we were waiting was mixed up about our location. AGAIN, it doesn't make sense this weird idea of good service. It left me feeling quite angry... AGAIN (yes I had slept and showered, so new anger hahaha) I know its a big hotel, It is a nice hotel and it does feel like peace and quite but it took forever to get anything to your room, we had to call numerous times (waiting 30 + mins) and then I had to call numerous times to get my laundry picked up. It just wasn't as good as I expected America to be. Asia smashes American service out the park. Generally: Hotel is lovely, Spa Lovely, Quiet, feels like an oasis.

reviews.title: Fantastic get away in the middle of it all
reviews.text: After spending five days for work at a much different type of hotel casino, the experience at the Four Seasons was a welcome respite from the crowds, smoke and basic interior spaces of most properties. Robert at the was an AMAZING massage therapist, Amex fine hotels program includes a spa credit, incredibly well used with Robert!

reviews.title: Nirvana and Sanity in Vegas
reviews.text: Las Vegas is such a popular draw for people from all walks of life. There's clearly something there for everyone. Sometimes the noise and hubbub are not what a traveler is looking for; the Four Seasons, located for 20 years on the top 5 floors of the Mandalay Bay Resort provides privacy, seclusion, personal service, and the options to "opt OUT" of the noise and craziness of the gambling scene. We can actually say that we stayed LONGER in Las Vegas than usual and came home more RESTED than anything except a deserted island. You don't have to walk through a casino - and the staff can't do enough to make your stay feel wonderful and relaxing.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: A wonderful place to have peace and quiet in a frenetic town. The room, the hotel, the pool, the food were all terrific. A great place to stay at a reasonable cost. The staff was helpful and very pleasant.

reviews.title: There is no place more lovely in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Four Season Las Vegas! Thank you for the exquisite service you provided during my stay with you. We were there for a conference. The hotel staff are kind and very generous with their time. All luxury service providers could learn from these folks! Thank you.

reviews.title: Four seasons is always amazing 😉
reviews.text: I stay here regularly and the are always the most friendly and have the cleanest rooms. I have never had a complaint about our stays. It’s quiet, my kids can sleep soundly with interruptions. The pool is always nice and staff is helpful with making sure you have an area that  accommodates our needs. I highly recommend this Four Seasons.

reviews.title: An oasis
reviews.text: The hotel is an oasis in the hustle and bustle of Las Vegas.  It is a little distant from the main part of the strip, but accessible. You can always "sneak" into the Mandalay Bay Hotel through a passageway and get to the action.

reviews.title: Wonderful Pool Area
reviews.text: Love this resort. Pool area is outstanding with no problem getting a poolside chair. Great Service with ice water delivered to your chair. Easy access to Mandalay Bay Casino. This is a hidden gem in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Great place to be away from las Vegas Vibe
reviews.text: Love this hotel , great room and elevator ride to Mandalay Bay if you want to be part of the Nightlife and Casino , Hotel work for both Business and Leisure , Highly recommended , Stayed in the same hotel over 10 times ,still the best location

reviews.title: Vegas Oasis
reviews.text: This hotel is truly an oasis on the Strip. Exceptional service throughout our stay, I especially appreciated the bottle of water and towel each time I returned from a run.  We dined at Veranda several times and enjoyed poolside cocktails and lunch. The lobby bar is great for post meetings or pre dinner cocktails.  No casino to walk through and no smoking. If you wish to make use of a casino simply press the C button in the elevator and get off on the Mandalay Bay casino floor.  We were sorry to leave everyday for meetings and breathed a sigh of relief walking back into this hotel every night. Thank you FS Las Vegas for a wonderful stay, we can’t wait to return!

reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: Beautiful, clean and quiet hotel right in the bustle and activity of Las Vegas.  Most welcome get away especially after attending huge trade show located conveniently at Mandalay Bay.  The staff was very friendly and accommodating.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: I loved how clean the the room and bathroom were. The staff was incredibly nice and respectful. I will definitely come back here. The pool area was very nice as well, and I saw lots of families with kids!

reviews.title: Best Vegas Hotel!
