reviews.text: Excellent Service!! Very friendly and knowledgeable staff and they take care of the smallest detail to ensure you have a wonderful experience in Las Vegas. i highly recommend the Four Seasons located  in the Mandalay Bay Resort!

reviews.title: Excellent Vegas Experience
reviews.text: The attention to detail and service is excellent. This is a non-gaming, non-smoking property which makes it more quiet and luxurious than others on the strip. However it's connected to Mandalay Bay so the real Vegas experience hits you once you walk through the private doors. It's the best of both worlds.

reviews.title: The Four Seasons Experience
reviews.text: The Four Seasons experience is unparalleled. The service is excellent, the accommodations are beautiful. The staff treated me as if I were the most important guest in the hotel. How could I stay anywhere else?

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel!
reviews.text: Having the option to stay at a Four Seasons in the middle of Las Vegas is such a gift! A stunning oasis located at the end of the Las Vegas strip this property was close to everything yet once inside the doors you would never have known you were in the middle of “Sin City”. Beautifully appointed in classic Four Seasons style there was no casino, no smoking, no crowds. Total FS vibe throughout the hotel. Service was impeccable. Pool area is quite large for a FS but smaller per Vegas standards. Pool service was the best I’ve ever had. The spa and gym were first rate and the rooms were beyond elegant and comfortable. We were there for R & R after a trip to Zion and literally only left the property one time in 3 days! While I wouldn’t usually come to Vegas to relax I would definitely come again just to stay here.

reviews.title: Four Seasons-Vegas
reviews.text: Nice hotel just not up to the usual Four Seasons standards. The room furnishings were a little dated and the shower was small. I did get a room upgrade they AmEx. A smoke free environment was a plus. Estelle my housekeeper and Connie in the Spa were both awesomely.

reviews.title: Great Vegas Experience without too much Vegas
reviews.text: My wife and I are not regulars to Las Vegas, but do enjoy the city on occasion. On previous trips, we’ve stayed away from the strip and only gone in at night for shows and dinner. This most recent trip, we tried the Four Seasons to see if it would be a typical Four Session experience even though it was in Mandalay Bay. The answer was yes. When you arrive at The Four Seasons it feels like the calm, beautiful setting that I’ve grown to expect with this brand. Yet, by hitting a different floor on the elevator, we could stop off into the typical Vegas. The hotel allowed us the control to be in the midst of the action of Vegas at one moment while easily retreating to the Five-Star relaxation at another. My only critique of the hotel was that pool area felt crowded and the noise of the Mandalay’s pool was quite evident. Yet, if you wanted the Vegas Pool scene, it was only a few steps away through the gate.

reviews.title: Ultimate Luxury
reviews.text: There are so many decadent things about this hotel, I don’t want to list them all and spoil the happy experience for you.  The staff is heaven sent and the rooms are plush, immaculate and luxurious.  There is nothing they don’t anticipate to make your stay delightful and you will not go wrong staying at this resort.

reviews.title: Great Retreat from the Bustle of the Strip
reviews.text: We stayed here with our family of six.  Really enjoyed that we could swim in the Mandalay Bay wave pool / lazy river, but then retreat to the confines of the much quieter Four Seasons pool for lunch and relaxation (excellent pool side service there).  Obviously the Mandalay Bay is further away from the center of the strip, but really not inconvenient to explore all the action - and then retreat to the serenity of very quiet hallways and well appointed rooms.  A nice treat if it fits your budget.

reviews.title: Wonderful hotel
reviews.text: The staff was amazing, the room was lovely, the bed was so comfortable, and the food was delicious. I am not that into Vegas, but my husband comes every year for a convention and I might join him in the future just to stay here.

reviews.title: Great smoke free facility
reviews.text: I think casino hotels feel dirty and Smokey. This is the exception. Fresh air and separation from the smoke filled halls of the casino. We are excited to find a great place with all the amenities of the manadaly bay resorts with none of the air quality problems.

reviews.title: Very very good
reviews.text: We arrived too early for check-in and although they checked no rooms were ready. However, they gave us passes so we could use the swimming pool and we left our bags with the car so valet made sure our bags were in the room, great service.Rooms were very nice high standard, the bed was probably the best one i have ever slept in without exaggeration. (We had a superior king size room)Lobby and whole presentation very professional and elegant.All staff members we encountered were extremely helpful and friendly. When we were settled in the room, a lady came to check whether we wanted room service for dinner and offered complimentary water bottles!Swimming pool and fitness area were very nice, quiet, a real escape.The hotel is attached to the Mandalay and there are actually dedicated four season lifts from the Mandalay bay casino. A benefit is also that you can use all amenities from the mandalay, like the tram to the Excalibur, the casino and their beach.It is difficult to think of any but if there are any min points it was probably the aircraft sound. It is really not too bad and you don’t hear it when you have the aircon on, but it is there.Also they seem a little understaffed at reception, while the queues are significantly shorter than at other hotels it does feel like the service is let down here a little.Valet was excellent, although having to ‘call up’ your car with a machine and then having to pay is a pain. Better would just be: front desk call your car while you are checking out and it is automatically linked to the room bill.Overall would really recommend this hotel if you want to stay in Vegas but also want to be able to escape it all whenever you want.

reviews.title: Awesome as usual.
reviews.text: The Four Seasons is the best hotel.  Service is impeccable.  Staff is cordial, friendly and accommodating.  Hotel conditions are flawless.  Ease of obtaining car from valet was incredible.  This hotel is our go to hotel when traveling through Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Four Season Las Vegas
reviews.text: Overall great property and wonderful and friendly staff.  I did find it odd that they were connected to the Mandalay Bay.  Although it did not affect my stay and actually benefitted it since I was able to have access to more pools & restaurants due to the fact that they do share the property.

reviews.title: More like the One Season
reviews.text: Looked forward to staying at the Four Seasons. We were a family of four on our way to a road trip. The room we ended up getting had two double beds, which meant that one of us had to sleep on a sofa. It turns out all the bedrooms with beds have double, not queen beds. Why would a luxury hotel have double beds? And in Las Vegas? I wouldn't stay there again.

reviews.title: This is the only place that ....
reviews.text: I will stay when we visit Las Vegas!  All employees consistently went above and beyond the call of duty. The staff was very accommodating allowing us to use the hotel's car to get to dinner. But the best example of the quality customer service was a waitress heard us say we wanted chocolate cake with our red wine - there were no choices in the menu - she delivered two pieces for us to enjoy as we finished a beautiful bottle of red wine. I don't know where she found it but it hit the spot. And one of the finest examples on how to take care of your guests.  Well done Four Seasons and you have won us for life.

reviews.title: Oasis in the hubub of Las Vegas
reviews.text: Lovely property, well appointed and bright rooms with excellent housekeeping service. Highly attentive and professional staff.  Concierge service outstanding,going above and beyond, even arranged for a private yoga instructor for an early morning lesson (so enjoyable we scheduled another!).

reviews.title: Nothing Special
reviews.text: Not really standout as you would expect from this brand.  I've stayed at the four seasons in orlando, and there is a big difference.  There is nothing special with this property and the location on the strip is not very good.  Once the stadium is built, perhaps this property can thrive.  You better be planning a walking bridge over the highway

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: A more intimate hotel but still on the strip.  less crowded and hectic with personalized service. Pool not as crowded, staff was very attentive.  All the advantages of bigger hotel in a very customer-focused environment.

reviews.title: Couldn't imagine staying anywhere else in Vegas!
reviews.text: Las Vegas is a trip of a lifetime not least so you can tick off seeing the awe-inspiring Grand Canyon! We loved everything about Vegas from its perfect weather (not sure summer would be as nice!) to all the fun and craziness of the Strip and Fremont Street - and of course all the amazing shopping! But what we loved most was staying at such a gorgeous hotel with its perfect pool (we tried the Mandalay Bay amenities and couldn't wait to get back to the calm of the Four Seasons!) and the best service we have ever experienced - when it all got a bit pricey we appreciated the fabulous Happy Hour which is a perfect choice if you have blown the budget! Small tip: We loved the pool view room we were kindly given (thank you for swapping us) as you could see for miles across the Vegas landscape to the mountains beyond. The beds are a little small for 2 adults and 2 teenagers but super comfy!

reviews.title: 6 star service
reviews.text: Our new favorite hotel in Vegas. We really enjoyed our stay. The facilities are impeccable and service is consistently friendly and helpful without being intrusive. The hotel is intimate in scale, which is a wonderful relief compared to the other (too) large hotels. Although we had access to the Mandalay Bay pools, they were crowded and chaotic in comparison to the private Four Seasons pool. If I could change one thing, I would have preferred more umbrellas by the poolside chaise lounges. What really put this hotel above the rest was the service. We forgot a spa purchase when we checked out and after realizing it when we returned home, decided to try our luck. We called the hotel and 2 days later, was able to locate our purchase and had it delivered home to us. Wish we could say thanks from rm 37111 to our maid from 4/20.

reviews.title: Simply it’s The Four Seasons
reviews.text: Why Four Seasons are the best Hotels in the world? Not just as a guest also employees working in the hospitality industry all agree that Four Seasons comes on top. This is because they give you the value of what you paid, they work hard to get it done the way you want and exceed your expectations. Following elite standards always at the same level whenever and wherever you will be staying in any of their hotels worldwide. They know how to select talented employees with a great level of passion to service, they provide the training needed and extraordinary levels of support to help you grow with your career, they know how to make you very proud saying I’m working at the Four Seasons. My visit to Four Seasons Las Vegas, took me years back when I was part of this wonderful organization, the place where I learned what it takes to be come a hospitality professional. THANK YOU... Isadore Sharp and thank you Rochelle Good and your outstanding team for memorable experience.

reviews.title: The non-Vegas Vegas experience
reviews.text: I only stay in the Four Seasons as I want to away from the madness of Las Vegas and this is my oasis.Always feel at home and extremely comfortable.  I am able to escape the chaos of the Strip!  Every part of my stay is calm and comfortable.

reviews.title: As expected excellence.
reviews.text: I expect a level of detail at certain hotels and Las Vegas lives up to it.  Just wish I'd asked for the humidifier sooner so that i slept better. While it shares the Mandalay building, it felt separate and more private.

reviews.title: Top-notch service and hotel
reviews.text: When you want full service without all the pretense, this is the place to go!  Every detail was so well thought out for us, I did not have to fret at all!  All the team members, whatever function assisted us in very aspect!

reviews.title: Vegas The Right Way
reviews.text: 4 Seasons in Vegas is a great family option.  No Casino in the building and a complete smoke free environment make it feel like you are not staying in the "vegas noise", which I prefer with my family.  Easy access to Mandalay Bay gives you all the ameneties Vegas offers - casino, sports book, and many dining options.

reviews.title: Fantastic Getaway at Las Vegas
reviews.text: I loved staying at the Four Seasons Hotel because it was away from most of the hustle and bustle of the strip.  While easily accessible to the strip, this location was very nice because it was very easy to get out of the city to go do other sightseeing like Hoover Dam and the Red Rock Canyon.

reviews.title: Best Stay on the Strip
reviews.text: We stay here quite often when we're in Vegas. Check-in couldn't be any easier. It has never taken us more than 5 minutes to be on our way to our room. Rooms are awesome along with the rest of the property. The rest of the hotels on the Strip could learn a lot from the staff here on how to treat their guest. From the Valets to management you are treated with the utmost in friendliness. One night we saw a guest that had enjoyed Vegas a little too much and decided to slip in the hall. Security was super respectful in getting her the help she needed.With this property there should be a sixth star.

reviews.title: Great place if you’re in Vegas with Kids
reviews.text: My husband and I come to Vegas often enough but always sans child. First time bringing the kid and the Four Seasons (during Spring Break no less) nailed it. The atmosphere was civilized, there were lots of kids and the pools are heated! People do not have enough respect for heated pools. It’s makes a world of a difference with kids! The Veranda Restaurant was a great fall back for dinner if you didn’t want to trek out on the strip. Rent a cabana - it’s worth it. We picked 2 but I got that wrong and should have gotten 3 because it got more sun (don’t worry, the cabana provides tons of shade). The concierge was good as to be expected. We saw the Michael Jackson One concert with our 8yr old. It was child appropriate, cost an arm and a leg but was great. Bring a set of ear plugs! The concierge provided. Good call! Valet service was great and housekeeping was spot on. Will come back again!

reviews.title: Loved the hotel
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time. The staff is top notch andthe room was lovely. (The huge tub was a delightful perk as well!) The hotel was wonderful,  skip the steakhouse. Meh food, meh service and overpriced.

reviews.title: Perfect for Mom and Perfect for Teens
reviews.text: We stayed here for two nights and none of us wanted to leave. It's just a quick Uber ride from the airport and then you're in heaven! Beautiful room, gracious staff, gorgeous pool and spa, and absolutely delicious food and cocktails. The Amex Platinum card gets you early check-in and late check-out, complimentary breakfast up to $80 per day, and a $100 spa credit. The Platinum also allows for a free upgrade to a strip-view room but we needed two beds and upgrades weren't available so we kept our pool-airport view and it was still fabulous. I spent two days by the quiet Four Seasons pool where they called me by my name and brought me complimentary frozen snickers and little snacks. I was blown away by the service. They also spoil you with free newspapers, sunscreen, and pitchers of ice water. My 14 year-olds were ecstatic with the free and easy access to the Mandalay Bay pool with waves and a lazy river. The teens also loved the freedom of exploring the shops, food courts, and activities of the interconnected Mandalay, Luxor, and Excalibur Hotels on their own. We ordered room service for dinner one night and ate at the Noodle House one night. One afternoon we went to the (incredible!) Body Exhibit at Luxor (about a 5-minute walk from Four Seasons.) We also considered seeing the Blue Man Group at Luxor but we were too tired - next time. I used my spa credit for a 25-minute massage with Austin and regretted not booking more time with him - wow! Another great perk of this hotel is their amazing new app. I used the app to order room service, inquire about restaurants and show tickets, book a spa treatment, and to check- out. The app provided the most efficient hotel experience I've ever had anywhere. Thanks to the Four Seasons this was by far the most enjoyable, peaceful, safe and relaxing stay in Vegas that I've ever had. If you are considering this as an option, don't hesitate!

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel out of the Las Vegas fray!
reviews.text: Husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Four Seasons, where it is quiet and lovely with many wonderful amenities, yet connecting to all the lights, noise, and gambling on the Strip.  Conveniently located near the airport and in walking or free train distance from other sections of the Strip, it is a perfect locale.  Our room was gorgeous and had a great view of the grounds, and we enjoyed a couple of very nice dinners in the restaurants on the premises.  The staff was very welcoming and cordial, the architecture elegant, and the amenities were many.  We'd highly recommend Four Seasons!

reviews.title: Convention
reviews.text: Excellent hotel on the top floors of the Mandalay Bay. Great bedding and service. Location at the end of the strip with three hotels sharing a casino. Raiders stadium being built right across the hotel complex but no noise of either construction or airport.

reviews.title: Didn't disappoint
reviews.text: We were married here 2006 and wanted to bring our 3 kids for a visit.  The best place to bring your kids when visiting Vegas.  NO smoking or gambling.  The staff was fantastic.  Love the new app for text messaging when things are needed.  All in all superb visit!

reviews.title: Love the Mobile App
reviews.text: Although the facility was superb and the staff professional yet friendly .. my favorite part of this stay was the use of the Mobile App for communication. It was easy to ask questions regardless of my location.

reviews.title: Nice, but nothing special
reviews.text: The rooms were average size.  The hotel was nice, but not really worth the extra money to stay there.  The casino is Mandalay Bay which is not smoke-free and the smoke was very .The best part was the service at the pool and the Veranda restaurant.

reviews.title: Birthday Treat
reviews.text: Lovely hotel. Was taken to Vegas as a birthday treat by my sister. We have been to Vegas before but never at a non-gambling hotel. There are so many places to play the tables so it was refreshing to not have that constant flow of people off the street. It is attached to The Mandala Bay casino so people can go there. The hotel is very clean. Rooms spacious and with more drawers & hanging space for clothes than I have ever seen in any hotel. "Veranda" restaurant provides a varied breakfast menu (best omlettes) as well as dinner options. There is also "Press" for fresh coffee & pastries. Compact pool area with Cabanas available. Ample sun lounges. Extremely helpful staff and David, concierge, knows everything you need to know. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. The Four Seasons is linked by tram/walkways to Delano, Luxor, Excalibur, all via Mandalay Bay. Easy access to MGM for the monorail and to the T Mobile arena.We will be back, I have no doubt.Thank you

reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.text: This place is an oasis in Vegas!  We stayed for a 4 day get away and it was awesome.  Service was great! Every detail was looked after. Best hotel beds I have ever stayed in. The private pool separate from Mandalay Bay was so peaceful and pool side service was great!

reviews.title: Very nice and clean
reviews.text: Stayed with my wife here over the weekend. After all the crowed and noise of the street, we enjoyed the privacy of the room. Very clean and the staff was very accommodating. Will stay again.Also thanks to Stephanie who gave us these strawberries.

reviews.title: Elegance in Vegas, without the Casino Feel
reviews.text: Sometimes getting away from the dinging, the bright lights, the smoke, the buzzing energy of "Vegas" is the recalibration one needs to really get back out there. Think of the Four Seasons as the oasis where elegance, quality and civility prevail. Veranda offers classic food with an emphasis on freshness. They're Saturday and Sunday brunch is perfection for all -- making that first meal of the weekend a slam dunk no matter what your friends are craving.The pool is decent-sized, with a hot tub off to the side. There is also a smaller pool, which can be rented for events. Lying under an umbrella, it's paradise with no sense of being in the big show'n'gambling capitol of the world. The Four Seasons also boasts one of the best Spas in Vegas, as well as a very good gym. Book ahead, or walk in. The massages are among the best you will have anywhere. As for the basic rooms, larger than most. They boast bathrooms with a large walk in shower AND a deep, long enough for a full grown man bath tub. In a world where so many hotels are getting rid of baths, they seem to have upped the ante for deep soaking after a long day.Room service is quick. The lobby coffee bar/cocktail bar keeps things lively (and delicious) when you walk in. An easy moment to collect yourself before heading upstairs, visit with friends before heading out or just kill time when your significant other is sleeping.As for the staff, nothing is too much to ask. Knowledgable and helpful, they are there to solve problems, suggest options and help create the ultimate Nevada experience -- whether it's going to shows, hiking, helicopter trips, golf, seeing the sites or shopping.Pricey, yes. And as new luxe hotels open, there is always the lure of the new. But this is the platinum standard for a reason,

reviews.title: Wonderful service and room
reviews.text: Room very clean. Good view. Food good.  Friendly service.    Charged per cup of coffee so watch for that. Nice pool.  Quiet room.  We are on 36th floor. Very nice hotel at Mandalay Bay. Would stay again!!!!

reviews.title: ANNIVERSARY
reviews.text: FS experience was spectacular! Service, cleanliness, atmosphere,  the whole FS standards above average! The fs employees will not disappoint you! You know the expectations. Now experience it! You will be very pleased.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Escape
reviews.text: If you want to escape the craziness of the strip yet have everything at your fingertips this is the place to stay.  There are no Casinos in the hotel so you have a calm atmosphere. But right next store is Mandalay Bay hotel that has it all

reviews.title: Business Conference
reviews.text: My stay was great! The hotel was beautiful and the staff was very attentive. I would definitely recommend. We had about 200 people attend and everything was put together seamlessly. Also, my new favorite shower! The products and water pressure were amazing.

reviews.title: You wil not know you are in Vegas
reviews.text: This resort truly is a respite from all the things you hate about Las Vegas. Once inside, you really don't think about the smokey casinos and crowded hotels. If you have a convention to attend and want to avoid the typical tacky Vegas spaces, stay here. Staff was very friendly, very efficient. Room was super comfy and quiet. Great views! Only downside was the hotel restaurant that was not that great. But room service was wonderful! Nice spa and easy access to the Madalay Bay casino if you must gamble. Even the doormen go out of their way to be gracious.And you can walk to the big shopping areas.  We will return!

reviews.title: Four seasons review
reviews.text: It was great walked in and checked in, NO wait!!Rooms were beautiful staff was all very friendly.We felt safe and comfortable, the beds were incredible, best sleep of my life :) I would recommend to anyone who travels to Vegas! It's the place to be for sure !

reviews.title: Calm oasis
reviews.text: I went for a weekend with a friend to have a low key birthday celebration - our plan was to have nice dinners, go to the spa/pool, and go shopping. We don't like walking through casinos or large crowds to check in, so this was a perfect option. No line to check in, we were able to check in early and the staff is very professional and accommodating. The hotel is quiet, comfortable and offers excellent service. The spa is wonderful and was a highlight of the trip. The only other option at the same level is the Waldorf Astoria (formerly the Mandarin). The Four Seasons is a better value and has better room options for friends traveling together. The Waldorf is closer to the "action" and more restaurants and shopping are walkable there. Both are excellent choices, although the Four Seasons feels more exclusive and attentive.Be prepared to take a car to go to other areas in town for dining, shopping and entertainment unless you plan on staying within Mandalay Bay for all of that. Crystals is a short ride away, but pick up and drop off is not the most convenient there. There is a house car available for transport, but it is available on a first come, first served basis so you cannot always count on it.We ate at two restaurants on-site: Charlie Palmer's Steak and the Italian restaurant (can't remember the name). Charlie Palmer's was excellent and we were impressed by the sommelier's recommendation for the type of wine we were looking for. We ate brunch at the Italian restaurant, which was excellent. They had a donut bar and a variety of wonderful sweet and savory options, as well as a nice patio for outdoor dining. You can also order a made-to-order omelet as part of brunch, which we did as well. Great, attentive service at both restaurants.Overall, highly recommend and will definitely go back.

reviews.title: A bit underwhelming
reviews.text: I always have this image of my mind of what a Four Seasons should be - luxurious, and exclusive with exceptional service and I’ve yet to really experience it.First time staying at the Four Seasons Las Vegas. I must say the rate was quite reasonable at 300$. The hotel is at the far end of the strip so on the plus side this means you’re quite removed from the action but also means walking around Vegas from this hotel can be tough.The check-in was pretty good and the hotel lobby is nice enough, if a little dated. We were given the keys to our room and started the long walk there which is pretty standard in Vegas. The room was a real let down with the exception of the beds - they were incredible as I’ve always experienced in Four Seasons hotels. The room needed a refresh and a dose of luxury added. It just felt basic. The bathroom was also disappointing with water running into the bathroom floor whenever you had a shower. Although the L’Occitane toiletries were appreciated!Just a couple of other things.... we ordered room service breakfast which was over 100$ and was crazy disappointing so I’d avoid that in future. I also had a massage at the spa which again was lacking any luxury and the massage was just ok.Overall just underwhelmed but I did get a good rate and there aren’t really many good luxury hotel options in Vegas.

reviews.title: 5 night stay
reviews.text: had pre arranged to have two rooms together arrived at nearly 3 pm which is check in time  rooms were not ready at 3 pm  no apology of rooms being late in the end i spoke to management as was very annoyed that could not get into my room .  the staff were not very informative . asked what time breakfast wwas got told wrong times of three different members of staff and all told us different times basic training i would of thought at a five star hotel . the hotel is not really on the strip so them advertising strip view rooms is a bit of a joke  its part of the mandalay bay resort realistically just with a smaller pool area . and the internet in my room was rubbish could only get reception i if i moved to different areas of my room

reviews.title: Peaceful oasis in Las Vegas
reviews.text: In a city of crazy behavior and loud chaos, Four Seasons provides a quiet sanctuary to escape the Las Vegas strip. It is the best place to stay, especially if you have children or teenagers with you. Staying here saved our family vacation!

reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: I very much disagree with the nothing special reviews. I found this place to be comfortable, relaxing, and luxurious. We were there in February during the cold snap. It was fun to be inside when it was cold outside and the people who work there are super helpful in getting us around. Can’t wait to return to use the pools! Very typical four seasons five star plus hospitality!  Four Seasons are on their A game lately! This is no exception!

reviews.title: Nothing Special
reviews.text: With so many luxury hotels in Las Vegas, the Four Seasons doesn't stand out.  You pay a premium to stay here, and it's a little disappointing.Pros:Quiet.Smoke-free.The attendants at the pool bring everyone a pitcher of ice water.Knowledgeable conceriege.Cons:Expensive, even compared to its competitors.Far South end of the strip.  It's not walking distance to anywhere.Crowded pool area.  You'll be sitting six inches from your neighbor.  They cram in the deck chairs in a manner that would make any Sheraton proud.  The pictures on the Four Seasons' website are deceptive.  They removed about half the deck chairs for those pictures.The exercise room has a bunch of machines and some weights, but that's it.  The club at the Venetian has a lot more to offer.Conclusion:I prefer the Palazzo and I'll probably try the Waldorf next time.

reviews.title: The Oasis
reviews.text: Like a secret oasis in a desert of drunken humanity. Staff has always been helpful and friendly. Restaurants are understated. The patio at Veranda is very relaxing. Rooms are clean and well appointed with proper electrical hookups and skin care products! Bedding is comfy and cozy. Pool is good and pool staff excellent. It simply doesn’t have the crowded feel of an other hotel in town save maybe the Waldorf.

reviews.title: Exceptional stay
reviews.text: My fiancé and I had a wonderful stay at the four seasons. EVERYTHING was exceptional from service, valet, room cleanliness, hotel cleanliness, view, to comfort. Our dog LOVED it! He was relaxed and didn’t want to leave the hotel. The staff gave him a lot of attention and he loved every bit of it! We’re definitely coming back and highly reccomend four seasons.

reviews.title: peace and serenity in the middle of chaos (the good kind)
reviews.text: I have been to the property a few times and I always want to stay longer. The Four Seasons is the top few floors of the Mandalay Bay Casino but exists as a world to its own if that's what you want. The pool, spa, exercise facilities, and restaurant are all private and quiet. If and when you want the hustle of Las Vegas (and I do...) it's so easy to pop through the "secret" door on the casino level and be right onto the casino floor at the Mandalay Bay. i think the property is hard to beat.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Despite the hotel being absolutely fantastic we found our recent holiday to the four seasons Las Vegas very disappointing. We decided to stay here due to their reputation of amazing customer services and attention to detail, unfortunately we did not witness any of that during our 10 days there.They continually got our names wrong, and at every opportunity to make things ‘right’ they just fell short. We researched all LV hotels and planned this holiday and wedding for over a year and we had such high expectations, with hindsight I wish we had booked the Bellagio or Venetian.

reviews.title: A Dreamy Stay!
reviews.text: Lovely property with excellent service.  They remembered my name all over the place!  Love the fact they have security person at the elevators.  This always provided me some comfort in the evenings as I was returning to my room.

reviews.title: Best Hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: I stayed here one night while waiting for friends to join the trip at the Cosmopolitan. The two hotels are night and day. If you want luxury and high level service, a smoke free environment but access to casinos and lots of restaurants Four Seasons is the place. This is one of the nicest Four Seasons I have stayed at and the chain is my preferred hotel wherever possible.

reviews.title: Very nice but not great
reviews.text: The Four Seasons branding is sacred. This is the first time I have stayed at a Four Seasons resort. I had very high expectations. Maybe I was naive. It was easy to check in. The staff was friendly. It was a lot less hassle than the Mandalay which I appreciated. Their rooms were ok. Comparable to the Wynn. No tv on the bathroom. Also no slippers. Had to call for them, Had a major problem with Charley Palmers. The manager did a bang up job to make it right which I appreciated. However, that put a stain on my stay. Hope things are better when I return in four weeks for our company conference.

reviews.title: Mix business with fun
reviews.text: Great rooms, great conference facilities. When I read it was a non gaming hotel, didn’t realize it was embedded within Mandalay Bay resort with all its amenities. The atmosphere was high end and professional with all the Vegas highlights just moments away.

reviews.title: Four Seasons Best in Vegas!
reviews.text: The Four Seasons Hotel in Las Vegas provides luxury accommodations, super comfortable beds and linens, top notch staff and service with access to The Mandalay Bay casino and pools.  Don't miss this experience to be pampered while in Vegas!!

reviews.title: Four Seasons Experience
reviews.text: All was of Four seasons quality.  Our stay went well, the location of the property was ideal for the  activities and meetings attended.Would have preferred a room (suite) that was not overlooking the airport..

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Made me feel like a princess. Had an amazing time. The pool area was beautiful and the food was totally to die for. All staff were friendly and thorough. I had an amazing time. Front desk was extremely helpfulwhen I lost my id

reviews.title: Always a great experience
reviews.text: Great service all around, rooms were perfect, pool was enjoyable, and restaurants were great to eat and have a drink at.  We hung out with the bartender at the Veranda when we wanted to relax and have a drink prior to dinner.  He always made us feel like we have known him for year.  Thank you Gabe!

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: Unparalleled guest service from staff.  I was greeted by name, and everyone tried to make my stay special.  It was so good it was almost creepy, like maybe they were just planning to fatten me up and eat me.  Nope.  Just great service.

reviews.title: Alexg3bml
reviews.text: Nice hotel very polite and pleasant staff very clean this is all the positive things on the negative side they advertise free wi if it’s not free unless you have booked on the four seasons web page . I know this is a petty complaint but they charge enough without charging for WiFi . I am disappointed in the four seasons for this but that is why after that being my fourth stay at that hotel I won’t go back .

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay!
reviews.text: Four Seasons has the most courteous and friendly staff I've ever come across, from the front desk to the housekeepers, they treat their guests like royalty.  The rooms are clean and the pool area is gorgeous.  Highly recommend.

reviews.title: "The" Place to Stay In Las Vegas!
reviews.text: I always stay at the Four Seasons Las Vegas and have since they first opened.  My first visit to Las Vegas was to the gorgeous Bellegio which is stunning with upscale amenities but for me just far too large!  I very much appreciate the intimacy of this smaller hotel, the tranquility and the friendly, efficient services this chain is well-known for.  The staff here will do all they can to ensure your have a memorable stay.  I was here on business, working long hours, relying heavily on room service which was excellent, fast, friendly and delicious!  My few visits to the restaurant for dinner were just as good.  I personally compare all spas to the Canyon Ranch, known as one of the best in the world, where I've been many times and I can honestly say the technicians at this spa are first rate.  I took a few hours off and tried the Essence of Four Seasons this visit which combined several procedures and highly recommend it!  My only regret is that my husband couldn't travel with me this trip and 5 days wasn't enough, we usually stay 7 - 10 due to the long flight.  We have always compared this hotel to a small desert oasis with it's beautiful pool, great chef and the most welcoming staff you'll find on the strip.  If you want more action, no problem, the connecting door to Mandalay Bay will bring you to the heart of the action with casino, shops, shows and restaurants.  As a Four Season guest you can come and go as you please using your room key but Mandalay Bay guests cannot, maintaining the tranquility of your retreat.  One visit and you'll know why this was the very first 5-Diamond Hotel in Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Best place to stay at Mandalay Bay
reviews.text: I have stayed at Mandalay Bay many times and the Four Seasons is the by far the best experience.  The staff and attention to detail are great.  From check in, to the pool, even at the elevators - the attentiveness of the staff is very high touch.

reviews.title: Very nice hotel with great service great view
reviews.text: Stayed here 4 days attending a conference.  One of the few hotels where  You don’t have to walk through the casino to get to your room.   Not Smokey.  Very good service.  Restaurant on site is good though a bit pricey.   Nice patio and small but nice pool.  Gym is ok.  Room had a view of the strip from floor 35.  Would stay again.

reviews.title: I always enjoy a visit to a Four Seasons
reviews.text: The hotel is located on the south end of the strip and is convenient to the airport.  The Four Seasons is located at the top of bother hotel.  I appreciated the quieteness of the hotel and lack of machines.  The greeting and service at the front desk was outstanding.  The room was nice but not as luxurious as other Four Seasons.  The pool was great and the staff was top notch.  I was very pleased at being so taken care of!

reviews.title: Best House Keeping Service Ever
reviews.text: Their house keeping staffs went above and beyond making everything look impeccable. Nothing was unnoticed. Not only very clean but organized every little things for you. Location was only problem we had since it’s located very far end of the strip.

reviews.title: My Favorite Place in Vegas
reviews.text: We took a 9 year hiatus between visits to Vegas and the Four Seasons.  After our recent stay, it remains the ONLY place In Vegas I want to stay. Admittedly, I am not a gambler or someone who loves the craziness of Vegas, so having a quiet place of respite is a must for me.  The Four Seasons makes me want to return. Highlights: incredible staff, comfortable & large rooms, nice fitness center (never too busy) and spa services, lovely quiet pool. I was pleased to see that a small coffee and light fare stand has been added in the lobby for breakfast.  My sons had great breakfasts at the Veranda Restaurant (the Lemon Ricotta pancakes were the highlight) , but the breakfast menu lacks smaller options.  They do have lighter fare, but the quantity of food is still substantial. On the last day I asked for one egg with toast.  Of course, they were happy to oblige.  It would be nice to see such options or a fruit cup (not an entire plate w/ muffin) on the menu. The poolside service is wonderful.  In fact, I recognized one of the servers from our last visit. Retaining employees long term speaks volumes about the work environment.  The food generally is good (Ceviche and veggies with hummus were tasty; chicken lollipops were too salty even for my kids). Food and drink prices are high, but that is true across Vegas’s high end hotels. We did not engage the concierge services this time, but my recollection is that they were fantastic!Side note: We took a day trip to the Valley of Fire State Park.  I highly recommend this experience if you want to do some hiking!  Not as busy as Red Rock Canyon.

reviews.title: PERFECT EVERY TIME
reviews.text: I love this hotel!  The staff in EVERY department is always on point - 100%!  They made our 23rd wedding anniversary super special, and we will definitely go back!  This location is very nice in that it's right next to Mandalay Bay, if you want a casino.  However, it's far enough off the strip to feel like you're away from "Vegas"!

reviews.title: Great for business travelers
reviews.text: I loved my corner room which had a little extra space and a chaise lounge. The products are nice, with L'Occitane soaps, shampoo and conditioner plus Kurig coffee. The bedding was lovely as well. Besides my room, I took advantage of the bar downstairs and loved the apricot Old Fashioned. March is still a little cold, but I'd recommend finding an hour in the middle of the day for a dip in the pool as it's heated and gets full sun. They provide service to pool loungers even in March, whereas some other hotels close their pools in winter.

reviews.title: 25th Wedding & 50th Birthday weekend
reviews.text: The rooms where spectacular with a great view of the strip in a smoke free environment.Good luck finding that anywhere else on the strip! If only they had a smoke free casino!Had a blast celebrating our 25th Wedding anniversary and my 50th birthday.

reviews.title: Loved it all!
reviews.text: They were thorough and went way above and beyond to ensure I had a great stay.  Forgot my flat iron, they had one to borrow! Lost my tooth paste, had some to give me! Small things but super impactful when away from home. Room was super quiet, could hear a pin drop. Very clean and loved that there wasn't a smoke smell anywhere in the hotel.  Impressive for Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Such a lovely place!
reviews.text: We had a flight delay that kept us in Vegas for a night longer than we had planned so we booked a room at the Four Seasons.  The experience was exceptional from beginning to end.  When we arrived, the bell staff was impeccable and kind.  They took us to the check in desk and the service was again spectacular.  Finally, our room - mmmmmm mmmm mmmm.  It had a wonderful view of the strip, a fabulous bathroom and very comfortable bed.  It also had a fully stocked bar and refrigerator and no detail was left unconsidered.  When you stay at a high end place like the Four Seasons, you do so for the extra attention to details and this Four Season did not disappoint.  The carpet is nicer, our room was a handicapped room and it had a peep hole in the door at bout normal standing level and at wheelchair level, the shampoos,etc. were high quality and the pillows were fantastic.  Our only wish was that we knew we were going to be staying here earlier so we could have really had more time to enjoy the entire property (and our room) more fully.  We'll be back!

reviews.title: PEACEFUL
reviews.text: No smoke, no gaming noise, easy access coming to / going from / also inside the hotel.Super clean, friendly (not fake friendly) wonderful spa and 2 good restaurants. If anyone in your party happens to get bored with quiet and peaceful; There is easy access to the Mandalay Bay for those interested in the normal Las Vegas fast track.

reviews.title: False Advertising regarding smoking
reviews.text: We love the Four Seasons, and choose it when we visit Vegas even though it is south on the strip and often inconvenient to our venues specifically because it is “non-smoking”.  Well, it turns out it really is not.  Despite having “smoke whoever you want Mandalay Bay” attached, the Four Seasons has caved to the smoking crowd and allowed smoking on their outdoor patio, right next to their previously lovely pool. Failing to realize that this vile, nauseating, cancer causing smoke is subject to the wind, they have effectively rendered their entire outdoor area subject to cigarette smoke.  Why?It is a dying (literally) habit.  It cannot help your brand. I was enjoying a beautiful day outdoors and had to retreat, nauseated, to my room after it was invaded by a half dozen smokers. Be bold and truly go non-smoking, or at least don’t deceive your guests. Put up signs and tell them they will be exposed to cigarette smoke at the pool, so that they can be informed and make a different choice.

reviews.title: Wonderful place to stay in!
reviews.text: The staff members are really friendly. Like all other four seasons, they care about the customer experience toward every single detail possible. I would love to stay in this place again.P.S. they only upgrade rooms in special circumstances.

reviews.title: Serenity on The Strip
reviews.text: If you are looking to get away from noisy hustle bustle of the strip - stay here! The entrance is hidden under the Mandalay Bay and the hotel is basically the top few floors of the hotel. Rooms are what you would expect from the 4 Seasons and service is great. Elevator access is simple to Mandalay Casino. Convenient lobby coffee shop and two great places to eat on the lobby level. Top Tip - it’s quieter on the mountain side and you can get a birds-eye view of the new stadium that’s going up.

reviews.title: Luxury in Las Vegas
reviews.text: There are bits and pieces that all of seek in Sin City. Suspended in the sky above the Strip - far away from it all- is the Four Seasons. When the buffets, screaming kids, pool parties that started at 9am and tourists clutching gallon plastic jugs filled with quarters - leave that all behind. The Four Seasons is at the top of a high rise. It’s luxury is quiet, peace, excellent service and food. The pool and spa live up to your greatest expectations. And, when gotta have it, LV is a elevator ride away.

reviews.title: Beds Were Uncomfortable & Didn’t Get Sleep All Night
reviews.text: We stayed at the Four Seasons in Vegas for one night to get some good rest before heading off to Death Valley. We had come off a long road trip. I come to Vegas 1-2 a year for the conventions and usually stay at the Delano or Mandalay Bay. I decided to give Four Seasons a try as my friends have said nice things. First the room was not that clean. There was a stain on the bed, the room was dusty, and the shower didn’t drain well. The mattress was not comfortable at all. I was unable to get any sleep because there were metal turning and clunking sounds outside all night. And when I did occasionally doze off, someone would slam their door. I come to Vegas often and this was one of my worst stays. Next time I am sticking with Delano.

reviews.title: Exceeding 5 star service
reviews.text: My wife and I came to Las Vegas this week for a business conference hosted at the Rio We checked into our room at the Rio and immediately checked out and called the four seasons for help! The lady who answered the phone at the front desk quickly set us up with a room and went above and beyond to get us checked in before our conference started so we could shower and be ready to go in time The service at the Four seasons is some of the best I’ve ever seen and you really feel like your away from the craziness that is Las Vegas Immediately you notice there is zero smoke smell and the property is very clean and manicured Our room was state of the art we had updated bathrooms big TVs and a shower head that put out more water than a fire hose! The nice part about the four seasons is it’s attached to the Mandalay Bay casino so if you want to be immersed in Vegas you just get off the elevator and walk out a little door and boom your back in the party and close to Mandalay shark reef and shopping areas This is our new favorite place to stay in Las Vegas and we will return soon

reviews.title: If work is your top priority, this is the best hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Nothing glitzy or needlessly opulent.  If you're there to work, to be able to work in your room, to sleep like a baby, the Four Seasons Las Vegas is the hotel for you.   Not as good a value as the properties that are looking to pull in gamblers, that's irrelevant if what you want is the best environment for work and meetings.

reviews.title: Lovely hotel
reviews.text: A smoke free oasis on the Las Vegas strip! Beautifully appointed rooms, great food,well-kept pool area. The hotel air was clean--unusual in Las Vegas--the bed was amazingly comfortable, and I was able to be well-rested during my conference.

reviews.title: Best Vegas hotel
reviews.text: Just an amazing hotel. Great staff. Great concierge. Marama is the best concierge in Vegas. She got us the best seats best shows. Just amazing !!!!!! We are coming back the week after because we had such a great time !

reviews.title: Bounce Back Beloved Four Seasons LV
reviews.text: Unfortunately there were a few glaring management issues this past stay. The pool opened on Friday, 3/1, however on Saturday, 3/2 The Four Seasons management neglected to communicate on any forum that they were closing the pool on Saturday due to high winds that were set to commence around 3:30pm. So, there were 10 people at the pool by 9:30am as the weather was beautiful. It was a huge disappointment and the FS team looked disjointed; the inside management actually made fun of the pool team telling all of us since it sprinkled rain that morning they cancelled the day which was a shame. We also checked into our suite to find the last guests left behind a pair of dirty underwear in the master bedroom chest of drawers. Nonetheless, we love the Four Seasons Hotels, and look forward to the LV location finding their rythym this year.

reviews.title: Weather-delayed emergency stay
reviews.text: Four Seasons accommodated us when we were stuck in Las Vegas due to weather.  When our plane to Phoenix was cancelled, we went to the closest hotel, MGM, and they gave us a tiny room in the old section that smelled horribly of disinfectant.  We left and returned to where we originally stayed, Mandalay Bay, and they said they had no room for us!!!  We had just checked out that morning.  Thanks, MB.  We found a much better place to stay.

reviews.title: A great time at 4 Seasons in Vegas
reviews.text: Don't usually like to go to Vegas but have been going there for a few years for a business conference and every year staying at Four Seasons.  I just love it!  It is not in the busy part of strip but no nice.  I highly recommend.  I want to go back now with friends and family!

reviews.title: An amazing hotel
reviews.text: Four Seasons Las Vegas - I just more than a week in this hotel and I can juts say I had an outstanding experience: The hotel staff, the room service, the front desk staff, how clean the hotel is . Everything makes you feel your money were spent in the right place . Of course in Vegas, you expect to smell the smoke and the rest at every single hotel, besides Four Seasons . I was so pleased to enjoy a smoke-free lobby and a quiet area where I could recharge my batteries :) I will recommend this hotel and will stay here again. Thank you Four Seasons team for making my stay just enjoyable !

reviews.title: Best Service in Vegas
reviews.text: By far the best service hotel in Las Vegas. From anticipating your needs before you do to ensuring the stay is beyond impeccable. In a world where customer service is becoming a lost art, even in Las Vegas, this hotel and it’s staff continue to set the standard.

reviews.title: Not up to four seasons standards
reviews.text: The rooms are nice but not very different then any other nice hotel room in Vegas.  I requested a room with a king bed close to the elevator but received a room with 2 doubles and as far from the elevator as possible. The only option was to upgrade to a suite. The hotel itself sits at the end of the strip which makes everything thing a cab ride away. The housekeeping staff is second to none.

reviews.title: Nice place to stay in Vegas!
reviews.text: Good: smoke free environment right next to Mandalay Bay resort. The service is excellent just like other four seasons every where. Less traffic in and out of the hotelBad:  I was not impressed with the size of the room.

reviews.title: Disappointing hotel in a bad location
reviews.text: The location of the Four Seasons Las Vegas is as far South on the strip as you can get. If you want to get anyway else on the strip - be it for a show or restaurant it can take a while. There are very few restaurants in the Four Seasons/Mandalay Bay/Delano complex and the restaurants that are there range from decent to awful.The hotel is a little dated and lacks a true luxury feeling. I like the fact that it wasn't an over the top casino hotel however it seemed more like a Marriott than a Four Seasons.However its the rooms that had us the most disappointed. We had a cluster of rooms including the Presidential Suite and they failed to impress. The Presidential Suite was one of the saddest suites I've ever been in. The ceilings were too low and the oddly configured angled room made for a less than comfortable experience. The advantages in choosing this hotel is that it is a non-casino hotel so there is not the smoke issue also because of its small size and separate entrance there is less chaos and noise than you would find in most hotels. Easy, no stress check in and elevator wait times are two good aspects of the Four Seasons.However the few good points can't compensate for its isolated location, unimpressive rooms and poor choice of restaurants.

reviews.title: Like an oasis
reviews.text: Loved staying here!  The Four Seasons connects to the Mandalay Bay - can easily access to the all the restaurants and shops.  Also, easy access to the tram that takes you to the other hotels.  BUT - it is so nice to come back to the Four Seasons - to the quiet, smoke-free lobby.  All the concierges were great.  There was never a line, and everyone was knowledgeable.  They were extremely helpful - finding us a lovely place for brunch - when we forgot to make reservations.  The room is larger than typical hotel room.  We had our 12 yo with us, and she loved the child-size robe and personalized toiletries. The Veranda restaurant had great food and drinks. Both the Veranda restaurant and lobby bar make great "mocktails" that our daughter enjoyed.

reviews.title: Great place to stay- the location is great! You have access to all of Vegas but don’t have the smoke and noise.
reviews.text: Great place to stay- the location is great! You have access to all of Vegas but don’t have the smoke and noise.

reviews.title: Exceeded my expectations
reviews.text: Understated elegant and wonderful customer service and care. You can tell that this is trained.  I remember going into the concierge area and they asked me before I said anything "how is your day going today".   That started things off so nicely as they sounded like they cared.

reviews.title: Four Seasons Hotel
reviews.text: The Four Seasons Hotel was an incredible stay. The staff was respectful and knowledgeable about the areas attractions. I would recommend staying here and hope to return when we have time for a personal trip not just for business.

reviews.title: Hidden gem
reviews.text: away from the hustle and bustle. Always a personal touch. Best room service food. Staff is always friendly. Dont forget to take advantage of the hotel car. Will definitely stay in this establishment again.

reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.text: Had an amazing 2 night stay at the Four Seasons in Las Vegas. The room was to die for. Staff is really friendly. Check in at Reception was really smooth as well. When chatting with the receptionist we mentioned it was my first time to Las Vegas and that we had been in three hotels before this one. We mentioned we had just got engaged in New York. When we took our carry on’s to our room we decided to go for a walk. When we came back to our room there was Champagne and dessert waiting for us with a note from reception.The breakfast was excellent. Room service was excellent we even had a knock on the door in the evenings for an ice refill before going out. Can’t wait to come back.

reviews.title: Nice, but removed
reviews.text: Stayed three nights, nice hotel by most counts. Positives, nice rooms, good service, beds and bedding excellent, it was a conference weekend in Las Vegas, so checkout strictly at noon, no exceptions. Verdant Restaraunt, nice, good service, but noisy and busy.Pool was closed, so watch out for this when you book, but it was February. Its a non-gaming hotel, but Mandalay on Casino floor is nice feature. The chairs in the hotel waiting room look nice, but are uncomfortable, I'd rather sit in airport seats.I like waldorf astoria (mandarin) better due to its location, restaurant, quiet, intimate appeal, classier rooms but that reflects my own taste for properties, not a bad reflection on 4 seasons. Four Stars, for awful hotel foyer, noisy restaraunts with mediocre food, and distance from other las vegas venues. Plan to sped dollars on cabs or uber if you stay here.

reviews.title: Perfect Vegas conference venue
reviews.text: Love everything here!  The staff couldn't have been more accommodating and friendly.  Small and intimate venue that is hard to find in Vegas.  No smoke.  Quite.  Fun.  I'd recommend it highly and I think we will bring our conference back there next year.

reviews.title: Best luxury in the strip
reviews.text: Best luxury on the strip, I have stayed in all the hotels and this one stands apart for service, room quality, cleanliness. Very peaceful retreat and welcome respite from Vegas chaos. Highly recommend this 4 seasons.

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: We stayed a couple of nights while in Vegas.  The hotel is attached to Mandalay Bay and at the far end of the strip which we liked because it was quiet.  The hotel itself is beautiful and the staff is wonderful.  We had a great view of the strip but felt like a sanctuary away from all the noise and lights.  The bed and shower were amazing!

reviews.title: Noice
reviews.text: This hotel has really nice facilities and the staff are really nice. The food is exquisite. However the only thing that is preventing it from getting a full 5 is that there is no indication of a seasonal theme

reviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas!
reviews.text: I have stayed at many different hotels/casinos throughout the years. This was my first time staying at The Four Seasons, Las Vegas. I loved the privacy of the hotel and the proximity to Mandalay Bay for gaming and clubs. The restaurant was great and staff their was super friendly. Loved the access to their car service as well. Can't wait to come back soon!

reviews.title: Not value for the money
reviews.text: The service was very cold.we were celebrating wedding anniversary and hotel offered us upgrade for the fee!no personal touch,far from the strip,trying to charge us for everything,0 customer obsession.constant metalic  creeking noise outside which sounded like a rusty gate.would not stay again

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: The service was remarkable!  The beds were so comfy and the rooms were very clean. The staff went above and beyond to satisfy our wants and needs. We really enjoyed the easy access to the Mandalay Bay Casino as well!

reviews.title: Birthday Trip
reviews.text: Four Season is definitely a hidden gem at the beginning of the strip with a great view. We enjoyed the luxury of this property but didn’t have to deal with the hustle of the.casino. I highly recommend this property in Las Vegas. If you are there on the weekend make sure to eat thier breakfast it is amazing.

reviews.title: The the Lord there's a Four Seasons in Las Vegas
reviews.text: I can't stand Vegas, the noise, the smoke, the crush of people, it all makes me nuts - but sometimes you just have to go.  The Four Seasons is an oasis:  no casino (though the Mandalay Bay casino is steps away if you need one - but you never hear it or smell it in the FS) makes a huge difference - and the few floors of guest rooms are serviced by their own elevators and hotel lobby, so no masses of people.   Decent fitness center, it's own pool, Veranda is a perfectly pleasant restaurant, and as always the staff is perfectly trained and provides a high level of service.  I don't think you could get me to Vegas with a gun to my head if I couldn't stay at the Four Seasons.

reviews.title: Wonderful hotel experience
reviews.text: Oasis of luxury and relaxation on the strip. It was so nice to leave the busy strip for a quiet retreat at the Four Seasons. The staff is excellent and the atmosphere very luxurious. I am eager to try other Four Seasons properties.

reviews.title: Simply the Best
reviews.text: From being welcomed at reception and having your stay organised by the brilliant concierge. We had our evening meals sorted by the attentive concierge who went the extra mile and got our window table at Sinatra's and the chef come and speak to us at Joel Rubichon and offer a glass of champagne and get a small box of desserts. Thank you Yuki

reviews.title: Las Vegas bucket list trip
reviews.text: Simply the best hotel in Las Vegas. First class in every department. Wonderful ever helpful staff,a perfect haven from the sometimes overwhelming Strip Atmosphere. Thank you Four Seasons FIRST CLASS in every way.

reviews.title: A different Four Seasons experience
reviews.text: Just spent 4 nights at this property. It was a very Vegas experience, and certainly not of the same caliber that other Four Seasons properties  have extended to me on previous stays at other FS properties around the world. Having booked through Centurion and confirmation from them I arrive at the hotel to be told that my existing reservation had been canceled and the higher rate was charged. After standing at the front desk for over 40 minutes (until they figured out their mistake and acknowledged) after a 10 hour flight is unacceptable. No follow-up or any courtesy was extended which again is not the norm for Four Seasons. Will not return.

reviews.title: An oasis for those who don't want to feel like they are in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Las Vegas is a destination for me for business conferences only.  I found this property to be an oasis, far from the crowds and constant sounds/lights of the casinos. However, it was an easy walk to shops and restaurants at the Mandalay Bay hotel.  I mainly ate in the hotel and found the staff to be professional, friendly, and accommodating.  Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Perfect Service
reviews.text: The staff at the Four Seasons is unparalleled. They took care of all the details perfectly.  The room was very nice and the housekeepers to care of everything. Will definitely stay there again. Also the bartenders were great as well!

reviews.title: Wonderful stay at New Year’s Eve
reviews.text: I think it’s gonna be my favourite hotel in Las Vegas. We tried the hotels in the centre of the Strip and off the Strip also, but this was just perfect. Close enough to all main attractions and at the same time it’s calm, crowd free and comfortable. The view from our room was nice too, we could even enjoy some New Years fireworks. Four Seasons is Four Seasons, the service is flawless and you have everything that you need in your room.

reviews.title: Donna I
reviews.text: Hotel, staff,  room,  restaurant,  perfect,  could not ask for better. Highly recommend when visiting Las Vegas. Do be prepared to walk,  as the rooms are quite a distance from the elevators,  we did not know this,  and was with someone who has a hard time walking,  we did find out once we eventually got her to her room that we could request a wheelchair,  which they provided to bring her back down only,  which was fine.

reviews.title: Four Seasons Las Vegas is an Oasis on the Strip
reviews.text: If you're going to spring for a luxury hotel in Las Vegas and want somewhere to recharge and relax, the Four Seasons should be on the top of your list.  From the terrific hotel staff, to their quiet and well-appointed rooms, the Four Seasons was the perfect oasis amidst the Vegas scene.  The spa steam rooms were available for hotel guests to use (the pool and jacuzzi were closed for the season although hotel guests could use the pool and jacuzzi next door) and their staff was warm and welcoming.  The hotel was quiet with the exception of late night thumping coming from the bar downstairs, but this didn't prevent us from getting a great night's sleep in their pillowtop bed.  We will definitely go back.

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: One expects service at the Four Seasons to be exemplary - and Las Vegas did not disappoint!We had perfect service throughout, from the moment we arrived at the valet until we left on our final day.  We usually stay at lovely hotels - and pay a fair price, but the Four Seasons was only a few dollars more this year and proved to be our new favorite.

reviews.title: Four Seasons Las Vegas Stay
reviews.text: My recent stay at the Four Seasons Las Vegas was excellent.  Th rooms and my requested view was great and the friendly interaction with the staff will be reason enough for my return to Four Seasons !!Thanks,

reviews.title: One of my few 5-Star Reviews
reviews.text: This was an excellent hotel for a small business conference and stay.  The hotel is truly - as they like to say - an oasis from the usual hotel and casino.  The hotel is located in a great area for access to all the Las Vegas stuff and is attached to the Mandalay Bay, but it doesn't have a casino which makes it perfect.  It is peaceful, smoke free and the rooms are typical four seasons, just amazing and comfortable.  The staff was super friendly and I would certainly stay here again in the future!

reviews.title: Excellent Choice!
reviews.text: This property is very easy to access, close to interstate, NONSMOKING, and adjoins a casino, without the noise and “grandeur” of a casino. Very comfortable and the spa was awesome. This place was a jewel of a find! Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.title: Not up to the usual Four Seasons standards
reviews.text: Don't get me wrong.  This is a very nice hotel.  Staff are generally friendly and rooms are very nice and comfortable with great views from the high floors of the Mandalay Bay, but it did not have that "Vegas feeling" you get a places like the Venetian or Ceasars Palace, for example.  If you are on the "wrong" side you will have perfect views of the scene of the Las Vegas shooting on Oct 1st, which can give a little bit of an eerie feeling.  What got me this time, though, was the cleaning.  There were stains on the bathroom floor which did not belong to us.  When I pointed this out at the time of the checkout, it was met with an insincere sorry and a shrug of the shoulders.  Next time I will stay somewhere else.

reviews.title: Four Seasons
reviews.text: Staff was very attentive from the valet to the front desk and the concierge.  Beautiful rooms and great views.  The amenities in the room were excellent, I loved having a Bath tub an shower available.  I definitely will stay here on my next visit.

reviews.title: First trip to Vegas
reviews.text: The Four Seasons was the best spot to land on my first trip to Vegas! Gracious and accommodating. Friendly staff and beautiful surroundings. I felt a part of Vegas and the Strip when I wanted and completely comfortable when I wanted down time.

reviews.title: Excellent strip view, tired room
reviews.text: The view of the strip from the 37th floor of the Mandalay Bay building cannot be beat. Service was very nice, we got a complimentary desert on our anniversary but the room seemed tired. The design seemed dated, and the shower regulator was unable to hold the water temperature steady and kept sliding down to super hot. The bathroom mirror also had water or humidity damage around the edges. I had expected better maintenance than that. The location at the extreme south end of the strip is a bit distant from most of the action, the tram helps some though but doesn't run until 9am. Finally there was some annoying loud music outside that was clearly heard even at the 37th floor every night. Other than that the bedding was very nice, housekeeping did a great job and the shower regulator was repaired promptly when we informed the service desk.

reviews.title: Most likely
reviews.text: I recently visited Las Vegas and stay in many hotels but this is the best in all. It is very big building and it has big parking space. No one can found causes in this hotel. So please visit this hotel.

reviews.title: Great service, but.........
reviews.text: Like most Four Seasons, service is impecable. The attention to detail is impressive.  Every employee smiles. The weekend breakfast buffet is  great (having a salad or two in the mix would have made it wow!!!). Service at the lobby area was amazing.  We were craving chocolate covered strawberries (not in the menu) and voila , we got them.    Why the 4 rating then?  I go to hotels for the experience and to sleep. Sleep, I didn’t . Terribly soft mattress.  The rooms decor is a bit outdated. And there is no gym.

reviews.title: wonderful experience
reviews.text: A first  rate hotel with personal attention and no din of gambling. Its refreshing to be in Vegas but with out the need for noise, smoking and sleaze.They provided a  personal and quality service and the best I encountered, having been to Vegas on at least 20 occasions

reviews.title: Luxury at its finest
reviews.text: The hotel is amazing. Quiet and luxurious. The beds are super comfortable. The service was impeccable. We loved there was no casino in the four seasons but Mandalay Bay’s casino was just an elevator ride away.

reviews.title: Business for Convention
reviews.text: It was a prefect stay for my Wife and I to relax and enjoy the Surface Convention we were attending. Love the way everybody treated us. The rooms were immaculate everyday. The Door Gentlemen were more then willing to make sure of our safety when we would leave with Uber Ride. It was amazing that the Lady that check us in on a Sunday remembered our name at check out before we even gave he our Key to check out.  WOW !!!!!!We will return next year for the next Convention.

reviews.title: Quiet Las Vegas
reviews.text: I spent two nights here, Saturday and Sunday night.  Both nights were equally enjoyable.  The hotel is far enough away from the Las Vegas strip that you don’t get all the noise and crowds of Las Vegas.  The hotel has a spa like feel to it. But it is also close enough that within in minutes from your room you are definitely in Las Vegas, in all its sights and sounds glory.

reviews.title: Las. Vegas
reviews.text: The Las Vegas 4 seasons hotel is without exception 4 seasons hotel par excellance. Superb very friendly staff. My room was exceptionally clean and well turned out. Should I return to Las Vegas I will stay at the 4 Seasons there. I appreciate the absence of any gambling machines at the Hotel.

reviews.title: Great base for a Las Vegas break
reviews.text: We arrived at the Four Seasons a day or two after our wedding - just a short ride from the airport. The staff in the main lobby, reception and at concierge were fantastic and really friendly and helpful,  providing some great suggestions for our 5 days and first trip to Vegas! Our room, probably considered their ‘standard’ was one of the best we’ve stayed in. Amazing side view of the strip and surround area 30 odd stories up. Huge space, good sized tv and one of the best beds and pillows we’ve slept on. One of the best aspects for us was just been far away enough out of the hustle of the main area to chill out. Also the fact Four Seasons was smoke free makes all the difference compared to just about every other hotel and casino that allows people to smoke - yet you’re literally in the Mandalay bay complex meaning you have the best of both worlds if you prefer that environment.You can access the more tranquil Four Seasons pool, as well as the Mandalay bay pools, which are great for groups. Overall this place exceeded our expectations and made Vegas a trip to remember!

reviews.title: Wonderful customer service
reviews.text: Upon check in, I was told that my bags would be delivered to my room within 10 minutes.  After patiently waiting 45 minutes, I still had no bags.  I called to the front desk to see where they may be.  Apparently the wrong name had been written down and they couldn't locate me.  Frustrated now, I finally get my bags.  Later that evening when I returned to my room, there was a hand written note and some chocolates from the hotel staff apologizing for the mix up.  Little touches like this were seen all through my stay by the lobby staff, house keeping, spa staff.  I could tell many stories of the extra steps they took to take care of their guests.  First class.

reviews.title: Another great stay
reviews.text: We didn’t get the room with the view of the strip this year 😢 but still a lovely stay. The rooms are spacious and the bedding is amazing, that amazing you can buy it. It is nice not to have to go through a casino every time you go out or return. The staff are all very friendly and helpful. Always enjoy our stays here.

reviews.title: Less than ordinary Four Seasons - was expecting more
reviews.text: Having stayed at/being to several Four Seasons I was not impressed with this property in Vegas. Perhaps we had high expectations but this was simply not exceptional. Frankly I enjoyed my stays at Mandalay Bay and Delano better. It did have a private lobby and yes it's a respite from all the chaos in the casino and it does attract a less rowdy customer base. Everything is what one would expect from a Four Seasons hotel - well appointed rooms, nice linen, good service. It feels like a small section of the Mandalay tower. Breakfast was wonderful though.

reviews.title: Best Hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We come to Vegas quite often and LOVE staying at the Four Seasons. We're platinum Amex members so we reap the benefits of their Fine Hotel rewards: early check-in, late check-out, free breakfast, spa credits. The service is always on par. Their weekend brunch buffet is one of the best. Not ginormous like other hotels but everything you want, they offer. Rooms are always clean and quiet. Steps away from Mandalay and usage of the metro to T-Mobile arena and other hotels close by. Can't fault this place.

reviews.title: Unbelievable!
reviews.text: I will NEVER stay anywhere else besides the 4 seasons after this incredible stay!!  The service was incredible, Charlie Palmers steak house was out of this world as was the Veranda for breakfast.  We even had a Car drive us to the airport when our stay was over!!

reviews.title: Peaceful Oasis on the Strip
reviews.text: The Four Seasons is hands down the place to stay in Vegas if you're looking to be right at the fingertips of the action but like to escape to peace and quiet. The property is small and intimate with a beautiful spa and state of the art fitness center. It's perfect for business travelers, families and nongamers. However, the casino and action are all just an elevator ride away!! This time we had an executive 1 bedroom suite with spacious living space and 2 bathrooms which was awesome. Definitely staying here again!!!

reviews.title: Luxury Hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: Truly excellent service.Very nice rooms with superbly comfortable beds.Great views of the city.Choice of restaurants for breakfast, lunch and dinner.Concierge can find you good variety of cuisines and reservation.

reviews.title: Four Seasons Las Vegas
reviews.text: This is a FANTASTIC hidden gem of a property attached to Mandalay Bay. I loved the quiet, respite from the Casinos and entertainment.  The room was heaven...excellent linens!!  Fantastic spa and super well appointed gym. Nita in the spa gave me a wonderful 80 minute facial when I had down time from conference.  Your staff never missed a beat!  Thank you Four Seasons:-)

reviews.title: BEST IN VEGAS
reviews.text: Only place to stay in Vegas.   Non-smoking, excellent Customer Service and restaurants.  Greet Happy Hour as well.   They are one of very few non-smoking hotels on the strip and as far as we're concerned, the ONLY place to stay in Vegas.

reviews.title: Best Non-Casino Resort Hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Have stayed at the Four Seasons on numberous occasions...clearly 5 star rating... easy valet parking with quick vehicle pick up and drop off,  non crowed pool, excellent dinner house, and breakfast pool side is exceptionally nice.

reviews.title: Four Seasons but Three Stars Quality
reviews.text: I have higher expectations when it comes to Five Star hotels, and to me, this Four Seasons in Vegas only qualify three star rating.We stayed for 6 days in the end of December.  As expected, the room were very clean everyday but that's about it.The only few things that are free in the room, is the daily mini bottle water, sometime they give you two, sometime only one, and the capsule coffee and tea. The coffee you can buy at the small cafe near the front desk has no taste.The mattress sunk in the middle so we need to sleep on either side near the edge.I won't stay in this hotel again.

reviews.title: A Hidden Gem
reviews.text: While there are a lot of great hotels in Las Vegas, the Four Seasons is one of the best. It has world class service, an unbelievable spa, warm and cozy rooms and a nice escape from the Casino Hustle. If you want the Casinon it is seconds away through a private entrance.

reviews.title: The worst Four Seasons location - at best a 2 star hotel
reviews.text: This location is not a 5-Star experience in any way.  Rooms horrible, cleaning mediocre, room service food is as good as Denny's and it takes them an hour to deliver food. The restaurants Veranda and CP below average in terms of food quality and selection.  We normally stay at the Wynn which is truly a 5-star experience with amazing restaurants, service, rooms, and in-room dining.  We learned our lesson, we will never stray from the Wynn and NEVER stay at this Four Seasons location again.

reviews.title: Best service ever i ever used.
reviews.text: Their hotel was really awesome. They room quality was very good. Overall i have outstanding experience. Thanks guys. I will highly recommend them to my friends, family and others. Best service i used in this location.

reviews.title: Nothing to do with other Four season hotels !! NEVER AGAIN
