reviews.text: i was staying for 10 days in a junior suite, and very very disappointed!!the worst housekeeping i have seen ever. until the 6 th day they didn't change bedsheets and towels, very dust,broken hairdryer in bathroom so very dangerous!!i have meeting with miss Liah gm of housekeepers and show everything.nothing to remind the usual four season all over the world.Also if you need business center...there is one and only computer in lobby outside the restrooms!!! oh yes!!!and you have to pay for the internet.And room service dinner arrive after 1:20 hrs. i pay for All this for 9.500 dollars experience. NEVER AGAIN.

reviews.title: Very clean
reviews.text: This hotel is very clean and kept to a very high standard. The room we had was beautifully furnished and kept spotless by our room maid. All the communal areas are clean and interesting artifacts are displayed. The lifts are prompt

reviews.title: A beautifully calm respite in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and every aspect from check in to dining to sleep was perfect. The hotel hires the right kind of person who cares about the guests’ experience. We will be back the next time we head to LV.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: No the sort of 'luxury' I expect. The room was well appointed and comfortable but the service was poor and I'll conceived. Housekeeping did not show and arranged times. Turndown service was more of a second room clean (bed was not actually turned down)

reviews.title: Wonderful hotel, great for families
reviews.text: We stayed here with our 4 month old and it was fantastic! Having a child on vacation in vegas was not ideal, but this hotel made it feel normal.  The hotel staff was so accommodating and helpful, the pool was fun but also OK for a baby, the food was good, couldn’t ask for more.  We have a one bedroom suite and it was huge.  Very nice, classic hotel.  A little far from the main parts of the strip, but that didn’t matter to us since we weren’t there for the gaming.  Will definitely go again!

reviews.title: Mixed experience
reviews.text: Very nice room with great view down the strip from 38th floor.   Amazing burger at the Charlie Palmer bar.  Veranda was excellent for breakfast.  Concierge staff was knowledgeable and friendly.  Calm and quiet environment with easy access to amenities of Mandalay Bay and Delano hotels.  Not five star ranked due to experience in spa.  Tip was changed after the fact by the spa to a higher $$.   Not a huge deal but an indication of an integrity problem with a spa employee or employees. Brought it to the attention of management and the improper tip amount was refunded along with apology.  I’d stay at the hotel again,  but would pay close attention to my bill.

reviews.title: The Four Seasons sets the bar for luxury and attentiveness.
reviews.text: I'm not impressed easily and the Four Seasons never fails to get my attention. They have impeccable taste, the most professional, warm, and helpful staff, and amenities galore. Their hotel in Vegas is no exception. The view from my room was breathtaking, and the value I received for the cost was significant. I always hate to leave a Four Seasons Hotel. The Vegas facility is incredibly lovely.

reviews.title: Amazing Stay!
reviews.text: Absolutely the BEST non-gaming hotel experience in Las Vegas. Our family of five has stayed here several times and we LOVE this hotel!  Every staff member goes out of their way to greet you and make you feel welcome and attend to your needs during your stay.

reviews.title: Excellent choice if you want a quieter location.
reviews.text: First visit to Vegas and I am so pleased we picked this hotel.  It is extremely modern and very well designed but the best part is that it is not packed to the hilt with paying guests.  Having visited a lot of the other 5 star hotels in Vegas (as you do), each were packed with tourists and guests.  Because the 4 Seasons does not have a casino, less people tend to stay there.  However, if you want to gamble you need only walk through a door to the Mandalay Bay and you have all the excitement you could wish for.  Would highly recommend if you do not like noise and tourists.  :)

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: This was our first time at the Four Seasons in Las Vegas (we've been to 3 other Four Seasons elsewhere). We loved that it wasn't part of a casino because we don't go to Las Vegas for the "Vegas" experience. It was quiet, impeccably clean, beautifully decorated for Christmas and comfortable. I'm always impressed with the customer service at Four Seasons. The barista recognized me and knew my order on just my second visit to get coffee. The security staff near the elevators recognized me as a guest and called for an elevator as I was walking down the hallway so I didn't have to wait. The bartender made a special holiday drink for my husband at his request that wasn't on the menu.I always love the Four Seasons touches. They're thoughtful and attentive. We had to work while we were there and Joy, our housekeeper, tidied up our electronic cords and bound them with velcro and put out mousepads next to our computers. You can easily access the Mandalay Bay casino and restaurants without going outside, which is a nice feature. Many restaurants were closed because of Christmas, but we went to Libertine Social and highly recommend it. My only complaint is that the bathroom products are too heavily perfumed. I get that it's Vegas, but this is the Four Seasons. It smelled like Macy's makeup counter in the bathroom and in the shower when I used the soap. However, I didn't call housekeeping to ask if there were non-perfumed products. If you're sensitive to fragrance, I recommend calling ahead to have them removed or find out if there are non-perfumed products.

reviews.title: The spa makes it great.
reviews.text: Love this hotel and the spa. Only thing I forgot is it is close to airport and with strip view I seemed to hear them more than when facing the mountains. Other than that though I love staying here. Great rooms.

reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text: The Four Seasons Hotel in Las Vegas is an oasis of calm and tranquility.   They provide the traditional, top level service that one would expect from a Four Seasons hotel.  However, if you in the mood for the traditional Las Vegas vibe, you can immediately access through a few discrete doors the Mandalay Bay Hotel which offers the typical Las Vegas casino atmosphere - gambling, crowds, noise, food court with lots of choices, etc...  So, you get the best of both worlds, which is a welcome change from every other luxury hotel in Las Vegas.  This hotel is perfect for couples who want to have a balance between glitz and tranquility, for business travelers (perfect place to have business meals), and families.

reviews.title: Love the Four Seasons in Vegas
reviews.text: Our entire experience was fabulous! We had two family’s staying in the Four Seasons Andy our getaway was perfect for our group. It is a delight to get away from the chaos of the strip hotels...the spa and gym are lovely...

reviews.title: Consistent quality and class
reviews.text: We didn’t book a strip view room or suite, but still received first class service. Room was ready on our arrival (about 1 pm) and a late check out was graciously offered. Front desk staff were helpful and efficient, offering bottled water upon check in. Bel staff was gracious, but not overbearing. Room was lovely and the bath, with large soaking tub, was perfect. L’Occitane bath products were plentiful and refreshed twice daily, if used, along with towels and turn down service in the evening. Bed was very comfortable and my fave mix of a firm mattress with soft down-filled pillows.  One particular treat was having the house car available to ferry us to our dinner at Guy Savoy; it was an unexpected treat and made a decadent night feel even more special. The breakfast buffet at Veranda was pricey, but the selection was good and well-prepared; service staff was excellent, as well.  Overall, it was an enjoyable two night stay and I look forward to returning in a couple of months!

reviews.title: best kept secret on the strip
reviews.text: Wow...I have visited Vegas many times, but the rooms/service/cleanliness/security were above and beyond for our wedding party at the Four Seasons..we arrived early and found everything to be well prepared...the pool was closed for the cool weather, but the grounds were immaculate.

reviews.title: Great Christmas!
reviews.text: We decided to treat ourselves to an unconventional Christmas and we booked a stay over the holiday at Four Seasons and we were so glad we did! They prices were a little higher than the usual strip hotels, but the pros outweighed the cons due to the high level of service, the quiet and good smelling qualities of the hotel, and the overall four seasons experience. They even offer a free car service (although it's only one car and it's first come first served...you have to be flexible - but it's a step up from an uber and it's free!).

reviews.title: An oasis of tranquility and comfort
reviews.text: We don’t enjoy gambling or the casino “scene” but Vegas was the ideal stopover for our recent road trip.From the service, the quality of the food and the comfort of our room, it was luxurious. Treated ourselves to spa services on 2nd night stay on the way home. The experience was outstanding!

reviews.title: Not what we expected
reviews.text: This hotel is located on the upper floors of the Mandalay Bay complex. It is fully private and segregated from the Mandalay Bay hotel at the south end of the strip. While I don't have any serious complaints, there are a lot of little things that left us wanting and expecting more from the Four Seasons hotel chain.What we liked: the hotel overall is a quiet, smoke-free and gamble-free oasis, like others have stated, with easy access to the hustle in Mandalay Bay. They offer a first-come, first-serve Mercedes S-class car service to drive you to a destination within a 3-mile radius of the hotel. The driver is courteous, professional, and the car is gorgeous! Don't forget to tip generously. Service overall was excellent, and employees greet you by your last name. Decor is classic (if you're into that). The outdoor pool is currently closed but guests get free access to the Moorea Beach Club in lieu which is about a 5 minute walk away. When we were not leaving until late in the evening, the hotel was generous about giving us access to the spa to freshen up up until 9 pm.Security is always present by the elevators that give access to the guest floors.What we didn't like/were surprised at: the rooms are not sound proof.  The hotel is located right by the airport and there was a constant whir of helicopters and airplanes.  This SUCKS if you are a light sleeper (like us). Because of its location, you will be doing A LOT of walking and/or driving to get to where all the action is. We found the beds too soft (but pillows nice). There is a daily resort fee that you cannot opt out of ($50/day).  This includes: local in-room calls, coffee and internet access. We noticed our coffee/bar wasn't always replenished correctly (i.e. glasses were never replaced, we were given more decaf but not regular coffee). Why charge a steep daily resort fee when the pool isn't even open or you can't get your coffee/bar straight? Another picky thing is the room did not have any slippers and our toiletries (i.e. shampoo/conditioner, lotion, etc.) were never replenished during our entire stay.  This is picky, for sure, but is expected for a Four Seasons-quality hotel.  It was the culmination of all these little things that left us feeling with a flat opinion of what is supposed to be a 5-star experience. We have seen what 5-star quality and service is at other hotels around the world, and although far from terrible, this ain't it.

reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay at the Four Seasons in Las Vegas. I never knew this hotel existed, as it’s tucked away in the upper floors of Mandalay Bay. It was great to be close to all the conveniences of Mandalay Bay but then enter a beautifully appointed hotel room away from all of the hustle and bustle of Vegas. It was so clean, quiet, and private. Everything was beautifully decorated and service was top-notch.

reviews.title: Amazing stay at the Four Seasons
reviews.text: We have stayed at the Four Seasons in Las Vegas several times and will never stay anywhere else.  This trip we were traveling with a large party and everyone from the bellman to the valet and front desk were always friendly and accommodating.  The hotel and quiet and luxurious - never a complaint!

reviews.title: Best Hotel Experience in LV
reviews.text: If you like an oasis near but not in the hubbub choose the Four Seasons. Friendly staff, close proximity to pool/casino, and excellent food options. I personally hate all the crowds but like the card rooms plus the occasional dip in the pool. Four Seasons give me the pampered resort feel with access down the hall to the carnival of Las Vegas.

reviews.title: A great place to stay on the strip
reviews.text: A relaxing, game free zone on the strip. I usually travel to Vegas 2-3 times a year for business meetings and always stay here.  Convenient location, still on the strip if clients what to game, go to a show etc.

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Great hotel. Would love to stay here again on my return trip. The staff is very friendly and attended to all our needs. The hotel is a bit away from the rest of the strip but not too inconvinient.very confortable rooms.

reviews.title: Very Good Stay
reviews.text: The hotel is quiet and  relaxed for a hotel on the strip. Service is of a high caliber, as was expected. Rooms are spacious. There are limited dining options at the hotel, but it adjoins the Mandalay Bay, which has many dining and drinking options available.

reviews.title: Four Seasons Las Vegas
reviews.text: Everything was great about my stay at the Four Seasons.  The room was clean and well-appointed.  The staff was friendly and courteous.  It was easy to get to Mandalay Bay for dining and entertainment. Truly a great experience.

reviews.title: Poor and indifference service at Four Seasons Las Vegas
reviews.text: The rooms at the FS are large and beautifully appointed. All rooms have great views. The service however is not great. The Front Office staff was unpolished and tried pretty forcefully to sell you upgrades at check in, and at other times are often not available to answer to your questions (most of the time the reception was staffed with one only person which is not enough.) there was nobody to help me with the luggage on arrival at 6pm! After dragging my luggage through the doors and finding my way to the reception, no apology, nobody cared. That’s the problem here, it felt just like that nobody cared. The service was cold, impersonal and not genuine at all.

reviews.title: Exactly what you would expect
reviews.text: Here for a friend’s wedding. The Four Seasons never disappoints. Upgraded to a suite. The staff, the room, the calming atmosphere are all perfection from a hotel. This property lives up to the reputation of the whole chain.

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: This hotel made our family stay pleasant.  Stuff were very friendly and we could check in early.  Room was very clean and all stuff stuff was amazing.  The experience of this hotel was truly above and beyond.

reviews.title: Best place to Stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: It is an absolute pleasure to stay somewhere that the stay cannot ever find a way to say NO to your requests.  Every ounce of our experience was wonderful.  My wife and I never place to stay anywhere else while in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: First Class in All Respects
reviews.text: The Four Seasons Hotel at Mandalay Bay may be a bit out of the way, but don't let that stop you.  The staff there at all stations are exceptionally gracious and helpful which makes our stays there truly relaxing and refreshing.  It also does't hurt, either that the food is outstanding.

reviews.title: Frankly speaking... Extraordinary!
reviews.text: Visiting Las Vegas is already an experience and much more if on my first trip to this city I had the chance to stay at the Four Seasons hotel at the Mandalay Bay building.  The hotel is of all luxury. Large rooms, huge bathrooms and easily, the best bed where I have slept in years, away from home.  The attention of all the staff in the hotel is first class. It is enough to leave the room for a moment so that when you return you will find a clean bathroom with an arsenal of amenities and warm plushed towels of all sizes. The service at the restaurant Veranda is first class also, there I had breakfast every day (great breakfast buffet during weekends).  Special attention and commentary deserve Gamini the doorman and bellboy, so kind and always willing to help, instructive and not losing the chance to offer an enjoyable conversation.  He has been at the hotel for more than eighteen years, so he is well-informed.The big difference with other renown hotels in Las Vegas is that at the Four Seasons you feel peace, there are no casinos close to the lobby (the casinos are in another wing of the Mandalay Bay building) so there is no such noise neither flow of visitors.  Without a doubt I will return to this hotel and congratulations to all the staff

reviews.title: Oasis in Vegas
reviews.text: Quiet, classy and convenient.   Enjoyed being close to all the attractions while not having to deal with all the Vegas vibe 24x7.  Food was great.  Rooms were comfy.  Check in was super easy. Used the hotel car several times.

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: Not everything was perfect, but it was close and so many things were spectacular that the little nitpicks were more than offset.  Spent five nights in early December in a one bedroom strip facing suite.  We arrived a little early around 1:30, and room was ready.  Had a moment of dissapointment when I saw the room was directly across from the elevator banks, but it was unfounded.  Not once did I hear noise from outside the room, and the view and layout of the suite was fantastic.  The room itself was of Four Seasons quality.  High end furnishings, comfortable bed, fast internet, and technologically advanced tv.  However, what really set it apart was the housekeeping.  Simply the best I've ever experienced.  There were several days where I worked in the suite for a few hours, calling to schedule service when I left.  They were literally at my door within minutes.  When I arrived back in the room, my charging cords were wrapped, toiletries laid out neatly and with accoutrements to aid in their use, etc.  Truly five star service, and they all greeted me by name.  The only nitpicks I had were the relatively long wait for basic room service.  Yes, you're in Las Vegas and should be limiting room service.  But as I was holding meetings, I needed to order several times.  It wasn't bad...but a 50 minute average wait is too long.  Additionally, there are three elevators and the hotel starts on the 35th floor.  During busy times (8:45 am, 6-8 pm) the service was SLOW, often waiting 5 minutes or so for an elevator.  Not really fixable and a minor annoyance...but its there.  Overall, I've stayed in many of the top choices in Las Vegas and this is clearly (to me) the best.  No, location is not ideal and it takes 10-15 minutes to get anywhere else on the strip.  But if you're looking for luxury and service that isn't ostentatious or overtly over-the-top and is simply fantastic, Four Seasons is a good bet.

reviews.title: Outstanding!!
reviews.text: I have never heard or stayed at a Four Seasons resort previously.  But I will always look for this resort when traveling for both pleasure and business. The employees were so welcoming and always had a nice smile and offered to help even when you passed them in the hallway.

reviews.title: Best place to stay if you don't need to be in the middle of it all
reviews.text: The Four Seasons is calm, quiet, smoke-free and easy to deal with. If you're in Las Vegas for anything other than partying and casino-hopping, it's the only place to stay at. The property is small so everything is intimate and easy to deal with. The staff is superb and has time for the little touches that are missing at the mega resorts up the street. Note that it's a long walk to the central strip, so if you want to spend a lot of time outside of the room or on other properties, it can be more difficult.

reviews.title: Four Seasons Las Vegas
reviews.text: Located at the end of the Strip, so if you like to be in the middle of the action stay elsewhere.  Casino is in Mandalay Bay and not the most easy to navigate.  Other casinos have more well designed layout in my opinion.

reviews.title: Quiet and Relaxing Oasis in the Chaos of the Strip
reviews.text: Last weekend my wife and I snuck away from the kids and spent Thursday to Sunday at the Four Seasons LV. While we did have some bumps throughout our stay, none were catastrophic and with one mention to the front desk / concierge / housekeeping the problem was rectified.  Not only that but follow ups were made to ensure we ere satisfied.   Again, minor things.Prior to our stay we downloaded the 4S app and it was an amazing way to keep track of our stay but also to engage with the hotel.  We communicated regularly with the hotel in advance of our stay for a number of reasons and the responses were immediate and comprehensive. We even used the app a number of times during our stay and it was an amazing channel through which to communicate / coordinate.  Highly recommend it.If you're looking for a "scene" when in Vegas... this is not it.  And that is why it is so awesome.  While you are on the strip you feel so far away and it is amazing.

reviews.title: An oasis in Vegas
reviews.text: The Four Seasons is a clean, quiet oasis away from the regular hustle and bustle of Vegas.  A great place to unwind after a day of business meetings, gambling or galavanting around town.  Yet, it is still close to all the action and sights that Vegas in known for.  Thoroughly enjoyed my stay.

reviews.title: Great LV Hotel
reviews.text: Best customer service.  Check in and out is efficient with no long waiting times which is burdensome in LV.  Concierge is spot on.  Great spa.  PLUS:  No casino, and so strolling 30 minutes through a smoke filled casino, to get to your room.

reviews.title: Ultimate Luxury Experience
reviews.text: If you are looking for luxury accommodations while staying  in Las Vegas; this is one of several upscale properties. From check-in to checkout, a great experience. It is a tail end property that is NOT in the heart of the strip, but accessible to everything

reviews.title: Quiet and Classy Place with Easy Access to Mandalay Bay
reviews.text: The Four Seasons Hotel Las Vegas is tucked inside of the larger Mandalay Bay resort, and is a great choice for a comfortable stay in Las Vegas. It has its own separate entrance and elevators, but you just have to step through a doorway and you are in the casino or lobby of Mandalay Bay. In summary, the level of service, amenities, and ambiance is what you expect at a Four Seasons Hotel. My room was on the 39th floor, and provided floor to ceiling views of the strip. The furnishings and bedding were an appropriate level of quality for a Four Seasons, and the room seemed to be a generally good state of repair. The only negative I could find is that the television system does not support streaming from your own device, so plan on watching cable if you actually have down time. The treadmills and gym are tucked inside the spa, and were okay. I was only in Las Vegas for a day, and went to the concierge desk in the morning to ask for help planning a visit to Red Rocks canyon. They quickly produced a map, as requested and asked if I needed anything else. Upon my return to the Four Seasons, I discovered that the tub is a bit short, a compromise I suppose, due to squeezing in a separate shower stall. A trade I find totally worth it. The pool was closed for repairs, so i can't provide feedback on that.Enjoy your stay at this Four Seasons, it's in line with the brand expectations.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: If u want to be in Las Vegas but away If u want to be in Las Vegas but away from the craziness of the strip, this is the place for u. Amazing service, amazibg rooms, everything was excellent. We will stay here Again.

reviews.title: BEST WAY TO DO VEGAS
reviews.text: Amazing place, Best Service, Great Staff. Best Hotel to do Vegas the Un Vegas way!!! We will come back and stay here every time I have to come visit my family. it was great not to have a casion in the hotel. It was definitely a deciding factor since we have a 6 month baby!

reviews.title: Four Seasons
reviews.text: It was an excellent experience. The view was great I stayed up on the 35th floor. I also loved the fact that it isn't a casino and there is absolutely no SMOKE in the Hotel. I have ahstma and the smoke really bothers me. I previously stayed over in Whistler Canada and had a wonderful stay there and now it's the four seasons wherever I go.

reviews.title: Wonderful Wedding Venue
reviews.text: Stayed for an exquisite wedding happening on site at the hotel. Location, service, food, elegance, reception hall, banquet room, were all excellent. It is quite interesting how the Four Seasons feels isolated from the much larger Mandalay Bay, while if you wish, the full resources of the Mandalay Bay are just a few steps away.

reviews.title: Oasis in Vegas
reviews.text: Another great experience at a Four Seasons.   Their properties are always spectacular with amazing service and care.  In Vegas there is the added benefit of this property being an oasis from the madness of the strip.  Quiet and low key space makes for a wonderful place to stay.

reviews.title: Perfect luxury hotel
reviews.text: Seeking a quick relaxing getaway, Vegas may not appeal to all, but this hotel delivers. Enjoying the private pool area you quickly forget you're in Vegas and are treated to amazing staff and service. The pool was a bit busy and we had to wait ~30 minutes for chairs, but they texted as soon as they were ready. Breakfast in the restaurant was great too. And as soon as you're ready for Vegas, you can exit into the Mandalay Bay via a private entrance (we had checked out a WNBA Las Vegas Aces game in the Mandalay Events Centre).

reviews.title: The best hotel in downtown Las Vegas
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Four Seasons in downtown Las Vegas.  It was conveniently located next to Mandalay Bay, less than 5 miles from the airport.  It was beautiful and immaculately clean.  There is no casino so there was no second hand smoke in the lobby.  It was walking distance from all the best restaurants, shopping and entertainment. The hotel staff was courteous and friendly.  The valet parking was totally worth it.

reviews.title: The Best of the Best
reviews.text: My stay at The Four Seasons was extraordinary because of the personal service and attention to detail they gave. They achieve the proper balance of giving personal attention without being pushy. They know my name, my likes and dislikes, and they think of things before I think to ask, but they don't intrude. The rooms are well appointed with added luxuries that made my stay so comfortable. The staff was attentive, polite, and warm. The Four Seasons is quietly classy with a glitzy, razzle dazzle city right outside its doors. My stay was perfect in every way.

reviews.title: Perfect trip if you want a relaxing stay by the Strip
reviews.text: I loved being in an Oasis from the craziness of the casinos and the crowds. I was here to visit family for Thanksgiving and this was the perfect sanctuary - I was able to run, meditate, eat and drink well - and was perfectly located for adventures in and out of the Vegas metro.

reviews.title: Perfect place for peace and quiet in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Great hotel for peace and quiet. It was a pleasure to relax  in a Vegas hotel without cacophony, and smoke. The rooms were great and the staff made us feel totally comfortable. Our room and facilities was immaculate. Using the AMEX fine hotel program. was a real perc with free breakfast and a spa credit.Though at the end of the strip- on top of the Mandalay Bay- the rst of the strip  is easily accessible.

reviews.title: Will be coming back
reviews.text: Expectations over exceeded. Will definitely come back. Took advantage of all Amex play benefits. My best stay in Vegas ever. Will try to upgrade to the presidential suite next time hopefully. Stayed in the executive suite for this stay

reviews.title: Another great stay at a Four Seasons
reviews.text: Amazing weekend in Las Vegas staying at the Four Seasons, an oasis from the craziness of the Strip.  Location is a bit out of the way but you are repaid with a great property with exceptional staff.  Rooms and grounds are incredible.  Service is personal and attentive.  .

reviews.title: Nice facility, but sterlization in spa may be a concern
reviews.text: Nice facility, great rooms, spa cleanliness and sterilization may be a concern. Great location being nestled near Mandalay Bay. Nice to get a break from the gaming side of Vegas and retreat to the Four Seasons. It sometimes takes away though from the traditional Four Seasons Experience being associated with Mandalay Bay.

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: The Four Seasons accommodations, service and amenities are exceptional. This is reflected in the price and additional fees for the room; for our wedding, this was well worth it. We got a credit for food which we took full advantage of.

reviews.title: Pretty basic rooms
reviews.text: I don’t understand all the hype of this hotel. The rooms were pretty basic like all of our others. There’s a smell within the rooms and the hotel itself that had my sinuses out of control, actually had to call for more Kleenex because they were that bad. Everyone was very friendly and helpful. The beds are just beds really. The lobby area was nicely decorated for the holidays and the crayon dog by the elevators was neat.

reviews.title: A Tranquil Retreat on the Strip
reviews.text: The Four Seasons is great.  I was there for 2 nights during a conference at the LV Convention Center.  While the location of the hotel is at the far end of the strip, if your looking for a quiet retreat from the bustle and intensity of the strip, this is it.  Luxurious appointments, personal attention and all the expectations associated with this premium brand of hotels.

reviews.title: 70 Year Celebration
reviews.text: Stayed for a night and very pleased with the property. Too bad the airport is next door. Not a huge problem but it did wake us a couple of times during the night. Both restaurants were very nice and I would certainly return. Only issue was the $50 corkage fee I paid at the steakhouse for my 70th birthday. Seems a bit stiff just to pop a cork on an excellent bottle if Bacchus red.

reviews.title: Oasis amidst the Vegas energy
reviews.text: The Four Seasons Las Vegas is a tranquil oasis just steps from the energetic vibe of Mandalay Bay. Beautifully appointed rooms, quiet common areas, great food and drinks (and some of the best coffee on the Strip), excellent restaurants, and a first class fitness center, pool and spa.

reviews.title: Four Seasons
reviews.text: excellent service on the propertyhotel staff is very attentive and ready to help at all times food was great and they even went outside the menu and made fresh apple sauce for my daughterawesome place

reviews.title: Serene, Quiet, Elegant
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Four Seasons Hotel Las Vegas and it was refreshing to stay at a quiet, non-gaming, non-smoking hotel.  Like all Four Seasons Hotels, the staff were very helpful and the decor was all about understated elegance.  I liked the design of the rooms and the L'Occitane toiletries The bathroom was very spacious and the bed was very comfortable.

reviews.title: 4 Seasons Las Vegas
reviews.text: Had a great stay at the 4 seasons Las Vegas. Helpful friendly staff. Good location within the Mandalay bay. Staff always makes sure you have everything you need. Nice bar and loung area. Convenient valet parking.

reviews.title: Great Stay for Race Weekend
reviews.text: My family and I stayed at the Four Seasons for the Rock and Roll Marathon weekend.  We really enjoyed our stay an appreciated the attentiveness and professionalism of the hotel staff.  My 6 year old daughter really liked her kids bath robe, slippers and the personal touch of her name spelled on the Barth tub with kids bubble bath.

reviews.title: A relaxed option on The Strip
reviews.text: Our stay was awesome. The room and whole hotel was clean, quiet, and relaxing. Staff was excellent and very helpful. They all were genuinely nice people. Housekeeping was friendly and professional. It felt like we were totally off the strip because it was so peaceful. I would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Not for the young & trendy crowd
reviews.text: Just stayed here two nights for a wedding. I was debating between 3 & 4 stars, but going with 4 because the service is great. The two beds are full sized beds - expected two queens. Rooms are very big. This is definitely a hotel for business men and women looking for a quiet vibe. The location is very inconvenient and far from everything like shopping, clubs, fine dining.

reviews.title: This is an escape from Vegas in Vegas
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, usual Four Seasons quality, located inside - but apart from - the Mandalay Bay resort. If you want to stay on the Vegas strip but not feel like you are on the strip or in the middle of a casino this is the place for you.

reviews.title: Business and Leisure trip
reviews.text: Hotel a bit off to where I want to go. Lack of bathroom amenities, need to request. Drinking water only comes in 300ml bottles so I decided to bring back my own from petrol kiosk. Great Comfort of bed and love it that there is no smoking in this place.

reviews.title: First Class
reviews.text: Everything was perfect from the staff to the room. I wish more places took pride in what they do like the staff at the Four Seasons. The room was very nice and comfortable and it seemed like they thought of every little detail.

reviews.title: Did not want to leave!
reviews.text: Service was amazing from check in to check out. Room was great, comfortable and super clean; we had a strip view on 39th floor, so worth it! Little slow service at Sunday brunch, but other than that, We did not want to leave!

reviews.title: Drinks and snacks.
reviews.text: Stopped on by the four seasons to check the place out for future stays during my visit to Las Vegas. The staff here are just amazing from what me and my partner experienced in the short amount of time here. We ordered cocktails which were amazing, our server Angel was so nice polite and professional which made us feel very welcomed here. Will definitely be coming back here in the near future.

reviews.title: Home away from Las Vegas
reviews.text: Very special place moments from the Las Vegas scene.  We have been to Vegas more than 10 times and found the Four Seasons to be as different as advertised.  Would go back in a heart beat.  We left to go to Mandalay pool and turned right around

reviews.title: Well appointed, luxury for adults but they look after children too
reviews.text: With its own check in, access to lounge facilities, well appointed rooms and great location above the Mandalay, this is one of my favourite hotels in Vegas. When we stayed, the kids had an adjoining room where the staff had layed on kids fun bathroom amenities and sweet plates with their names on in piped chocolate and a chocolate assortment. The lounge catered for the kids too.  A great experience.

reviews.title: A luxury escape from Vegas
reviews.text: Located on top of the Mandalay Bay, this hotel is a pleasant escape from the buzzing casino along the Strip. Not quite as posh and glamorous as other Four Season hotels, but a great place to stay while in Vegas.  The room had an amazing view over the strip. Room service and house keeping were top class.

reviews.title: A bit of quiet amid chaos....
reviews.text: Just a great property from check in to check out. Fantastic service and best of all.... the privacy and ability to escape the noise of Vegas. The secret door to Mandalay Bay is epic and we used it every day. The rooms and beds are all Four Seasons! Amenities are top notch and bathrooms the best. The pool is small and again private with a great staff and food choices. Loved every minute....

reviews.title: Excellent service at FS Las Vegas
reviews.text: Service gets 5 stars plus and concierge team was amazing. They were very helpful t me Very Nice spa and fitness center and pool area Only complaint is that hotel needs updating and better window sound proofing

reviews.title: Perfect spot to relax in Vegas!
reviews.text: Large rooms with one of the best hotel beds I’ve stayed in. Service was excellent. Pool was very nice and not overcrowded. We had lunch poolside and it was excellent as were the cocktails. Lovely brunch in the morning as well. Definitely plan to stay here again next time I come back.

reviews.title: Paradise!
reviews.text: Came here from another place down the strip which was too noisy, crowded, smelly and impersonal. It was so peaceful and relaxing, completely opposite of the central strip casinos. EVERYONE made us feel welcomed and appreciated. They accommodated our every request. Amazingly, they not only provide a Keurig machine, but also k cups so that you can make coffee in your room without additional fees. AND if we ran out, they would quickly bring additional coffee to the room. Same thing with bottled water. We arrived 4 hours before check in time and they were able to get us into a beautiful room within 10 minutes! And this was done without an additional fee. When we were at Caesar’s Palace, they offered to try to get us into a room before 4 pm but only if we agreed to pay an additional $30. We are at their outstanding Sunday brunch, 5 stars, not to be missed !!!Also had great couples massage from Koko and Joie. Thanks!!!I can’t say enough great things about the Four Seasons. We will definitely be back !!!

reviews.title: A smokeless paradise
reviews.text: Plus you get the amenities of Mandalay Bay right next-door. The room service food was memorable. This is the best hotel on the strip.  I have been to Las Vegas a number of times and I still cannot get used to the disgusting cigarette smoke all over the town. The Four Seasons Seems to be the only smokeless venue in the whole of Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Spectacular lunch!
reviews.text: Enjoyed the culinary expertise of Executive Chef Michael Goodman...what a fabulous assortment of offerings. My party of four was asked if we had any food allergies before our meal which was thoughtful and uncommon in most restaurants. Can’t wait to return!

reviews.title: Nice Room with Pricey Room Service
reviews.text: Room was pretty much what I expected, luxury linens, spacious bathroom, with a terrific view.  But more than $80 for room service breakfast for one...wow!  Super pricey. And I only had pancakes, bacon, fruit, juice and coffee.

reviews.title: Amazing beautiful place
reviews.text: I had a blast during my time staying at four season vegas. It is clean, calm and beautiful. Also used the spa and it was great. I loved the pool and their services. They have great brunches and food. You can also get food by the pool.

reviews.title: A Quiet Gem in Vegas
reviews.text: Many people don’t know the hotel is an oasis of calm as there’s no gaming.  It’s connected to the Mandalay so you’re a five minute walk to the House of Blues (Santana). Or next door to the great little theatre playing Cirque’s One. Wonderful staff from Leo at the poolside Veranda restaurant to Kimberly the Concierge extraordinaire.

reviews.title: A wonderful weekend in Vegas
reviews.text: The Four Season in Las Vegas is a little oasis in the middle of a crazy city.  The hotel is very quiet, clean and friendly.  I loved the non smoking and no casino environment.  You have easy access to Mandalay Bay if you wish to gamble.  The staff is very friendly and the service is remarkable.  I let them know it was my husband's birthday and we had a room upgrade and also they had a birthday card and cake waiting when we checked into our room.  I highly recommend the Veranda restaurant for breakfast.  The spa is wonderful and relaxing.  I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Exceptional Service
reviews.text: Truly exceptional level of service and an outstanding property. It's so nice to be in Las Vegas and not hear the noise of a casino or smell smoke. The staff was both highly professional and genuinely warm, a terrific mix. The restaurant was excellent as well.

reviews.title: Gorgeous & Relaxing
reviews.text: Amazing Hotel and Service. We were extremely happy with our stay, the quality and attention to detail is unrivaled. Certainly a gorgeous hotel to enjoy some peace and relaxation, with easy access to the hustle and bustle of the usual Vegas resort and casino scene. The Staff are knowledgeable, helpful, friendly and warm. The Exclusive Pool and (again) Service was Incredible. You get what you pay for and then some! Definitely worth every penny and We will be Back

reviews.title: Exemplary Hotel!
reviews.text: The beautiful Four Seasons Hotel is tucked into the Mandalay Bay's upper floors with all the amenities and services to offer a guest. Indulging guests in luxury is their specialty and they certainly delivered. My room was spacious, modern, clean, and welcoming. Hotel staff greeted me by name and made sure all of my needs were cared for. I'll certainly return to this hotel during my next trip to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Great non-gaming / none-casino property with a great location.
reviews.text: I came here looking for a non-gaming hotel that was centrally located to visit the SEMA show. The property was very nice and in many ways much nicer than the casino-hotels along the strip. Rooms are spacious and have all the amenities you would expect but won’t usually find in the big casino properties-that just want you out of the room and gambling. I have some favorite foodie haunts in town but I did grab a meal at Charles Palmer and drinks at the Veranda bar. Both were good and certainly a notch up from most of the hotel drinking and dining spots that are typically found at the strip hotels. Stayed 2 nights, valley view suite. Typical Four Seasons room which is a good thing. Staff couldn’t have been nicer. Quick walk everywhere to see the cars and the sights.

reviews.title: Staff that caters to your needs
reviews.text: We had the pleasure to stay at the Four Seasons in Las Vegas during our vacation. It is by far the most memorable experience from a great trip. The staff does a fantastic job making you feel welcome and taking care of your needs .Even little details go unmissed . Room service leaving microfiber cloths under your eyeglasses and mousepads under your PC mouse. Even water on the nightstands when you come back for bed in the evening .Absolutely amazing!

reviews.title: A Smooth Wedding at the Four Seasons
reviews.text: One of the best hotels in Las Vegas, hands down. The staff is friendly and professional. Service is on par with what you will find in Asia which is unusual for the United States. Our wedding was stress free.

reviews.title: Four Seasons
reviews.text: Beautiful oasis in Las Vegas.  Non smoking non gambling luxury property with a private entrance and rooms on the top floors of Mandalay Bay. Elevator does provide easy access to casino and other MB amenities if that's what you want. Beautiful rooms with great views.  Staff couldn't be nicer.

reviews.title: Best of the Best
reviews.text: This is one of the best Hotels and we are never failed us ,all and everything is on top .Away from Las Vegas Noise and smoke ,small and cozy ,very good food ,very clean rooms ,close to Casinos if you wish

reviews.title: Nice stay, but expected more
reviews.text: We stayed here for two nights for our anniversary weekend. I will start with the best parts. The service and staff couldn’t have been better. Definitely a 5 star experience on service. Thank you to Lawrence for sending us an anniversary treat by the pool.The Sunday brunch buffet was one of the best buffets ever. The fresh mini doughnuts were sooo good as well as the many other options. The beds comfortable and rooms very clean.Here is the downside in my opinion, I feel the hotel is too far from most of the strip. We needed to take an Uber or a taxi every time we left the hotel. Personally I do not care for that end of the strip. We could also hear the airplane noise from McCarren airport since we literally were looking at the runway from our room.The Four Seasons did not build this hotel they purchased it and the rooms are just so so. The shower is tiny and the shower head too low for my 6’4” husband. For the price there are other options with bigger rooms in a better location (Wynn, Encore etc).Even though we had a good experience due to the staff,  I would probably not stay here again.

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: The service is exceptional!  The staff went above and beyond to make me feel welcome and comfortable during my stay.  This hotel has ruined all other hotels for me...from now on I will only be staying here when I visit Vegas!

reviews.title: First Vegas Experience
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel to celebrate our 22 Anniversary. The best customer service you could ask for. The staff and hotel excedeed our expectations. They know how to make you feel special! We will return to the Four Seasons again!

reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: Great hotel in Las Vegas. On the strip, close to all the major hotels. No casino or cigarette smell. Casino at Mandalay Bay is just a few steps away. Great staff to attend to all your needs. Very quiet and family friendly. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Not what you’d expect from this brand
reviews.text: Not what you’d expect from this brand- I experience service problems, lounge problems, billing problems, checkout problems, transportation problems, but the worst part of my stay was the $300 for the worst massage I’ve ever had. I’ve stayed here before this trip and there has been a SHARP decline in the level of service here.

reviews.title: Lovely hotel. Great for families.
reviews.text: Brilliant, personal service. Welcomed our daughter with cookies and sunglasses followed by a room delivery of child's robe and bubble bath etc. Chocolates on arrival and departure with personal note for all of us. Check in and out was so quick and painless. No queues unlike other Vegas hotels. Use of Mandalay Bay pools was great as well as exclusive Four Seasons pool.

reviews.title: The best stay available in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Though I lived in Las Vegas in a previous life, I never knew the Four Seasons was hidden inside Mandalay Bay.  This is definitely a hidden gem.  Only two steps away from the casino floor, the entire facility felt as if the casino could have been 100 miles away.  What a quiet retreat in the center of the Las Vegas strip-- exactly what I needed when traveling for business and the perfect location for our conference.

reviews.title: oasis away
reviews.text: This was a welcome respite given yet another trip for yet another conference in Las Vegas.  I was skeptical at first given the location, but was enchanted by this hotel.  the service, the food, the atmosphere all made another business trip feel like a vacation.I will return

reviews.title: The best of the best
reviews.text: This hotel always exceeds my expectations. The staff genuinely cares about the guests. They make you feel very special and welcome. The lemon ricotta pancakes for breakfast are out of this world. On weekends they have the best cronuts in the cafe in the lobby. Try them! They are very rich though.

reviews.title: Robert at the Spa
reviews.text: Everything during our stay was wonderful, but I wanted to especially thank Robert at the spa for the best massage of my life. His energy was amazing, as was the warmth of the entire staff. This is a remarkable property, and it had everything on site to make our vacation a wonderful experience. The bed/linens were the quality I expect from the Four Seasons, as was the food service and and amenities. We did not bring our kids this trip, but we loved seeing all of the families and wish we had. Although other reviews have said all of this before, I wanted to add I am a tough customer to please, and everything was a pleasure.

reviews.title: So Wanted This to be 5 Star
reviews.text: I so so so wanted this to be a five star.  But alas...Las Vegas.  Every 4S is a bit different.  I travel a lot and used to have a gold tag in Houston.  This one has small problems (mostly housekeeping related.)Before we get to that:The good:  LV4S is a step away from most of the craziness/nonsense in Vegas.  Rooms and the hotel are tasteful.  Staff is super nice.  I found the spa and food to be simply excellent.  Literally the most huge club sandwich I have ever had.  The spa is really good.  Ask for Rosalinda.  Seriously, that was some next level deep massage.The bad:This hotel has housekeeping problems.  See pics of my shower drain.  Gross.   Room service on my floor was really really nice.  But, Dang.  when the door says do not disturb: Do not No Knock and come in.   Listen, I've been with my wife a long time...but damn.  I do have an expectation of privacy.  Despite the spa being really nice, the drains are slow so you are showering in a big puddle.  Pool is OK. Kind of small for the size of hotel.  Yes, you can go to the Mandalay pool which is nice but akin stepping onto a  crowded cruise ship.    Hard pass.

reviews.title: Always the best!
reviews.text: Nothing beats the luxury, service, and pampering of a Four Seasons stay! The Vegas Four Seasons is especially great because you can get a really great rate so if your gambling game is off, you can enjoy a lovely weekend getaway at an unbeatable price. In enjoy other resorts but every time I return to a Four Seasons, I say to myself “yep, this is the best and they set the bar for everyone else!”

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: Was excellent very nice pools  are great service was great great great great great. I had a great stay and would go back for sure. The restaurants are great and the wave pool so cool. I had a spa treatment for the first time and let me tell you it was amazing. thanks to all the staff for being so accommodating .

reviews.title: Vegas weekend
reviews.text: Spent a three day weekend here. Property and room were very clean and well-maintained.  Much more calm and relaxed atmosphere as compared to the other hotels on the strip.  We had a strip view room with great views of all the  action. Although the hotel is located near the airport, it was quiet. Very easy walk to all of the attractions, restaurants and shows. We had dinner one night at the on site Italian restaurant which was very nice. Also Saturday brunch at the hotel was perfect. Room service for breakfast another day was also excellent. Only complaints are: bathroom sink was clogged when we checked in but was promptly fixed with one phone call. Also TV did not work but was fixed with another phone call.  While the rooms are on the more expensive side for Vegas, they are at least half price of what you would pay for a four seasons room anywhere else.

reviews.title: Loved it, best hotel in Vegas.
reviews.text: Stayed here specifically to see the Michael Jackson Cirque show. Easy in easy out, fabulous staff, room was amazing. The four seasons is actually the top few floors of Mandalay Bay, so views are amazing. Stay here if you can

reviews.title: Luxurious and Relaxing
reviews.text: Located at the quiet section on the strip,this piece of the Mandalay Hotel is simply the best.From the pleasant scents in the halls to the exquisite details on confort,truly a oasis in the Desert.Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Expecting more from Four Seasons
reviews.text: My first time to Vegas so maybe this is a top hotel here but still nothing WOW about it compare to the other 4S we stayed in.  The check in is definitely very smooth and there is no queue compare to the other hotels.  There are a few misses tho, there is no free water provided in our room the first night.  So we had no choice but consumed the $10 bottled water.  The housekeeper does not top up the soaps.  And even when we put the privacy sign out, they still knock and come into the room.  Ummm.  There seems to be no bath specific products.  There is no water pressure control on the shower either.  Just very strong.We had the standard room with the strip view which is nice and we didn't need to use the air con.  It is quiet enough that you don't hear the plane or the noise from the strip.I went down to the pool and surprised that there is actually no lounger left that are in the shade unless I pay for the beach cabana.  This was not what I expected for 4S that I have to get down there early to reserve a lounger.  The gym was good with all the equipment but there was one time 2 drunken guest wearing flip flops decided to do some weights.  And they spilled some drinks in the gym and just left.  Again, not the sort of clients that I was expecting to find in 4S.  All in all, I think I will try another hotel next time I visit Vegas.And no one address us with our last name either the 7 days we stayed here.

reviews.title: 4 Seasons Las Vegas
reviews.text: Excellent accommodations and helpful, friendly staff.  Large suite with bedroom and living room. Bedding mattress, pillows, covers were devine. Greeted personally by concierge and bellmen, coming and going.  Will certainly stay at this 4 Seasons again.

reviews.title: Quiet Oasis in the middle of the action
reviews.text: This is truly the best of all worlds.  The rooms are the top few floors in a wing of Mandalay Bay.  It has it's own quiet lobby with a bar, coffee bar, restaurants, and spa that can only be accessed by the main entry, private elevator, or quiet stairway.  Has it's own pool and gym.  Great service, including turn down service.  AND, just step outside the private and secured elevator bank into the main Mandalay Bay lobby and casino!  You also have access to the Mandalay Bay pool.  Although the gym and spa facilities are not huge, they are nice with great service.  I had an amazing experience at the spa with a custom 100 minute massage.  Aroma therapy, stones, cups, lighting, and music.  I agree with other reviewers on the noise.  I guess it just depends on which direction your room faces.  I use a white noise app when I travel, so this was easily resolved.Overall great experience!

reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.text: The staff treated me like a rock star from the minute I jumped out of the car. The hotel lobby was extremely clean so was my room. Very impressed with the professionalism each staff member showed, from the front desk to the turn down service. I highly recommend staying at this hotel. It has been the best experience I have had while traveling.  Thank you!

reviews.title: Awesome stay at Four Seasons Las Vegas
reviews.text: Exceptional service and a gem hidden away on the strip. From the moment we stepped out of our car to the day we left, we felt cared for, pampered and special. Even though the hotel is in the Mandalay Bay building, the private elevators to the top floors, the tucked away entry onto the casino floor, Lawrence in the Concierge service, Leah from housekeeping and the wonderful lady from housekeeping who went out of her way to make sure I had the products I was looking for (so sorry I didn't get her name), it was a wonderful stay all around. I highly recommend the experience.

reviews.title: Four Seasons
reviews.text: Four Seasons is actually the top floors of Mandalay Bay.  One of the very few Vegas luxury hotels that provide in room coffee.   No need to find a casino Starbucks in your pajamas at 6am !Very comfortable beds and nice linens as well

reviewsWithMentions.title: FS delivers again
reviewsWithMentions.text: We had a wonderful stay. The hotel and rooms are impeccably clean. The service is always above par. The food at the hotel is exceptionally good. We enjoyed being able to access the Mandalay Bay pool but being able to come back to the FS pool, which was quieter and calmer.  We saw a number of celebrities at the hotel during this visit. I noticed how my young son was treated with the same level of care and respect as the celebrities.  No matter who you are or what age you are, the customer experience is always a 10/10. We will be back.
